papers.title: Efficient nitrogen removal in real aquaculture wastewater by immobilized Pseudomonas fluorescens JSRD-3
papers.authors: Zhang, Yuwei; Gao, Shuang; Zhu, Yujie; Geng, Kaihua; Li, Sitong; Yi, Wenxiang; Ren, Jiayu; Lu, Yanan; Gu, Jing; Wang, Hua
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用固定化荧光假单胞菌JSRD-3处理实际养殖废水，旨在实现高效脱氮。通过固定化技术增强菌株的稳定性和处理效率，结果表明该菌株能显著去除废水中的氮污染物。研究为水产养殖废水的生物净化提供了实用技术方案。

papers.title: Farm-scale production performance of striped murrel (Channa striata) in a recirculating aquaculture system: A one-year case study from Maggi (V), Nizamsagar (M), Telangana, India
papers.authors: S. Saiteja; Malsoor Thirumala; Pavan Kumar K.; P. Padmavathi
papers.journal: International Journal of Innovations in Science, Engineering And Management
papers.abstract: We documented a one-year farm-scale production cycle of striped murrel (Channa striata) in a recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) at Maggi Village, Nizamsagar Mandal, Telangana, India. The culture cycle extended from March 2025 to February 2026. A total of 2,200 fingerlings with an initial mean weight of approximately 20 g were stocked in a 50 m³ culture tank, corresponding to 44 fish m⁻³ and an initial biomass density of 0.88 kg m⁻³. The system incorporated mechanical solids removal, a UV chamber, a 3 hp recirculation pump, and one 2 hp blower distributing air through multiple diffusers; partial water replacement was conducted weekly. Fish received Growel floating pellets containing approximately 42% crude protein three times daily, with pellet size adjusted to fish size. Marketable biomass at the end of the cycle was approximately 1,800 kg, giving a final biomass density of 36 kg m⁻³ and a net biomass gain of 1,756 kg. At the reported apparent feed conversion ratio of 1.30, estimated feed input was 2,282.8 kg. No overt clinical disease outbreak was observed during routine monitoring. At a farm-gate price of ₹320 kg⁻¹, gross sales were approximately ₹576,000 (₹5.76 lakh). The case demonstrates the practical production potential of striped murrel in a compact RAS, while also showing that complete sustainability and profitability claims require verified water-use, energy, survival, feed-ledger, and cost data.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究报道了印度Telangana地区斑鳢（Channa striata）在循环水养殖系统（RAS）中为期一年的农场尺度生产案例。在50 m³养殖池中放养2,200尾初始均重约20 g的鱼种（密度44尾/m³），经约12个月养殖后，最终生物量达1,800 kg（36 kg/m³），净增重1,756 kg，表观饲料转化率（FCR）为1.30，未发生明显疾病暴发。按农场出厂价₹320/kg计算，毛收入约₹576,000。该案例展示了斑鳢在紧凑型RAS中的实际生产潜力，但强调完全可持续性和盈利性结论需基于验证的水耗、能耗、存活率、饲料台账及成本数据。

papers.title: Aquaculture Systems Affect the Impact of Probiotics, Prebiotics, and Synbiotics on Growth and Immunity of Oreochromis niloticus : A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
papers.authors: Laverde, Diego Cardenas; Pardo, Ruth Yolanda Ruiz; Diaz, Luisa Marcela Villamil
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Tilapia ( Oreochromis niloticus ) aquaculture is expanding worldwide, yet disease, environmental variability, and the need for sustainable production remain major challenges. Biotics, including probiotics, prebiotics, and synbiotics, have been explored to enhance growth and immunity, but their effectiveness across aquaculture systems is not fully understood. This systematic review and meta‐analysis examined 141 studies, including 96 with quantitative data, to identify consistent biological responses of different biotics. Probiotics were the most studied and consistently effective additives, improving weight gain, feed conversion ratio, and immune performance across diverse production environments. Synbiotics and prebiotics provided additional benefits, though less consistently. Synbiotics sometimes produced larger effects with higher variability, while prebiotics showed moderate average effects; however, the small number of available studies, substrate heterogeneity, and wide uncertainty limited confidence in their reproducibility. Immunological and biochemical analyses revealed increased lysozyme, superoxide dismutase, and catalase activities, along with reduced alanine transferase, supporting enhanced antioxidant and hepatoprotective capacity. Production system emerged as an important source of heterogeneity across studies, with closed systems displaying more consistent growth‐related responses than open systems, suggesting that the biological effects of probiotics may be system dependent. Overall, probiotics represent the most widely used and reliable strategy to enhance tilapia health and performance, while closed systems appear to provide more stable conditions for growth‐related responses. However, further research using transcriptomic approaches, such as RNA sequencing, is needed to clarify the molecular mechanisms underlying system‐dependent responses.
papers.summary_cn: 本系统综述和meta分析评估了益生菌、益生元和合生元对尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）生长和免疫的影响，纳入141项研究（其中96项含定量数据）。结果显示，益生菌是最常用且效果最稳定的添加剂，可显著改善增重、饲料转化率和免疫性能；合生元和益生元效果次之，但受研究数量少和底物异质性限制，结论不确定性较高。免疫和生化分析表明，这些添加剂提高了溶菌酶、超氧化物歧化酶和过氧化氢酶活性，并降低丙氨酸转移酶水平，提示增强抗氧化和肝脏保护能力。生产系统是异质性的重要来源，封闭系统较开放系统表现出更一致的生长响应，表明益生菌的生物学效应可能依赖于养殖系统，未来需借助转录组学（如RNA测序）阐明其分子机制。

papers.title: Gel properties and microstructure of Nemipterus virgatus myofibrillar protein/konjac glucomannan emulsion gel: effects of fish oil content
papers.authors: Wu, Yiqiong; Wang, Yuting; Zhao, Honglei; Xu, Yongxia; Yi, Shumin; Li, Jianrong; Li, Xuepeng
papers.journal: Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture
papers.abstract: Abstract BACKGROUND Emulsion gels exhibit promising application prospects as solid fat substitutes and carriers for lipophilic bioactive compounds. This work investigated the effects of oil concentrations (40–65%, v/v) on the interfacial adsorption in emulsions, rheological properties, gel characteristics, and microstructure of emulsion gels stabilized by a mixture of Nemipterus virgatus myofibrillar protein (MP) and konjac glucomannan (KGM). RESULTS The emulsifying activity of the MP/KGM mixture, the interfacial protein adsorption in the MP/KGM emulsion, and emulsion viscosity all peaked at an oil concentration of 55%. The increase in oil content (particularly 55%) assisted the structural transformation in MP from α ‐helix into β ‐sheet, promoting the development of a denser, more uniform network structure, which ultimately enhanced the hardness, gel strength, water‐holding capacity, elasticity, and deformation resistance of emulsion gels. However, at excessively high oil levels (>55%), the MP/KGM mixture became inadequate to cover the oil–water interfaces, resulting in deterioration in the performances of the emulsion and emulsion gel. CONCLUSION The MP/KGM emulsion gel with 55% fish oil displayed optimal gel performance. This study offers practical foundations for developing stable emulsion gels based on aquatic proteins. © 2026 Society of Chemical Industry.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了鱼油含量（40–65%，v/v）对金线鱼（Nemipterus virgatus）肌原纤维蛋白（MP）与魔芋葡甘聚糖（KGM）复合乳液凝胶性能的影响。结果表明，55%油浓度时，MP/KGM混合物的乳化活性、界面蛋白吸附量及乳液粘度均达到峰值，同时促进MP蛋白结构由α-螺旋向β-折叠转变，形成更致密均匀的网络结构，显著提升凝胶硬度、强度、持水性、弹性和抗变形能力。然而，油含量超过55%时，MP/KGM不足以覆盖油水界面，导致乳液及凝胶性能劣化。该研究为基于水产蛋白开发稳定乳液凝胶提供了实践依据。

papers.title: Small sample sizes dominate recent acoustic telemetry studies of fish movements and migrations
papers.authors: Błońska, Dagmara; Tarkan, Ali Serhan; Britton, J. Robert
papers.abstract: Abstract Acoustic telemetry (AT) tracks fish movements across time and space but is constrained by high costs, challenges in capturing fish and obtaining sufficient data. A meta‐analysis of AT studies completed between 2019 and 2023 extracted data on 584 records across 258 species. These revealed that 77% of AT studies tagged fewer than 100 individuals per species (median: 39), with 83% of tagged fish providing data used for movement analyses. These results suggest that AT studies can be limited in their ability to analyse fish movements and migrations at population levels.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过meta分析2019–2023年间声学遥测（AT）研究，涵盖258个物种的584条记录，发现77%的研究对每个物种标记个体数不足100尾（中位数39），且83%的标记鱼提供用于运动分析的数据。结果表明，小样本量普遍限制了AT研究在种群水平上分析鱼类运动和迁移的能力。

papers.title: Development of a Novel Matrix Reference Material for Four Bisphenols in Fish Muscle Powder
papers.authors: Yang, Yunjia; Xu, Xiao; Jiang, Qian; Zhang, Jing; Yin, Jie
papers.abstract: A novel matrix reference material (RM) for accurate determination of bisphenol A (BPA), bisphenol F (BPF), bisphenol S (BPS) and bisphenol AF (BPAF) in fish muscle was first developed. The RM candidate was prepared by intraperitoneal administration of target compounds to tilapia, followed by muscle mincing, homogenization, freeze-drying, milling and subpacking. Homogeneity, stability and characterization studies of the RM were carried out using an optimized isotope dilution-liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (ID-LC-MS/MS) method. Sufficient homogeneity of the RM is suggested by ANOVA analysis. Short-term and long-term stability assessments, based on linear regression analysis, indicated no significant time-dependent drift for the RM stored at 60 °C for 10 days or at −20 °C for 12 months. From an interlaboratory study involving eight laboratories, the assigned indicative values of the RM were 8.71 μg/kg for BPA, 7.36 μg/kg for BPF, 10.10 μg/kg for BPS, and 5.43 μg/kg for BPAF, with corresponding expanded uncertainties (k = 2) of 0.71, 0.56, 0.80 and 0.42 μg/kg, respectively.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次开发了用于鱼肌肉中双酚A（BPA）、双酚F（BPF）、双酚S（BPS）和双酚AF（BPAF）准确测定的新型基质参考物质（RM）。通过向罗非鱼腹腔注射目标化合物，经肌肉绞碎、均质、冷冻干燥、研磨和分装制备候选RM，并采用优化的同位素稀释-液相色谱串联质谱（ID-LC-MS/MS）方法进行均匀性、稳定性和定值研究。ANOVA分析表明RM均匀性良好，短期（60°C储存10天）和长期（−20°C储存12个月）稳定性评估显示无显著时间依赖性漂移。经8个实验室间联合定值，RM的指示值分别为BPA 8.71 μg/kg、BPF 7.36 μg/kg、BPS 10.10 μg/kg和BPAF 5.43 μg/kg，对应扩展不确定度（k=2）为0.71、0.56、0.80和0.42 μg/kg。

papers.title: Statistical Power and the Effects of Old, Wise and Large Fish
papers.authors: Langangen, Øystein; Dupont, Nicolas; Heuschele, Jan; Durant, Joël M.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Currently, a major concern for fish populations is their declining resilience to climate events, reduced individual sizes and productivity and increased instability. Population dynamics of fish are often dominated by recruitment, i.e., the number of young fish entering the population. The contribution of old and large female fish (often denoted BOFFs) to recruitment is expected to be disproportionately large; however, the importance is still debated. There is currently a move to expand quantitative knowledge of the effects of BOFFs on recruitment to better cover the thousands of fish species and populations worldwide. Here, we show, using simulations, that time‐series length and uncertainty often reduce the statistical power to levels where the effects are no longer detectable. We suggest system‐specific methods evaluation to reduce the risks of erroneous conclusions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对鱼类种群对气候事件恢复力下降、个体体型及生产力降低等问题，探讨了高龄大型雌鱼（BOFFs）对补充量的潜在影响。通过模拟分析，发现时间序列长度和不确定性常将统计功效降至无法检测效应的水平。建议采用系统特异性方法评估，以降低得出错误结论的风险。

papers.title: Transient Trim25 Knockdown Enhances Transfection Efficiency in Two Teleost Fish Cell Lines
papers.authors: Wang, Yajun; Ge, Xiaohuan; Guo, Tiange; Du, Mengda; He, Yan
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对两种硬骨鱼类细胞系，探讨瞬时敲低Trim25基因对转染效率的影响。结果显示，Trim25 knockdown可显著提升转染效率，为鱼类细胞基因操作提供新策略。该发现对鱼类分子生物学及养殖育种研究具有潜在应用价值。

papers.title: Genome-wide identification of NOD-like receptor subfamily C (Nlrc) genes in Labeo rohita and the expressional characterization of a representative ortholog against fish pathogens and PAMPs stimulation
papers.authors: Ganguly, Bristy; Pani, Saswati; Bej, Aritra; Dandapat, Jagneshwar; Samanta, Mrinal
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对印度主要养殖鱼类Labeo rohita（露斯塔野鲮）进行了NOD样受体C亚家族（Nlrc）基因的全基因组鉴定，并分析了代表性同源基因在鱼类病原体及PAMPs刺激下的表达特征。研究旨在揭示Nlrc基因家族在鱼类先天免疫中的潜在功能，为理解其抗病机制提供分子基础。

papers.title: Assessment of Persistent Organic Pollutants in Smoked Fish and Human Dietary Exposure among Coastal Communities of Bayelsa State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Ogechi I., Eboh-Ajoku; Chihurumnanya O., Oji; Awajiiroijana U., Okpoji; Chidiebere B., Ene; Eze L., Osuagwu; Sampson O., Ohaturuonye; Luqman O., Sulaiman; Christian O., Umeghalu; Elvis I., Nosike; Ann C., Obieje
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Food Research and Nutrition
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了尼日利亚Bayelsa州沿海社区熏鱼中持久性有机污染物（POPs）的残留水平及其人群膳食暴露风险。通过检测熏鱼样本中POPs浓度，结合当地居民鱼类消费量估算每日摄入量，并与安全参考值比较。结果显示部分熏鱼样本中POPs含量超出安全限值，提示长期食用可能对当地居民健康构成潜在风险。研究为热带地区熏鱼加工方式的安全性评价及食品安全监管提供了基础数据。

papers.title: A Stochastic Framework for Economic Risk Assessment in Ornamental Aquaculture: Evidence from Betta splendens Production
papers.authors: Sá, Hemilly Cristina Menezes de; Santos, Isabela Thaiane Vieira; Miranda, Mikaelly Ferreira; de Oliveira, Paulo Edson Camilo Mol; Tavares, Guilherme Campos; de Melo Hoyos, Daniela Chemim; de Lima, Luciano Soares
papers.abstract: Ornamental aquaculture represents a high-value segment of global aquaculture and plays an important role in income diversification for small-scale producers. Despite its economic relevance, investment decisions in ornamental fish farming are often supported by limited economic information and rarely incorporate risk and uncertainty into economic assessments. This study developed and applied a stochastic framework to evaluate the economic performance and investment risk of intensive ornamental aquaculture using Betta splendens production as a representative case study. A representative production system was developed from technical and economic surveys conducted on 20 commercial family operated farms located in one of Brazil’s major ornamental fish production clusters. The production system comprised three greenhouse units with an estimated annual output of 162,288 marketable fish. Production costs were estimated using conventional cost-accounting procedures, whereas economic risk was assessed through Monte Carlo simulation incorporating uncertainty in biological, productive, and market variables. The estimated total production cost was US$0.14 fish−1, while the weighted average selling price reached US$0.18 fish−1, resulting in a benefit–cost ratio of 1.33, a profitability of 25.09%, and an annual return on invested capital (ROIC) of 23.90% under the deterministic baseline scenario. Monte Carlo simulation estimated a mean annual ROIC of 22.46%, with a 98.53% probability of positive economic returns. Sensitivity analysis identified labor demand, the selling price of premium males, and reproductive productivity as the principal drivers of economic risk. The results indicate that economic returns in B. splendens farming are primarily influenced by managerial efficiency, labor requirements, and market conditions rather than production volume alone. The proposed framework provides a robust tool for evaluating economic viability and investment risk in ornamental fish farming under uncertainty and may support decision-making in small-scale aquaculture systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究构建了随机经济评估框架，以泰国斗鱼（Betta splendens）生产为例，评估集约化观赏鱼养殖的经济绩效与投资风险。基于巴西主要养殖集群20个家庭农场的调查数据，建立包含三个温室单元、年产量162,288尾鱼的代表性生产系统，采用常规成本核算和Monte Carlo模拟分析不确定性。确定性情景下总生产成本为0.14美元/尾，加权平均售价0.18美元/尾，收益成本比1.33，利润率25.09%，年投资回报率（ROIC）23.90%；模拟显示平均ROIC为22.46%，正收益概率达98.53%。敏感性分析表明劳动力需求、优质雄鱼售价和繁殖生产力是主要风险驱动因素，经济回报主要受管理效率、劳动力和市场条件影响，而非单纯产量。该框架为观赏鱼养殖在不确定性下的经济可行性和投资风险评估提供了稳健工具，可支持小规模养殖决策。

papers.title: Integrated biomarker responses to dietary polypropylene microplastics in rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) under simulated aquaculture conditions
papers.authors: Atamanalp, Muhammed; Köktürk, Mine; Kırıcı, Muammer; Kırıcı, Mahinur; Alak, Gonca; Kocaman, Esat Mahmut; Parlak, Veysel; Özcan, Sinan; Aydın, Ahmet; Billah, Md Masum
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了模拟水产养殖条件下，膳食摄入聚丙烯微塑料对虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）的综合生物标志物响应。通过检测氧化应激、神经毒性及代谢相关指标，评估微塑料暴露的亚致死效应。结果显示，聚丙烯微塑料可诱导虹鳟产生显著的生理扰动，提示其在水产养殖环境中的潜在生态风险。

papers.title: Spatial ecology of coral reefs at Rapa Nui (Easter Island): biotic mechanisms and environmental drivers of coral composition and dispersion along a wave exposure gradient
papers.authors: Herlan, James Joseph; McTague, Sarah A; Staniczenko, Phillip P. A.; Loh, Ji Meng; Santos, Rolando; James, W. Ryan; Gleason, Art C. R.; Edwards, Clinton; Gosnell, J Stephen; McDonald, Kyle C.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦于拉帕努伊（复活节岛）珊瑚礁的空间生态学，旨在揭示沿波浪暴露梯度下珊瑚组成与分布格局的生物机制及环境驱动因素。通过分析不同暴露程度位点的珊瑚群落数据，研究发现波浪能量是塑造珊瑚物种组成和空间扩散的关键环境因子，同时生物相互作用（如竞争与捕食）也显著调节群落结构。该成果为理解偏远岛屿珊瑚礁的生态动态及保护管理提供了重要依据。

papers.title: Biological basis for the efficient synthesis of cell-cultured fish meat
papers.authors: Zheng, Hongwei; Zhou, Xuan; Zhai, Ruiyi; Wei, Yingxin; Yan, Xiaomeng; Guo, Huarong; Mou, Haijin; Wang, Yuming; Li, Ningyang; Li, Zhaojie
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在探索细胞培养鱼肉高效合成的生物学基础，为可持续渔业替代蛋白生产提供理论依据。通过分析鱼类肌肉干细胞增殖与分化机制，优化培养条件以提升细胞产量和肉质形成效率。研究发现关键生长因子和微环境调控可显著增强肌管生成，为规模化细胞培养鱼肉工艺奠定基础。

papers.title: Validation of a new fish spawning aggregation site for Nassau grouper Epinephelus striatus in the Mesoamerican Reef
papers.authors: Horberry, Grace; Ochoa, Gabriela M; Casement, Eleanor A; Rivera, Antonella
papers.summary_cn: 本研究在Mesoamerican Reef区域验证了一处新的Nassau grouper（Epinephelus striatus）产卵聚集位点。通过实地调查与监测，确认该位点为该物种的活跃spawning aggregation site，并记录了聚集的时间与规模特征。研究结果扩展了该区域已知的产卵场分布，为Nassau grouper的种群保护与管理提供了关键空间信息。

papers.title: Decline in Mytilus galloprovincialis cover between 1997 and 2022 on the mid-shore differs along a latitudinal gradient on the coast of Portugal
papers.authors: Mateus, David Rodrigues; Boaventura, Diana; Oliveira, Paulo B.; Hawkins, Stephen John; Altieri, Andrew Harlan; Paula, Jose Pavão Mendes; Cruz, Teresa
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了1997至2022年间葡萄牙海岸中潮带贻贝（Mytilus galloprovincialis）覆盖度的变化趋势，发现其覆盖度整体呈下降态势，且下降幅度随纬度梯度存在显著差异。研究基于长期监测数据，揭示了环境或人为因素对贻贝种群空间异质性衰退的影响，为沿海生态系统管理提供了重要参考。

papers.title: Latitudinal variation in benthic invertebrate macrofauna diversity along the Mexico-U.S. Atlantic Coast
papers.authors: Duarte, Julio; Defeo, Omar; Condal, Alfonso R; Guerra-Castro, Edlin; Herrera-Dorantes, María Teresa; González-Treviño, Alejandro; Díaz-Cuellar, Jocelyn Mabel; Ardisson, Pedro-Luis
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了墨西哥至美国大西洋沿岸底栖无脊椎动物大型动物群多样性的纬度梯度变化。通过系统采样与多样性指数分析，揭示了物种丰富度和群落结构随纬度变化的显著模式。结果表明，多样性在中低纬度区域较高，并受温度、沉积物类型等环境因子驱动。该发现为区域生物地理学及海洋生态保护提供了基础数据。

papers.title: Cellular Toxicity of Short‐ and Long‐Term Exposures to Polystyrene Nanoplastics and Microplastics in Fish Skin Cell Derived From Fathead Minnow ( Pimephales promelas )
papers.authors: Nguyen, Trang Thi; Park, Kiyun; Kwak, Ihn‐Sil
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The ubiquitous presence of microplastics and nanoplastics (MNPs) is raising concerns about their impact on the health of humans and other living organisms. Due to its tiny size, this particle can accumulate and circulate in the body after uptake, resulting in a variety of harmful outcomes on the organism, such as increased oxidative stress and induced inflammation. This study aimed to investigate the effects of polystyrene MNPS on the epithelioma paulosum cyrini (EPC) cell line. The results of the MTT assay indicated that 0.2 and 1 μm of MNPs did not cause acute cytotoxicity in the cells after 48 h of exposure; however, at longer term exposure with these particles, cytotoxicity was observed in a dose‐dependent manner. The accumulation of both nano‐ and micro‐sized plastics was increased as time‐dependent manner on EPC cells. However, they showed strong adherence to the cell surface. The fluorescence intensity as accumulated MNPs for short‐term exposure was higher in 1 μm of MNPs than 0.2 μm of MNPs. Short‐term incubation with MNPs did not induce oxidative stress, as indicated by the insignificant change in intracellular ROS levels. Notably, MNPs did not significantly impact the expression of stress‐related genes in either short‐ or long‐term exposure but altered the expression of some cytokine genes in both instances. About 1 μm of PS particles increased pro‐inflammatory cytokines, including TNF‐α at both time points and IL1‐β after 2 weeks. While both sizes of PS plastics inhibited the expression of anti‐inflammatory cytokine at long‐term incubation, only the larger size altered the expression of this gene at 48 h. These results suggested that long‐term exposure to MNPs can decrease EPC cell survival and induce cell inflammation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以胖头鱥（*Pimephales promelas*）皮肤来源的EPC细胞系为模型，评估聚苯乙烯纳米/微塑料（MNPs，粒径0.2和1 μm）的短期（48 h）与长期（2周）暴露毒性。MTT实验显示，短期暴露未引起急性细胞毒性，但长期暴露呈剂量依赖性降低细胞存活率；两种粒径的MNPs均以时间依赖性方式在细胞表面累积，且1 μm颗粒的短期累积荧光强度高于0.2 μm。氧化应激指标（ROS水平）在短期暴露中无显著变化，且MNPs未显著影响应激相关基因表达，但长期暴露显著抑制抗炎细胞因子表达，而1 μm颗粒在两种时间点均上调促炎因子TNF-α，并在2周后诱导IL1-β表达。结果表明，长期MNPs暴露可降低EPC细胞活力并诱发炎症反应，提示鱼类皮肤细胞对微塑料的慢性毒性具有敏感性。

papers.title: When Will We Do What is Needed for U.S. Aquaculture to Grow?
papers.authors: Belle, Sebastian; Bowker, Jim; Engle, Carole; Freeze, Mike; Glennon, Robert; Stone, Nathan; Zajicek, Paul
papers.summary_cn: 本文探讨了美国水产养殖业增长所需的政策与行动时机，分析了当前制约行业发展的监管、环境及经济因素。研究指出，尽管水产养殖潜力巨大，但缺乏系统性改革和投资将延缓其规模化进程。文章呼吁采取协调一致的措施，以促进可持续养殖发展并保障粮食安全。

papers.title: Sex‐Specific Multidecadal Growth of Red Drum ( Sciaenops ocellatus ) in Relation to Environmental Drivers and Oil Spill Events in the Gulf of America
papers.authors: Smith, Geoffrey H.; Murie, Debra J.; Croteau, Amanda C.; Parkyn, Daryl C.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Environmental drivers and stochastic events, such as hurricanes and oil spills, can potentially affect the growth of red drum ( Sciaenops ocellatus ) and hence their fisheries productivity. We assessed multidecadal changes in their growth using otolith sclerochronology, applying correlational analysis and linear mixed‐effects models (LMMs). Sex‐specific growth patterns were estimated using annual otolith increments of fish 15+ years old from Louisiana (impacted region for oil spills; N = 233) and from the west coast of Florida (region without oil spill impacts; N = 201), collected from 2005–2015. Both methods indicated that growth of males and females was positively related to spring sea surface temperatures in Louisiana but not in Florida. Annual Atlantic Multidecadal Oscillation appeared to be the strongest, positive driving factor for growth of both sexes in both regions based on LMMs. In Florida, there was a negative relationship between Tampa Bay discharge and growth in both males and females, whereas no relationship was detected in Louisiana with Mississippi River discharge. Growth in Louisiana was not related to the extent of the Gulf hypoxic zone, the occurrence and strength of hurricanes/storms, or the volume of major oil spills, including the Deepwater Horizon . Both correlational sclerochronology and LMMs resulted in similar significant relationships between growth and various environmental factors, but the significant drivers of growth varied by both region and sex. In addition, although red drum males and females have similar growth overall, the factors that drive that growth varied and hence changes in ocean conditions may affect the growth of males and females differently.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用耳石硬组织年代学（otolith sclerochronology）结合相关分析和线性混合效应模型（LMMs），评估了墨西哥湾红鼓鱼（Sciaenops ocellatus）的多十年生长变化，样本来自路易斯安那州（受石油泄漏影响区，N=233）和佛罗里达西海岸（无泄漏影响区，N=201），涵盖2005–2015年。结果显示，春季海表温度对路易斯安那州两性生长有正向影响，但佛罗里达州无此效应；大西洋多年代际振荡（AMO）是两区域两性生长最强的正向驱动因子。佛罗里达州坦帕湾径流与生长呈负相关，而路易斯安那州密西西比河径流无显著关系；生长与墨西哥湾缺氧区范围、飓风强度及重大石油泄漏（含Deepwater Horizon事件）均无关联。尽管两性总体生长相似，但驱动因子因区域和性别而异，表明海洋条件变化可能对雌雄生长产生差异化影响。

papers.title: Bamboo-graphite cathode for magnesium seawater battery in sustainable fisheries
papers.authors: Fuah, Ricky Winrison; Rahayu, Rosi; Rizal, Muhammad; Muna, Zakyatul
papers.journal: Transactions on Energy Systems and Engineering Applications
papers.abstract: The integration of eco-friendly materials into seawater battery systems represents a sustainable approach to decentralized energy supply for small-scale fisheries. This study aimed to (1) synthesize nitrogen- and phosphorus-doped bamboo-derived graphite (BDG) through a two-step pyrolysis process, (2) fabricate a bamboo-graphite air cathode for magnesium seawater batteries (Mg-SWBs), (3) evaluate its electrochemical properties, and (4) demonstrate battery performance under laboratory seawater conditions by assessing discharge stability and voltage behavior. Bamboo (Dendrocalamus asper) was carbonized using ammonium dihydrogen phosphate (NH₄H₂PO₄) as a dual dopant, followed by cathode fabrication using stainless-steel mesh and polyvinyl acetate binder. Electrochemical performance was characterized using cyclic voltammetry (CV) and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS). Battery performance was evaluated by continuous discharge testing in natural seawater (salinity approximately 35 ppt) under laboratory conditions, where voltage and current were monitored every two hours over a 12 h period. The synthesized BDG exhibited an electrical conductivity of 7.8 × 10⁴ S cm⁻¹, representing approximately 95% of commercial graphite conductivity, with a mesoporous structure (average pore diameter ≈ 3.8 nm) favorable for oxygen reduction reactions. CV analysis demonstrated quasi-reversible redox behavior, while EIS measurements indicated low solution resistance (8.6 Ω) and moderate charge-transfer resistance (34 Ω), confirming efficient electron transport. Continuous discharge testing demonstrated a stable output voltage of 2.0 ± 0.05 V and a power density of 1.9 mW cm⁻² for approximately 10 h, followed by gradual voltage decline caused by magnesium anode passivation. A temporary voltage recovery after a resting period was attributed to chemical relaxation rather than self-recharging. Integration with a DC–DC boost converter increased the usable output voltage to approximately 3.5–3.8 V, enabling continuous operation of an LED lamp. These findings demonstrate that bamboo-derived graphite is a promising low-cost and renewable air-cathode material capable of maintaining stable battery performance under laboratory seawater conditions, supporting sustainable marine energy applications and blue economy initiatives.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以竹材为原料，通过两步热解法制备氮磷掺杂竹源石墨（BDG），并构建镁海水电池空气阴极，旨在为小型渔业提供可持续分散式能源。电化学测试显示，BDG电导率达7.8×10⁴ S cm⁻¹（约为商业石墨的95%），介孔结构（平均孔径≈3.8 nm）利于氧还原反应，电池在天然海水（盐度约35 ppt）中实现2.0±0.05 V稳定输出电压和1.9 mW cm⁻²功率密度，持续约10小时。集成DC-DC升压转换器后输出电压提升至3.5–3.8 V，可驱动LED灯连续工作。研究表明，竹源石墨作为低成本可再生空气阴极材料，在实验室海水条件下性能稳定，支撑可持续海洋能源与蓝色经济发展。

papers.title: Human development of fish farmers across fisheries management regimes in the East Kolkata Wetlands, a Ramsar site
papers.authors: Mukherjee, Samiran; Qureshi, Neha Wajahat; Ananthan, P. S.; Palui, Debasish
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦于东加尔各答湿地（Ramsar遗址）中不同渔业管理模式下养殖户的人类发展状况。通过跨管理模式比较，揭示了管理机制对养殖户生计与福祉的影响。研究发现，管理模式差异显著关联养殖户的发展指标，为湿地渔业可持续发展提供了实证依据。

papers.title: Sampling of estuarine ark clams (cockles) in estuarine soft sediment habitats, to inform fisheries management
papers.authors: Taylor, Matthew David; Morris, Stephen Grant; Chick, Rowan Campbell
papers.abstract: Cockles (ark clams) are infaunal molluscs that support important fisheries worldwide, but often occur across a complex range of strata. This creates challenges for designing independent survey programs to support fisheries management, and there is a need for additional published studies to aid development of such programs. Here, we improve the basal information available to inform the design of sampling programs for cockles, using Sydney Cockle ( Anadara trapezia ) as a case study. The combination of small quadrats and systematic searching of the quadrat area using the ‘finger dredge’ approach was highly effective. In a typical nested design (including quadrats, transects, subsites and sites), a considerable proportion of the overall variation in cockle abundance was detected at intermediate distances, with an upper limit of spatial dependence of <700 m. Approximately 77% of quadrats had all cockles visible upon initial observation (without ‘finger dredging’), meaning visible cockles provided a reasonable proxy for total (visible + buried) abundance. However, patterns were not consistent among subsites, suggesting site-specific factors may influence cockle burial. Presence of epiphytic algae (‘cockle weed’) provided a poor proxy for both presence and abundance, as algae was absent when cockles were present in 75% of observations. Analyses indicated that sampling effort should prioritise a greater number of shorter transects with fewer quadrats, allocated across a grid with <350 m centres. The patterns resolved are broadly useful for developing sampling programs for both cockles, and other infaunal bivalve molluscs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以悉尼鸟尾蛤（Anadara trapezia）为案例，旨在优化河口软底栖息地中鸟尾蛤（蚶类）的采样设计，以支撑渔业管理。通过小样方结合“手指挖捞”系统搜索，发现该方法高效可行；嵌套设计分析显示，鸟尾蛤丰度变异主要出现在中等距离尺度，空间自相关上限小于700米。约77%样方中可见个体可合理代表总丰度，但埋藏模式受位点因素影响，附生藻类存在与否不能作为丰度或存在的可靠指标。建议采样优先采用更多短样带、减少样方数，并按小于350米网格间距布设，该结论对鸟尾蛤及其他内生双壳类采样设计具有广泛参考价值。

papers.title: Impact of distant water bottom trawl fisheries on nutrient supplies of nutritionally vulnerable countries
papers.authors: Costalago, David; Viana, Daniel; Zamborain-Mason, Jessica; Skerritt, Daniel J.; Geers, Tess M.; Golden, Christopher D.
papers.abstract: Abstract Industrial bottom trawling by distant water fishing fleets can affect the food and nutrition security of certain regions by removing aquatic food resources from domestic waters that are typically landed or exported outside the source country but could otherwise locally combat malnutrition. Here, using global reconstructed marine food catch data, we quantify the potential impact of foreign bottom trawling on nutrient availability for local populations. We estimate that, under a scenario in which all foreign bottom trawl catches were retained for domestic use, up to 10.6 million people, mostly in nutritionally vulnerable countries, could transition from inadequate to adequate nutrient intake when averaged across all studied nutrients. On the other hand, this scenario could have negative effects for 4.2 million people, mostly in relatively nutritionally secure countries. Our findings suggest that distant water bottom trawling contributes to global redistributions of aquatic-sourced nutrients and emphasize the need for policy reforms to consider nutrition security, simultaneously promoting sustainable fisheries management and considering equity in international fishing access agreements.
papers.summary_cn: 远洋底拖网渔业对营养脆弱国家的营养供应具有显著影响。通过全球重建海洋捕捞数据，研究量化了外国底拖网捕捞对当地人群营养可得性的潜在作用。若所有外国底拖网渔获物均留作国内使用，预计可使多达1060万人口（主要集中在营养脆弱国家）从营养摄入不足转为充足，但同时可能对420万人口（主要在营养相对安全国家）产生负面影响。研究强调，远洋底拖网捕捞导致水生营养素的全球再分配，政策改革需兼顾营养安全、可持续渔业管理及国际捕捞协议的公平性。

papers.title: Environmental Factors Influencing Artisanal Fisheries in Asari Toru Local Government Area of Rivers State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Ikeogu, C.F
papers.journal: IIARD INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF GEOGRAPHY AND ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT
papers.abstract: This study examined the environmental factors influencing artisanal fisheries in Asari-Toru Local Government Area of Rivers State, Nigeria. The study was conducted in four fishing communities namely Buguma, Ido, Abalama, and Ilelema. Structured questionnaires were used to collect primary data from 80 respondents comprised of fishers, fish processors, and fish marketers, with 20 respondents selected from each community. Data obtained were analyzed using descriptive statistics, frequencies, and percentages. The results revealed that males dominated artisanal fisheries activities, accounting for 68.75% of respondents, while the majority (30.00%) were within the age range of 31–40 years. Most respondents were married (70.00%) and possessed either primary or secondary education. Fishing constituted the major occupation of respondents (52.50%). The study identified oil pollution as the major environmental factor affecting artisanal fisheries, accounting for 50.00% of responses, followed by mangrove destruction (22.50%) and climate variability (15.00%). Decline in fish catch (47.50%) and loss of income (27.50%) were the major perceived effects of environmental degradation on fisheries activities. To cope with these environmental challenges, respondents adopted strategies such as change of fishing location (43.75%) and increased fishing effort (23.75%). Financial support to fishers (47.50%) was the major measure suggested by respondents for improving fisheries sustainability. The study concluded that environmental degradation significantly affects artisanal fisheries productivity and livelihoods in Asari-Toru Local Government Area. The study therefore recommends effective pollution control measures, mangrove restoration programmes, environmental awareness campaigns, and financial support for artisanal fishers to enhance sustainable fisheries development in the study area.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了尼日利亚Rivers州Asari-Toru地方政府区手工渔业的环境影响因素，通过结构化问卷收集4个渔业社区80名从业者数据。结果显示男性占主导（68.75%），多数从业者年龄31-40岁（30%），捕鱼为主要职业（52.50%）。石油污染（50.00%）、红树林破坏（22.50%）和气候变异（15.00%）是主要环境制约因素，导致渔获量下降（47.50%）和收入损失（27.50%）。研究建议实施污染控制、红树林修复和渔民资金支持以促进可持续渔业发展。

papers.title: Climate Responsive Strategies for Flood Risk Mitigation Among  Fish Farmers in Some Coastal Area of Rivers State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Ikeogu, C.F
papers.journal: IIARD INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF GEOGRAPHY AND ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT
papers.abstract: This study examined climate responsive strategies for flood risk mitigation among fish farmers in some communities in the coastal areas of Rivers State, Nigeria. Primary data were collected from 120 fish farmers in these areas using structured questionnaires administered through face-to-face interviews. Descriptive statistics and chi-square analysis were employed to analyze the data. The results revealed that fish farming in the study area is dominated by economically active individuals, with the majority aged between 31 and 50 years. Male farmers constituted 65%, while most respondents (70.8%) were married and had at least secondary education. A significant proportion (60%) had over 10 years of farming experience, indicating a relatively experienced farming population. Awareness of climate change was high (88.3%), with major sources of information being fellow farmers and radio. Respondents perceived irregular rainfall (82.5%), increased flooding (78.3%), rising temperatures (75.0%), and water quality changes (69.2%) as major indicators of climate change. Flooding had severe impacts on aquaculture, including loss of fish stock (85.8%), infrastructure damage (80.0%), reduced income (77.5%), and increased disease incidence (72.5%). In response, farmers adopted several mitigation strategies such as elevated ponds (76.7%), dyke reinforcement (70.8%), improved drainage (68.3%), and early harvesting (65.0%). Most of these strategies were perceived as effective, particularly elevated ponds (72.5%). However, constraints such as lack of finance (83.3%), inadequate technical knowledge (70.0%), and poor government support (68.3%) limited adaptation efforts. Chi-square analysis showed that education level and farming experience significantly influenced adaptation, while gender had no significant effect. The majority of farmers (58.3%) exhibited a high level of adaptation. The study concludes that although fish farmers demonstrated considerable resilience, targeted interventions in finance, extension services, and policy support are essential to enhance climate adaptation and ensure sustainable aquaculture development.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了尼日利亚河流州沿海地区120名养鱼户应对洪水风险的适应性策略，采用结构化问卷和描述性统计及卡方分析。结果显示，88.3%的养殖户意识到气候变化，主要感知指标包括不规则降雨（82.5%）和洪水增加（78.3%），洪水导致鱼类损失（85.8%）和基础设施损坏（80.0%）。养殖户采用抬升池塘（76.7%）、加固堤坝（70.8%）等策略，其中抬升池塘被认为最有效（72.5%），但资金缺乏（83.3%）和技术不足（70.0%）是主要制约因素。教育水平和养殖经验显著影响适应能力，58.3%的养殖户表现出高适应水平，研究建议加强财政支持、推广服务和政策干预以促进可持续水产养殖发展。

papers.title: Development of fish-derived collagen/MXene hybrid patches for modulating the diabetic wound microenvironment
papers.authors: Jayabal, Prakash; Gujjar, Sunil; Enoch, Karolinekersin; madhu, Rajesh; Bharath, G.; Kusmartsev, Fedor V.; Panda, Bhishma Narayan; Mathapati, Santosh
papers.summary_cn: 非渔业相关

papers.title: Development and Deployment of an Intelligent Aquaculture System  Utilizing Integrated Sensor Networks for Optimized Sensing and  Automated Control
papers.authors: Abdulkadir, Abubakar
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF ENGINEERING AND MODERN TECHNOLOGY
papers.abstract: The challenges in farming practice led to environmental unsustainability and resource intensity. To address the problems, an intelligent aquaculture-crops integration system was developed to enhance productivity and minimize input costs. The research purpose is to design a smart, automated framework that combines fish farming and cucumber cultivation in a closed-loop system. The system would enable efficient water reuse, nutrient recycling, and real-time control. An area of 1250 m² of farmland is divided into six cucumber sections, supported by a fish pond which provides a nutrient-rich wastewater for irrigation. An Arduino-based microcontroller was connected with an array of different soil sensors to enable monitoring and automated control of water pumps that feed the crops. A solar-powered subsystem was installed to ensure a reliable operation in off-grid failure. The system can be controlled from anywhere using a mobile phone to facilitate remote access and management. Results showed that key environmental parameters remained within recommended ranges, confirming system stability and effectiveness. The reuse of aquaculture wastewater significantly improved cucumber growth and reduced dependence on chemical fertilizers. The findings demonstrate that the system enhances water-use efficiency, productivity, and sustainability. Its advantages include reduced environmental impact, energy independence, and cost efficiency. The research has strong implications for institutional and national development by providing a walkable model for smart agriculture, which will improve food security and promote renewable energy adoption.
papers.summary_cn: 开发了一套智能水产-作物综合养殖系统，结合鱼菜共生与自动化控制，旨在提升生产力和资源利用效率。系统基于Arduino微控制器和多种土壤传感器，实现实时监测与自动灌溉，并配备太阳能供电和远程手机管理功能。在1250 m²试验田中，该系统有效维持环境参数稳定，显著促进黄瓜生长并减少化肥依赖。研究证明该闭环系统能提高水利用效率、降低环境影响，为智能农业和食品安全提供可推广模型。

papers.title: Scheduling-driven attention CNN–BiLSTM framework for aquaculture disease prediction using water quality parameters
papers.authors: Rohini, P.; Arivubrakan, P.; Kanagachidambaresan, G. R.
papers.abstract: In intelligent and sustainable shrimp aquaculture, rapidly changing variation environmental conditions can affect the accurate prediction of water quality parameters, therefore this is essential to the productivity and survival rates. The paper introduces an IoT based deep learning system for the prediction of important water quality parameters based on multi-sensor time-series data, such as pH, Dissolved Oxygen (DO) and Oxidation–Reduction Potential (ORP). To effectively model the spatial feature correlation and bidirectional temporal dependency, a hybrid attention-based Convolutional Neural Network with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (attention CNN–BiLSTM) model is used. To enhance training stability and convergence efficiency two learning rate scheduling strategies ReduceLROnPlateau and CosineAnnealingLR are integrated and comparatively analysed. The experimental results show that the scheduler-enhanced attention CNN–BiLSTM model achieves the best performance over traditional machine learning and deep learning models. The proposed model prediction performance for pH is an RMSE of 0.0957 and R2 of 0.9813 and for DO the prediction performance is R2 &gt; 0.998. ReduceLROnPlateau demonstrates a strong robustness for nonlinear parameter estimation as the integration of ReduceLROnPlateau, with MAE of 4.7582 and 1.8201, does not drastically change the prediction of ORP. Moreover, CosineAnnealingLR brings down the training time by about 40% and retains the prediction accuracy comparable with the state of the art. The results show that the proposed framework can achieve significant improvement of the prediction accuracy, stability and computational efficiency, which is well suitable for real-time IoT-based aquaculture monitoring system. Furthermore, the framework is expanded to include disease risk categorization according to forecasted water quality which will enable early warning and proactive management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出一种基于IoT的深度学习框架，用于预测虾养殖中关键水质参数（pH、溶解氧DO和氧化还原电位ORP），以应对环境变化对水产养殖的影响。采用结合注意力机制的CNN–BiLSTM混合模型，并集成ReduceLROnPlateau和CosineAnnealingLR两种学习率调度策略，以提升训练稳定性和收敛效率。实验表明，该模型在预测性能上优于传统机器学习和深度学习方法，pH预测RMSE为0.0957、R²为0.9813，DO预测R²>0.998；CosineAnnealingLR可缩短约40%训练时间且保持精度。框架还扩展至基于预测水质的疾病风险分类，支持实时监测和早期预警，适用于智能水产养殖系统。

papers.title: Unveiling the potential of extracellular and outer membrane vesicles in fish aquaculture: a comprehensive review
papers.authors: Park, So Young; Hasan, Md Tawheed; Oh, Dong Nyoung; Kim, Ga Yeong; Lee, Jong Min
papers.abstract: Live eukaryotic cells produce extracellular vesicles (EVs) that play a crucial role in cell-to-cell communication and transport various cargoes, including proteins, nucleic acids, and lipids. Based on their biogenesis, size, content, and pathways, EVs are mainly categorized into exosomes, microvesicles, and apoptotic bodies. These EVs have been studied as promising biomarkers for disease diagnosis, stress responses, and indicators of immune-physiological health in prominent aquaculture fish species. In fish studies, EVs have been associated with sex determination and immune response regulation, whereas EV-mediated tissue regeneration and cell permeability have mainly been investigated using zebrafish or medaka models, including studies employing non-fish- or cell culture-derived EVs. On the other hand, outer membrane vesicles (OMVs), primarily produced by gram-negative bacteria, possess acellular properties and are being explored for vaccine development. Intraperitoneal injections of OMVs act as vaccines, providing protection against infectious diseases and mortality. OMVs also modulate immune responses through gene transcription and promote anti-pathogenic antibody production. However, OMVs, which are biologically active nanoparticles, demonstrated infection potential in cultured species. Moreover, hemolytic activity, biofilm formation to protect the parent cell, and cytopathic effect were also confirmed in fish pathogen OMVs. Despite limited research on EVs and OMVs in fish, their potential in aquaculture should not be overlooked. In this report, we discuss the content and mechanisms of eukaryotic and prokaryotic nanovesicles in fish, along with the properties mentioned above. Moreover, research gaps and the future prospects of these nanomaterials will open a new prospect for upcoming researchers to utilize EVs and OMVs in the aquaculture sector.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了细胞外囊泡（EVs）和外膜囊泡（OMVs）在鱼类养殖中的潜力，涵盖其生物发生、分类及在鱼类中的功能。EVs作为疾病诊断和免疫生理健康的生物标志物，参与性别决定和免疫调节；OMVs作为疫苗可预防感染，但具潜在致病性。研究指出这些纳米颗粒在鱼类中应用有限，但前景广阔，并讨论了研究空白和未来方向，为水产养殖利用提供新视角。

papers.title: Producers’ Perceptions of Climate Change Impacts on Inland Aquaculture in the Western Mediterranean Region of Türkiye
papers.authors: Sürer, Mustafa İlker; Tolunay, Ahmet; Turkoglu, Turkay; Uyar, Çağdan; Perkumienė, Dalia; Aleinikovas, Marius; Škėma, Mindaugas
papers.abstract: This study aims to investigate the perspectives of aquaculture producers in the Western Mediterranean Region (operating in Antalya, Burdur, and Isparta provinces) on climate change, examine the impacts of climate change on regional aquaculture, and develop solution proposals. Within the scope of this objective, the socioeconomic and demographic characteristics of the aquaculture producers in the Western Mediterranean Region, along with their knowledge levels regarding climate change, were obtained through a questionnaire technique. The results indicate that producers, who are predominantly engaged in rainbow trout aquaculture, are under severe economic pressure due to high-exchange-rate-driven input costs and the abolition of government subsidies. While all participants (100%) perceived that climate change has decreased production tonnage, the most prominent impact of the climate crisis is perceived as drought and the decline of water resources, with a response rate of 37.2%. Multivariable analysis further showed that aquaculture experience and satisfaction with aquaculture income were significantly associated with producers’ future outlook, highlighting the importance of socioeconomic factors in shaping perceived sectoral vulnerability. Due to both rising costs and environmental risks, 50% of the producers view the future of the sector pessimistically and do not recommend this profession to future generations. Consequently, these results emphasize the critical need for integrated land and water resource management policies, alongside targeted climate adaptation strategies, to ensure the long-term socio-ecological sustainability of forest inland aquaculture in the region.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了土耳其西地中海地区（安塔利亚、布尔杜尔和伊斯帕尔塔省）内陆水产养殖生产者对气候变化的认知及其影响，通过问卷调查收集社会经济特征和气候变化知识水平。结果显示，以虹鳟养殖为主的生产者因高汇率驱动的投入成本和政府补贴取消面临严重经济压力；所有受访者（100%）认为气候变化降低了产量，最显著影响为干旱和水资源减少（响应率37.2%）。多变量分析表明，养殖经验和收入满意度显著关联生产者未来展望，凸显社会经济因素在感知行业脆弱性中的作用。由于成本上升和环境风险，50%的生产者对行业前景悲观且不推荐后代从事此职业，研究强调需综合土地和水资源管理政策及针对性气候适应策略，以保障区域森林内陆养殖的长期社会-生态可持续性。

papers.title: SYNERGISTIC TREATMENT EFFICIENCY OF THE MAIFANITE-&lt;italic&gt;VALLISNERIA NATANS&lt;/italic&gt; COMBINED REMEDIATION SYSTEM FOR SIMULATED AQUACULTURE WASTEWATER
papers.authors: FENG, Qi; YANG, Hang; ZHANG, Hui-Yi; WU, Ying-Zhi; WU, Zhen-Bin; ZHANG, Yi
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨麦饭石与苦草（Vallisneria natans）联合修复系统对模拟养殖废水的协同处理效率。通过构建组合修复体系，评估其对养殖废水中污染物的去除效果。结果显示该系统具有显著的协同增效作用，可为水产养殖废水治理提供技术参考。

papers.title: Unravelling the trophic ecology of the ocean sunfish Mola mola in the western Mediterranean Sea through integrated approaches
papers.authors: Borrajo, Oriol; García-Barcelona, Salvador; Fernández-Corredor, Elena; Fernández-Álvarez, Fernando Ángel; Coll, Marta; Navarro, Joan
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.abstract: Abstract Understanding the trophic ecology of marine megafauna is essential for elucidating their ecological roles and supporting effective conservation strategies. The ocean sunfish ( Mola mola ) is the second-largest bony fish worldwide and has a broad distribution, including the Mediterranean Sea. Despite its size and widespread occurrence, many aspects of its biology remain poorly understood. Traditionally regarded as an obligate feeder on gelatinous zooplankton, recent evidence instead points to a more generalist feeding strategy. Here, we applied a multi-method approach integrating stomach content analysis, DNA metabarcoding, and stable isotope analysis to investigate the feeding ecology of ocean sunfish in the western Mediterranean Sea. Our results revealed that, indeed, ocean sunfish mainly consume gelatinous zooplankton, particularly siphonophores such as Chelophyes appendiculata . However, substantial arthropod, mollusc and chordate contributions were also detected by molecular or observational methods, suggesting a more generalist diet. Stable isotope analysis showed high δ 15 N values compared to other sympatric marine predators reported in the literature, while δ 13 C values showed that ocean sunfish feed extensively in oceanic/pelagic environments. Our results suggest that ocean sunfish in the western Mediterranean Sea occupy an intermediate trophic position but are isotopically segregated from other sympatric marine predators, reflecting a distinct trophic niche. Our integrated approach shows that ocean sunfish play an important role as intermediate predators, facilitating energy transfer from low pelagic trophic levels to higher-level predators, and potentially contributing to the regulation of gelatinous plankton populations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过整合胃含物分析、DNA宏条形码和稳定同位素分析，探究了西地中海翻车鲀（Mola mola）的摄食生态。结果显示，其主要摄食胶质浮游动物（尤其是管水母类Chelophyes appendiculata），但节肢动物、软体动物和脊索动物也有显著贡献，表明其食性偏向泛化。稳定同位素分析显示高δ¹⁵N值和海洋性δ¹³C特征，说明翻车鲀占据中等营养级，并与同域海洋捕食者存在同位素生态位分离。该研究揭示翻车鲀作为中间捕食者，在低营养级至高营养级能量传递中发挥关键作用，并可能调控胶质浮游生物种群。

papers.title: Invertivore fish predation is an overlooked source of carbonate sediment on a turbid coral reef
papers.authors: Nilsen, Jake L.; Browne, Nicola K.; Morgan, Kyle M.; Bonesso, Joshua L.; Benson, Dylan; Dee, Shannon; O’Leary, Michael J.; Kirkendale, Lisa A.; Middelfart, Peter U.; Cuttler, Michael V. W.
papers.abstract: Abstract The geomorphic stability of coral reef islands depends on a continued supply of biologically derived sediment from reefs. However, the ecological processes that produce detrital sediment remain poorly resolved. The role of fishes as sediment producers has largely focused on coral sand generated by parrotfishes (Labridae: Scarinae) in clear-water settings, while the contribution of other groups, such as durophagous invertivores, remains poorly understood. Here, we quantify the contribution of invertivores to carbonate sediments at an inshore reef in the Exmouth Gulf, Western Australia, by combining fish census data and dietary analysis, coupled with taphonomic and compositional analysis of benthic sediments. Invertivore species were among the most abundant fish groups, contributing nearly two-thirds of total fish biomass (28.51 kg out of 48.29 kg). Tuskfish species ( Choerodon schoenleinii and Choerodon cyanodus ) dominated the invertivore assemblage, with dietary analysis indicating that these species, together with Choerodon cauteroma , Lethrinus laticaudis , and Diagramma pictum labiosum , had stomach contents composed of > 50% carbonate shell material. Benthic sediment analysis revealed that ~ 40% of sediments comprised mollusc and echinoderm fragments, with more than one-third of mollusc fragments displaying edge characteristics consistent with durophagy, providing direct evidence of fish predation. Together, these data suggest that invertivore fishes represent a previously unrecognised pathway of carbonate sediment production through the rapid mechanical breakdown of calcareous benthic invertebrates. Quantifying sediment production by invertivores is, therefore, critical for improving carbonate sediment budget estimates, especially turbid reefs with high benthic invertebrate diversity and biomass.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过鱼类种群调查、食性分析及沉积物组成分析，量化了西澳大利亚埃克斯茅斯湾近岸浑浊珊瑚礁中食无脊椎动物鱼类对碳酸盐沉积物的贡献。结果显示，该类群占鱼类总生物量近三分之二（48.29 kg中占28.51 kg），其中以 Choerodon 属和 Lethrinus 属为主，胃含物中碳酸盐壳材料超过50%。沉积物分析表明约40%由软体动物和棘皮动物碎片组成，其中超过三分之一软体动物碎片具有硬食性捕食边缘特征，直接证实了鱼类捕食作用。研究揭示食无脊椎动物鱼类通过快速机械破碎钙质底栖无脊椎动物，构成此前未被识别的碳酸盐沉积物生产途径，对完善碳酸盐沉积物预算估算（尤其在高底栖无脊椎动物多样性和生物量的浑浊礁区）至关重要。

papers.title: Shrimp larviculture and nutrition: current knowledge gaps and future directions
papers.authors: Wouters, Roeland; Lemos, Daniel; Sorgeloos, Patrick
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了虾类苗种培育与营养领域的研究进展，指出当前存在的主要知识空白，包括幼体阶段营养需求、微藻与替代饲料开发、肠道微生物调控等关键方向。文章强调未来需结合分子生物学与养殖技术优化，以提升育苗成活率和健康管理水平。

papers.title: Efficacy of exclusion periods for mitigating harm to freshwater fishes moving into a Great Lakes coastal wetland
papers.authors: Midwood, Jonathan D; Bzonek, Paul; Piczak, Morgan L.; Theÿsmeÿer, Tys; Braun, Douglas C.; Tunney, Tyler D.; Naman, Sean M.; Lake, Colin; Brownscombe, Jacob W
papers.abstract: Exclusion periods (i.e., periods when activities are not permitted near or in-water) are among the most commonly applied harm mitigation measures for freshwater fish and fish habitat. We used a 25 year dataset collected at a wetland entrance in Lake Ontario, Canada to assess the efficacy of coolwater (15 March – 31 May) and warmwater (01 May – 15 July) exclusion periods. When both are applied, all 16 evaluated fishes are well protected (i.e., >70% of their spawning run is protected); however, when only one period is applied protection declined, particularly for early-arriving warmwater fishes. If activities continued into the first few weeks of an exclusion period, risk increased for early arriving fishes. Interannual variation in peak arrival timing was high and the development of models that forecast arrival timing based on within-year conditions (e.g., water temperatures) is recommended. Such models would inform risk-based within-year decision making on whether activities can continue into an exclusion period. Overall, results support the continued application of exclusion periods as an effective measure for mitigating harm to fish and fish habitat.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于加拿大安大略湖湿地入口25年监测数据，评估了冷水期（3月15日-5月31日）和温水期（5月1日-7月15日）两种exclusion periods对淡水鱼类洄游的保护效果。结果显示，同时实施两个时段可有效保护所有16种评估鱼类（>70%产卵洄游），但仅实施单一时段时保护效果下降，尤其对早到达的温水鱼类风险增加。研究建议基于年内环境条件（如水温）开发到达时间预测模型，以支持风险导向的年度决策。总体结论支持继续采用exclusion periods作为减轻鱼类及栖息地损害的有效管理措施。

papers.title: Hybridizing sisters: Evidence of bluegill-pumpkinseed hybridization in modified habitats at the confluence of two major Canadian waterways
papers.authors: Gagliano, Anthony; Villain, Eleonore; Roy, Denis
papers.abstract: Urbanization and shoreline development are reshaping aquatic ecosystems, creating conditions that promote hybridization among fishes. This study investigates the potential hybridization between bluegill (Lepomis macrochirus) and pumpkinseed (Lepomis gibbosus) at the confluence of two major Canadian waterways and compares it to a long-established hybridization in Lake Opinicon, Ontario. We genetically confirm 17 bluegill–pumpkinseed hybrids in Montreal’s West Island, marking the first documented occurrence in Quebec. Hybrids from Montreal showed clearer classification into simple hybrid categories, suggesting a more recent hybridization than that observed in Lake Opinicon. Morphological, dietary, and isotopic analyses indicate that hybrids in both locations are more distinct from bluegill, with pure pumpkinseed becoming increasingly rare in Lake Opinicon. Notably, hybrids in Montreal are concentrated in heavily modified habitats, where altered environmental conditions appear associated with hybridization. This study captures an early stage of introgressive hybridization and highlights the importance of preserving critical habitat conditions to maintain the genetic integrity of key native fish species.
papers.summary_cn: 城市化与岸线开发正改变水生生态系统，促进鱼类杂交。本研究在加拿大两条主要水道交汇处（蒙特利尔西岛）首次记录蓝鳃太阳鱼与驼背太阳鱼杂交个体17尾，并通过遗传学确认其存在，且杂交类型分类清晰，表明杂交发生较安大略湖Opinicon湖的长期杂交更近期。形态、食性和同位素分析显示，两地的杂交个体均与蓝鳃太阳鱼差异更大，而Opinicon湖纯种驼背太阳鱼日益稀少。杂交个体集中于高度改造的生境，提示环境变化与杂交相关，该研究捕捉了渐渗杂交的早期阶段，强调保护关键栖息地条件对维持本地鱼类遗传完整性的重要性。

papers.title: The environmental biology of the tenpounder Elops machnata (Fabricius, 1775) in global estuarine and coastal marine ecosystems
papers.authors: Whitfield, Alan K.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究综述了全球河口及近海海洋生态系统中大海鲢（Elops machnata）的环境生物学特征，涵盖其分布、栖息地利用、生活史及生态适应性。研究旨在整合现有知识，为这一经济与生态重要鱼类的资源管理和保护提供科学依据。

papers.title: Impact of Natural Disaster and Essential Spawning Habitat (ESH) Characteristics on the Conservation of the Vulnerable Endemic Bilih Fish (Mystacoleucus padangensis) in Lake Singkarak, Indonesia
papers.authors: Adelfiani, Adelfiani; Retnoaji, Bambang
papers.journal: The Eurasia Proceedings of Health, Environment and Life Sciences
papers.abstract: The Bilih fish (Mystacoleucus padangensis) is a high value endemic species critical to regional aquaculture biosystems. Currently listed as Vulnerable (VU) on the IUCN Red List, its wild stocks are facing an acute ecological and economic crisis, evidenced by a dramatic 99% collapse in catch volume (from 1 ton/day in 2002 to only 10 kg/day in 2025). This study aimed to characterize the Essential Spawning Habitat (ESH) and governing reproductive strategies, and to develop conservation management principles. Environmental metrics and habitat characteristics (substrate, depth) were measured. Results confirmed that the ESH functions as a critical biosystem component, defined by extremely shallow waters (4–16 cm) and sandy and rocky substrates. Precise environmental cues, specifically consistently low nocturnal temperatures (22–24°C), act as triggering inputs for migration and spawning. This existing stock crisis was severely exacerbated by a catastrophic flood and landslide event that occurred on November 27, 2025, in the spawning locality of West Sumatra. The disaster resulted in the critical degradation of the ESH, primarily through infilling the original substrate with unsuitable mud and fine sand. This damage effectively eliminated the essential rocky spawning media required for behavioral triggering, consequently disrupting the remaining reproductive cycle and accelerating the failure of current resource management efforts. Given the evident high sensitivity of the reproductive process to specific biosystem inputs and the physical destruction of the ESH by the natural disaster, this study urgently recommends strict conservation zoning and ecology based management. Crucially, these must be immediately followed by habitat restoration efforts to reinstate the necessary rocky substrate. Such measures are vital inputs for the regional biosystem, not only to prevent the immediate loss of this Vulnerable endemic germplasm but also to secure the biological foundations required for future resource recovery and sustainable ex-situ aquaculture development.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对印尼Singkarak湖特有濒危鱼类Bilih（Mystacoleucus padangensis）的种群崩溃危机，旨在刻画其关键产卵栖息地（Essential Spawning Habitat, ESH）特征及繁殖策略，并制定保护管理原则。通过测量环境指标和栖息地参数（底质、水深），发现ESH以极浅水域（4–16 cm）和砂石底质为核心，且低温（22–24°C）是触发洄游和产卵的关键环境信号。2025年11月27日的洪水和滑坡灾害严重破坏了ESH，泥和细沙填充原始底质，消除了产卵所需的岩石介质，导致繁殖周期中断并加剧资源管理失效。研究紧急建议实施严格保护分区和基于生态的管理，并立即开展栖息地恢复以重建岩石底质，这对防止该脆弱特有种种质丧失及保障未来资源恢复和可持续ex-situ aquaculture发展至关重要。

papers.title: In Vivo Developmental Toxicity and Teratogenic Evaluation of Cucumis melo L. var. Gama Melon Parfum Extract on Wader Pari Fish(Rasbora lateristriata) Embryos
papers.authors: Podhi, Felisitas Meli; Widiyanto, Slamet; Retnoaji, Bambang
papers.journal: The Eurasia Proceedings of Health, Environment and Life Sciences
papers.abstract: Cucumis melo L. var. Gama Melon Parfum (GMP) is a superior hybrid cultivar developed by the Laboratory of Genetics and Breeding, Faculty of Biology, Universitas Gadjah Mada, characterized by its distinctive sweet aroma and bitter taste. Previous in vitro studies have demonstrated the anticancer potential of GMP extract through the inhibition of cell proliferation and the induction of apoptosis; however, its in vivo toxicity and developmental safety profile remain largely unexplored. This study aimed to evaluate the developmental toxicity and teratogenic potential of GMP extract using Rasbora lateristriata embryos as a biological model. This Indonesian native species offers several advantages, including embryo transparency, high environmental sensitivity, and rapid development, with hatching occurring within 24 hours. The study was conducted in accordance with the Fish Embryo Toxicity (FET) guidelines (OECD Test No. 236, 2025). A preliminary range-finding test indicated 100% mortality at 1000 ppm, followed by a definitive test using concentrations of 50, 100, 250, and 500 ppm in 0.1% DMSO. Early-stage embryos (2–4 hpf) were exposed up to 96 hpf, and endpoints including hatching rate, survival rate, heart rate, and morphological abnormalities were assessed. The results revealed a concentration-dependent response. At 50–250 ppm, no significant effects were observed on survival, hatching, or heart rate; however, notable teratogenic effects were identified, including spinal deformities, ocular abnormalities (microphthalmia and anophthalmia), hemorrhage, and impaired swim bladder development. In contrast, exposure to 500 ppm resulted in acute lethal toxicity, as evidenced by complete mortality, absence of hatching, and loss of cardiac activity. In conclusion, GMP extract exhibits developmental toxicity characterized by a transition from sublethal (teratogenic) to lethal effects with increasing concentration. These findings underscore the importance of dose optimization and comprehensive in vivo evaluation in the development of GMP extract as a potential biomedical agent.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用Wader Pari鱼（Rasbora lateristriata）胚胎作为生物模型，评估了Gama Melon Parfum（GMP）甜瓜提取物的发育毒性和致畸性，遵循OECD Test No. 236的Fish Embryo Toxicity（FET）指南。结果显示，50–250 ppm浓度下未显著影响存活率、孵化率或心率，但诱导脊柱畸形、眼部异常（小眼和无眼）、出血及 swim bladder 发育受损；500 ppm则导致完全致死。研究揭示了从亚致死（致畸）到致死效应的浓度依赖性转变，强调在开发GMP提取物作为生物医学制剂时需优化剂量并进行全面in vivo评估。

papers.title: <b>Effects of Plant-Based Diets on Growth Performance and Water Quality of African Catfish Cultured in a Recirculating Aquaculture System</b>
papers.authors: Abdul Aziz, Nur Azrin; Idris, Nor Shafikah; Zainol, Zamzila Erdawati; Ahmad, Aziani
papers.journal: Malaysian Journal of Science and Advanced Technology
papers.abstract: This research determined the effects of plant-based dietary on the growth performance and water quality of African catfish (Clarias gariepinus) cultured in a Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS). The three dietary treatments were used: commercial pellet (A1), commercial pellet with seaweed (A2) and commercial pellet with Azolla (A3). The growth performance indices and water quality were measured weekly such as weight gain, length gain, specific growth rate (SGR), feed conversion ratio (FCR) and water quality parameters (pH, ammonia, nitrite, and nitrate). The results showed that, the fish fed with Azolla diet (A3) achieved the highest weight gain (15.92 ± 2.13 g), length gain (5.12 ± 1.56 cm) and SGR (2.74 ± 0.51 % day⁻¹) whereas fish fed with seaweed diet (A2) showed lower growth performance but produced significantly improved water quality. The consistent numerical trends indicated biologically meaningful dietary effects, although growth performance differences among treatments were not statistically significant (p > 0.05). Thus, commercial pellet with Azolla (A3), emerged as a practical and sustainable feeding strategy that enhances growth performance while maintaining acceptable water quality in intensive systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了植物性饲料对循环水养殖系统（RAS）中非洲鲶鱼（Clarias gariepinus）生长性能和水质的影响，设商品颗粒饲料（A1）、添加海藻（A2）及添加满江红（A3）三种处理。结果显示，A3组获得最高增重（15.92 ± 2.13 g）、体长增长（5.12 ± 1.56 cm）和特定生长率（2.74 ± 0.51 % day⁻¹），而A2组生长较低但显著改善水质；尽管处理间生长差异未达统计显著（p > 0.05），趋势表明添加满江红（A3）是兼顾生长与水质可持续性的实用策略。

papers.title: Fish skin–derived collagen–chitosan composite membranes: Structure, properties, and packaging performance
papers.authors: Dang, Nhan Thi Thanh; Nguyen, Chi Bao; Le, Thang Quoc
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦鱼皮来源胶原蛋白与壳聚糖复合膜的制备与性能表征，系统考察了其结构特性、理化性质及包装应用潜力。结果表明，该复合膜具有优异的机械强度、生物相容性和阻隔性能，可作为可持续食品包装材料替代传统塑料。研究为渔业副产物高值化利用提供了新途径，兼具环保与经济价值。

papers.title: Length–Weight Relationship and Condition Factor of Nine Indigenous Freshwater Fish Species from Selected Streams of Dooars Region of West Bengal, India
papers.authors: Das, Ram Krishna
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了印度西孟加拉邦Dooars地区多条溪流中9种本土淡水鱼类的体长-体重关系（LWR）及肥满度（condition factor）。通过采集样本并测量体长、体重数据，计算了各鱼种的LWR参数（a、b值）及肥满度指数，旨在评估其生长模式与健康状况。结果显示，多数鱼种呈等速或异速生长，肥满度值表明种群整体营养状况良好，为当地渔业资源管理提供了基础生物学数据。

papers.title: “Give a Man a Fish . . . .”
papers.authors: Brady, Adrian P.
papers.summary_cn: 该标题出自谚语“授人以鱼不如授人以渔”，虽未提供摘要，但结合渔业科学背景，可能探讨渔业资源管理或生计改善策略。若内容涉及渔业，则旨在强调能力建设（如可持续捕捞技术）优于直接援助；若无具体渔业数据或方法，则无法确认相关性。基于现有信息，暂无法判断是否与渔业直接相关。

papers.title: Fish Cytokines at the Crossroads: From Ancient Immune Signals to Modern One Health and Aquaculture Vaccines
papers.authors: Sahoo, Amiya K.; Mohanty, Bimal P.; Martin, Sam; Savan, Ram; Otta, Subhendu K.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨鱼类细胞因子在免疫系统中的核心作用，追溯其从古老免疫信号到现代应用的演化路径。文章聚焦细胞因子在鱼类疫苗开发及One Health理念中的潜在价值，强调其作为连接基础免疫学与水产养殖实践的桥梁。通过综述现有证据，提出靶向细胞因子通路可提升疫苗效力和疾病防控策略，为可持续水产养殖提供新思路。

papers.title: Surface Micromorphology of Oropharyngeal Structures in Schizopyge niger (Heckel, 1838): A SEM Study of Feeding Adaptations in a Coldwater Himalayan Fish
papers.authors: Shah, Syeda Bareeha; Mushtaq, Syed Talia; Shah, Tasaduq Hussain; Bhat, Farooz Ahmed; Aziz-ul-Rehman; Rehman, Misbah
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, India Section B: Biological Sciences
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过扫描电镜（SEM）对喜马拉雅冷水鱼Schizopyge niger（Heckel, 1838）口咽部结构的表面微形态进行了观察，旨在揭示其摄食适应性。研究发现，该鱼种口咽部表面特征（如齿状结构、味蕾分布及黏液分泌孔）与其底栖刮食或滤食习性密切相关，体现了对冷水环境的形态特化。研究为理解高海拔鱼类摄食生态及进化适应提供了微观形态学证据。

papers.title: Impact of Hydroelectric Schemes on the Fish Fauna State in Upstream Pools Using the Example of the Kolyma Hydroelectric Power Plant
papers.authors: Elistratov, V. V.; Maslikov, V. I.; Shilin, M. B.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以科雷马水电站为例，评估水电工程对上游库区鱼类资源状态的影响。通过对比建坝前后鱼类群落组成与丰度变化，揭示水电站运行导致的栖息地破碎化及水文情势改变对鱼类种群结构的负面效应。结果显示，上游库区鱼类多样性显著下降，部分洄游性物种局部消失，而静水性物种占比上升。研究强调需在水电开发中纳入鱼类生态保护措施，以缓解长期生态影响。

papers.title: Effects of Broken Rice Flour Feeding Strategies on Water Quality, Growth Performance and Production Costs of Nile Tilapia (<i>Oreochromis niloticus</i> Linnaeus, 1758) Reared in Fish Pens
papers.authors: Yeo, Maurice; Djeke, Simplice Paul; Konaté, Soumaïla; Etchian, Assoi Olivier; Blé, Mélécony Célestin
papers.abstract: Background and Objective: The increasing cost of commercial aquafeeds has prompted fish farmers to incorporate agricultural by-products into fish diets as cost-effective alternatives. In Côte d'Ivoire, broken rice flour is among the most commonly used agricultural by-products in small-scale aquaculture. This study evaluated the effects of different feeding strategies incorporating broken rice flour on water quality, zootechnical performance, and the economic viability of Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) cultured in fish pens. Materials and Methods: A total of 240 Nile tilapia were reared in fish pens for 56 days under four feeding strategies: Commercial Feed (CF), Commercial Feed plus Broken Rice Flour (CFBR), Broken Rice Flour alone (BR) and a Double Ration of Broken Rice Flour (2BR). Water quality, growth performance, survival, feed utilization, and production costs were assessed throughout the experimental period. Results: Dissolved oxygen concentrations ranged from 5.03-7.50 mg/L, with the lowest value recorded in the 2BR treatment. Despite this, the 2BR treatment achieved the highest survival rate (86.67%, p<0.05). Fish fed the CF diet exhibited the greatest weight gain (36.77 g), significantly exceeding those fed the CFBR (24.63 g), 2BR (25.63 g), and BR (16.80 g) diets. Voluntary feed intake (4.98-5.15% body weight/day) and condition factor values (K>1) indicated good diet acceptability and satisfactory physiological status of the fish across all treatments. Economic analysis showed that the production cost of the CFBR feeding strategy (1,788.7 XOF) was nearly twice that of the 2BR strategy (993 XOF), despite producing a comparable weight gain. Conclusion: Feeding Nile tilapia with a double ration of broken rice flour (2BR) represents a technically and economically favorable strategy, providing the highest survival rate while substantially reducing production costs compared with feeding strategies incorporating commercial feed.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了在科特迪瓦鱼围栏中，不同碎米面粉投喂策略对尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）水质、生长性能及经济可行性的影响。实验设四种策略（纯商品饲料、商品饲料加碎米、纯碎米、双倍碎米），饲养56天。结果显示，双倍碎米组存活率最高（86.67%，p<0.05），且生产成本（993 XOF）远低于商品饲料加碎米组（1788.7 XOF），尽管增重（25.63 g）低于纯商品饲料组（36.77 g）。综合而言，双倍碎米投喂策略在技术经济上最优，可显著降低养殖成本并提高存活率。

papers.title: Contrasting patterns of kelp-associated bacterial community dynamics between farmed and wild Saccharina latissima throughout an aquaculture season
papers.authors: Ramshaw, Jasmine; King, Nathan G.; Rees, Sian; Sheehan, Emma V.; Brown, Ross; Smale, Dan A.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对比了养殖与野生Saccharina latissima（糖海带）在整个养殖季节中附生细菌群落的动态变化模式，旨在揭示 aquaculture 环境对海带微生物组的影响。研究发现养殖与野生海带的细菌群落组成和演替规律存在显著差异，养殖海带的细菌多样性及特定功能类群丰度受季节和环境因子调控更为明显。该结果对理解养殖海带的健康管理及微生物生态调控具有参考意义。

papers.title: Little variation in field-based upper thermal tolerance among populations of a freshwater fish exhibiting strong life history differences
papers.authors: Bauer Reid, Heather; Raby, Graham
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: As aquatic ecosystems warm, intraspecific variation may contribute to population- and species-level resilience. Thermal tolerance is typically studied in the laboratory, which can control for acclimation but might mask population differences. We measured critical thermal maximum (CT_max) of pumpkinseed (Lepomis gibbosus) in lakeside assays for nine populations in central and eastern Ontario, Canada. These populations had previously been shown to exhibit profound differences in life history. Trials were conducted in the late summer and early fall and replicated over two years (2023 and 2024). Temperature loggers provided acclimation temperatures; CT_max was best predicted using shorter acclimation windows (<10 days). CT_max ranged from 33.64 to 37.34 °C, with no differences between years. Acclimation temperature had a positive effect on thermal tolerance. Larger fish had higher CT_max, contrary to much of the literature. Overall, while we found that pumpkinseed thermal tolerance was affected by thermal history and body size, we found no evidence for population differences. Therefore, inter-individual variation is more likely to contribute to resilience to warming in this species than inter-population variation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过野外现场实验测定了加拿大安大略省中部和东部9个种群淡水鱼pumpkinseed（Lepomis gibbosus）的临界热最大值（CT_max），这些种群此前表现出显著的生活史差异。实验在2023-2024年夏末秋初重复进行，利用温度记录仪评估驯化温度影响，发现CT_max范围为33.64-37.34°C，且受短期驯化窗口（<10天）和体长正向影响，但种群间无显著差异。结果表明，该物种对气候变暖的恢复力更可能源于个体间变异而非种群间变异，强调了种内表型可塑性在热适应中的重要性。

papers.title: Short-term effects on water quality from fish stockings with planktivorous, omnivorous, and benthivorous fish species within the Black Sea coast shallow lakes
papers.authors: Doychev, Dimitar
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了黑海沿岸浅水湖泊中投放浮游食性、杂食性和底栖食性鱼类后，对水质的短期影响。通过比较不同食性鱼类组合的投放效果，评估了营养盐浓度、浮游生物群落及透明度等水质指标的变化。结果显示，鱼类食性显著影响水质改善程度，其中浮游食性鱼类可能通过控制浮游生物量降低富营养化风险，而底栖食性鱼类则可能增加底泥扰动。研究为浅水湖泊生态修复中的鱼类管理策略提供了科学依据。

papers.title: Carcinogenic and non-carcinogenic health risks associated with heavy metal exposure in commonly consumed marine fish in Egypt
papers.authors: Elshebrawy, Hend Ali; Sallam, Khalid Ibrahim; Kasem, Nahed Gomaa; Xue, Huping; El-Gohary, Fatma A.
papers.abstract: Abstract This study aimed to quantify the levels of mercury (Hg), arsenic (As), lead (Pb), and cadmium (Cd) in 250 fish samples, including flathead grey mullet, sardine, and mackerel, collected from local fish markets in Mansoura, Egypt, on ten occasions from August 2023 to March 2024. Unlike previous studies that have primarily focused on metal concentrations, this study assessed both carcinogenic and non-carcinogenic health risks among the general population (57.09 g/day) and high-fish consumers (200 g/day). Metal concentrations were determined using atomic absorption spectrophotometry, with method accuracy validated using certified reference materials (CRMs), yielding recoveries of 95.5–100.6%. The average concentrations of Hg, As, Pb, and Cd (µg/g wet weight) were 0.313, 2.13, 0.194, and 0.018 in flathead grey mullet (As > Hg > Pb > Cd); 0.131, 1.65, 0.472, and 0.021 in sardine (As > Pb > Hg > Cd); and 0.196, 0.98, 0.370, and 0.025 in mackerel (As > Pb > Hg > Cd), respectively. Hg and As concentrations were significantly higher in flathead grey mullet, whereas Pb concentration was highest in sardine and Cd concentration was highest in mackerel. Based on the Maximum Permissible Limits (MPLs) set by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), Egyptian Organization for Standardization and Quality (EOS), and Food Standards Australia New Zealand (FSANZ), the proportion of samples exceeding these limits ranged from 9 to 20% for Hg, 22–56% for As, and 20–58% for Pb. For the general population, only the estimated daily intake (EDI) of Hg in flathead grey mullet was above the Provisional Tolerable Daily Intakes (PTDIs), while EDI of most metals exceeded safety thresholds in high fish consumers. Target Hazard Quotient (THQ) for Hg and As exceeded 1.0, while TTHQ values for flathead grey mullet, sardine, and mackerel were 8.4, 5.7, and 4.35 for the general population and 29.43, 19.84, and 15.26 for high-fish consumers, respectively, indicating potential non-carcinogenic health risks. Furthermore, cancer risk (CR) for As ranged from 1.20E−03 to 9.14E−03, exceeding the acceptable safety threshold of 1.0E−04, whereas Pb and Cd risks remained within safe limits. The relatively high metal concentrations may reflect anthropogenic pollution and other environmental inputs affecting the aquatic ecosystem, highlighting the need for regular monitoring and control of pollution sources to reduce contamination and protect public health.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究量化了埃及曼苏拉市售三种常见海鱼（鲻鱼、沙丁鱼、鲭鱼）中汞、砷、铅、镉的浓度，并评估其对普通人群（57.09 g/天）和高消费人群（200 g/天）的致癌与非致癌健康风险。采用原子吸收分光光度法测定金属含量，结果经标准参考物质验证（回收率95.5–100.6%）。研究发现，砷和汞在鲻鱼中含量最高，铅在沙丁鱼中最高，镉在鲭鱼中最高；部分样本超出FAO、EOS及FSANZ限量标准（汞9–20%、砷22–56%、铅20–58%）。目标危害商数（THQ）显示汞和砷超过1.0，总THQ值在普通人群和高消费人群中分别达4.35–8.4和15.26–29.43，表明存在潜在非致癌风险；砷的癌症风险（CR）为1.20E−03至9.14E−03，超出安全阈值，而铅和镉风险在安全范围内。研究强调需加强污染源监测与控制以保障公众健康。

papers.title: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon levels and health risk assessment of sediment and shellfish from coastal communities in the Niger Delta, Nigeria
papers.authors: Ighariemu, Victor; Ighariemu, Oghenerukevwe; Tebu, Oghenerukevwe; Ogbomade, Wellington Emmanuel
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了尼日利亚尼日尔三角洲沿海社区沉积物和贝类中多环芳烃（PAHs）的污染水平及其健康风险。通过检测PAHs浓度，结合风险商值法，揭示了沉积物和贝类中PAHs的分布特征及潜在致癌风险。结果表明，部分采样点PAHs含量超出安全阈值，食用受污染贝类可能对当地居民健康构成威胁。研究为区域环境监测和水产品安全监管提供了科学依据。

papers.title: Navigating the fourth industrial revolution by communicating seafood industry innovation through social media narratives
papers.authors: Subash, Abhirami; N. Ramanathan, Hareesh; Šostar, Marko
papers.abstract: Abstract The seafood sector is experiencing relevant technological development, especially with the implementation of Industry 4.0 advancements. However, it is unknown to what degree seafood enterprises convey these improvements using digital narratives. In the changing environment of the seafood sector, digital narratives are critical for explaining technical breakthroughs. This study analyses social media content from top global and Indian seafood enterprises to determine their emphasis on technical innovation. The study categorizes and analyses posts on various platforms (such as: LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook), revealing variations in technology-centric narratives based on textual analysis. The study underscores the significance of strategic digital communication in showcasing technological advancements in the seafood sector, highlighting the importance of strengthening the communication of technological innovation through digital narratives to enhance international visibility and competitiveness.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在探讨海产品企业在第四次工业革命背景下，如何通过社交媒体叙事传达技术创新。通过分析全球及印度顶级海产品企业在LinkedIn、Instagram和Facebook上的内容，采用文本分类方法评估其技术叙事重点。结果显示，不同平台间技术导向叙事存在显著差异，强调战略数字传播在展示行业技术进步中的关键作用，并建议加强数字叙事以提升国际可见度和竞争力。

papers.title: Antibacterial Activity and Salinity Tolerance of Endophytic Bacteria Isolated from Marine Macroalgae
papers.authors: Fatmawati, Umi; Faturrahim, Muhammad Ilham; Purnamasari, Maria Indah
papers.journal: Biosaintifika: Journal of Biology & Biology Education
papers.abstract: Marine organisms, especially macroalgae, are unique microhabitats for endophytic bacteria that have the potential toprovide unique microhabitats for endophytic bacteria that can produce bioactive compounds with antimicrobial activity. However, the exploration of endophytic bacteria from marine macroalgae, especially those directly associated with host tissues, remains relatively limited. This study aims to isolate endophytic bacteria from various macroalgae and explore the antibacterial potential and salinity resistance of these endophytic isolates. This study aims to identify the potential isolates that produce antibacterial compounds at the molecular level. The antibacterial activity was qualitatively evaluated using the Kirby–Bauer disk diffusion method. The salinity tolerance of the bacterial isolates was assessed by growing them on media with varying NaCl concentrations. Molecular identification of the isolates was performed through 16S rRNA gene amplification and sequence analysis. The results showed that isolate H3 had the highest antibacterial activity against Bacillus subtillis and Staphylococcus aureus, with inhibition zones of 28.9 + 2.3 mm and 26.2 + 4.36 mm, respectively. Isolate R1A showed the highest inhibitory activity on S. aureus and Escherichia coli, with inhibition zones of 25 + 1.08 mm and 35 + 2.9 mm. Salinity resistance test results showed that isolate R1A was able to grow well at a 10% (w/v) NaCl concentration. Molecular identification results with 16S rRNA gene analysis showed that isolate H3 has similarities with the species Lysinibacillus fusiformis, isolate R1A has similarities with Bacillus mojavensis, and R2C has similarities with Bacillus stercosis. This study suggests that endophytic bacteria from macroalgae represent promising and sustainable sources of novel antibacterial agents for pathogen control in high-salinity aquaculture systems. This study aligns with SDG 3 and SDG 14 by supporting human health initiatives and the sustainable utilization of marine biodiversity.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究从海洋大型藻类中分离内生细菌，评估其抗菌活性与耐盐性，旨在开发新型抗菌剂。通过Kirby–Bauer纸片扩散法检测抑菌效果，并利用16S rRNA基因测序进行分子鉴定。结果显示，菌株H3对Bacillus subtilis和Staphylococcus aureus抑菌圈最大（28.9 mm和26.2 mm），菌株R1A对Escherichia coli抑菌圈达35 mm，且能在10% NaCl浓度下良好生长。分子鉴定将H3、R1A和R2C分别归为Lysinibacillus fusiformis、Bacillus mojavensis和Bacillus stercosis。研究表明，大型藻类内生细菌是耐盐养殖系统中病原控制的可持续抗菌资源，符合SDG 3和SDG 14目标。

papers.title: Reproductive biology of the red cornetfish Fistularia petimba and its relation to fisheries off western Kyushu, southwestern Japan
papers.authors: Shimose, Tamaki; Sakai, Takeshi; Masubuchi, Takahito; Gomi, Shintaro; Ebisu, Ryousei
papers.abstract: Abstract The red cornetfish Fistularia petimba (Syngnathiformes; Fistulariidae) is an important commercial fish species caught around all sea areas of Japan, but biological information on the species is limited. In this study, gonadal development of the species was determined, and the spawning season was estimated by the histological observation of gonads using 222 female (691–1783 mm total length without filament) and 120 male (714–1358 mm) specimens caught off western Kyushu (eastern part of the East China Sea), southwestern Japan. The occurrence of vitellogenic oocytes for all females and spermatozoa in all males indicated that they reached sexual maturity. Hydrated oocytes and ovulated eggs in the ovarian cavity were observed from April to October, and the proportion of females possessing them increased from May to July, indicating a spawning season from April to October with a peak from May to July in the area. Postovulatory follicles were exclusively observed with hydrated oocytes or ovulated eggs; however, postovulatory follicles were no longer observed despite ovulated eggs remaining in the ovarian cavity for some females. This suggests that females can retain ovulated eggs until postovulatory follicles degenerate over a few days before they release eggs. The gonadosomatic index increased during the spawning season in females but remained at low values all year-round in males. The small amount of sperm for males even in the spawning season and the retention of ovulated eggs for a few days by females implies some kind of unique reproductive pattern/strategy for the species. Bottom trawl fishery closure during the peak spawning season may contribute to maintaining the stock of the species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过组织学观察，分析了日本九州西部海域222尾雌性和120尾雄性红烟管鱼（Fistularia petimba）的性腺发育，确定了其繁殖生物学特征。研究发现该物种4-10月为产卵期，5-7月为产卵高峰，雌鱼可保留排卵卵数天直至排卵后滤泡退化，而雄鱼全年性腺指数较低，提示其具有独特的繁殖策略。产卵高峰期底拖网禁渔可能有助于维持该物种资源量。

papers.title: Thermal bottlenecks constrain early-life survival of native fish in regulated rivers
papers.authors: Arai, Kohma; Ryan, Rachael E.; Daniels, Miles; Willmes, Malte; Whitman, George E.; Thacher, Larisa M.; Matsuda, Nozomi; Bell, Elizabeth A.; McKeegan, Kevin D.; Jeffres, Carson A.
papers.abstract: Climate change is reshaping thermal regimes worldwide, threatening species whose early development depends on narrow temperature ranges. Yet directly linking warming to reproductive failure in wild populations remains intractable, particularly in aquatic ecosystems.
