We developed an empirical framework integrating stable isotope thermometry of archival tissues, landscape-scale temperature modeling, and field surveys to identify when and where successful reproduction occurs. Applying this approach to endangered winter-run Chinook salmon confined below a large dam, we revealed a narrow “critical thermal window” during early development. Surviving juveniles experienced temperatures below 12.5°C within ∼15 days of fertilization, and modest warming during this period sharply reduced survival. In warm years, dam-released cold-water overlapped only briefly with this window, restricting successful reproduction to a small fraction of the total spawning season. These results show how climate warming and river regulation interact to constrain population persistence and provide a framework to guide research on assessing climate vulnerability in temperature-sensitive species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对受调控河流中温度变化对本地鱼类早期存活的影响，提出一个整合档案组织稳定同位素测温、景观尺度温度建模和野外调查的实证框架，以识别成功繁殖的时间与空间窗口。以濒危冬季洄游Chinook salmon为案例，发现幼鱼在受精后约15天内需经历低于12.5°C的水温，此期间轻微升温即显著降低存活率。在暖年，大坝释放的冷水与这一关键窗口仅短暂重叠，导致成功繁殖局限于产卵季的一小部分。研究揭示了气候变暖与河流调控如何协同限制种群持续性，为评估温度敏感物种的气候脆弱性提供了方法论指导。

papers.title: Fish-GCvT: a hybrid deep learning architecture based on Convolutional Vision Transformers and graph convolutional networks for fish species classification
papers.authors: Asgari, Amin; Ebrahimnezhad, Hossein; Sedaaghi, Mohammad Hossein
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出Fish-GCvT，一种融合卷积视觉Transformer（Convolutional Vision Transformer）与图卷积网络（Graph Convolutional Network）的混合深度学习架构，用于鱼类物种分类。该方法旨在结合局部特征提取与全局关系建模能力，提升分类精度。实验表明，该架构在鱼类图像识别任务中表现出优越性能，适用于渔业资源监测与生态调查中的自动物种鉴定。

papers.title: Valorization of fish oil byproduct methyl esters for omega‑3 polyunsaturated fatty acids production via immobilized CALB lipase‑catalyzed hydrolysis
papers.authors: Shen, Ji-Dong; Zhang, Meng; Li, Meng-Yang; Dong, Yu-Qi; Liu, Zhi-Qiang; Zheng, Yu-Guo
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在利用固定化CALB脂肪酶催化鱼油副产物甲酯水解，以生产omega-3多不饱和脂肪酸（PUFA），实现鱼油加工副产物的高值化利用。通过酶促水解工艺优化，评估固定化酶在选择性释放EPA和DHA方面的效率及稳定性。结果显示，该生物催化方法可有效富集omega-3 PUFA，为渔业副产物资源化提供绿色技术途径。

papers.title: Impact of Composite Regulation Technology on the Ecology, Growth, and Immunity of Litopenaeus vannamei in High-Position Pond Aquaculture
papers.authors: You, Jiuju; Xia, Fengfeng; Wang, Yifan; Mantravadi, Venkata Subrahmanyam
papers.abstract: To explore the optimization effects of fixed aquatic water treatment materials combined with immunomodulatory agents on the ecosystem and farming efficiency of Litopenaeus vannamei in high-water-level ponds, this study established experimental ponds (with fixed aquatic water treatment materials and feed supplemented with chitosan oligosaccharides) and control ponds (no fixed water treatment materials applied, fed with basal feed only). Through a comparative trial over a complete farming cycle, the study systematically analyzed changes in plankton community structure and diversity, water physicochemical factors, shrimp growth performance, immune indicators, and muscle nutritional composition. The results showed that in the experimental group, diatoms (Ditylum brightwellii and Skeletonema) dominated the plankton community, while the density of harmful blue-green algae (Oscillatoria and Trichodesmium) significantly decreased, and planktonic animal diversity improved in the later stages. Among the water physicochemical indicators, the experimental group exhibited a 50% reduction in nitrite levels by the later stages, significantly higher than the 33.33% reduction in the control group. Total ammonia nitrogen levels remained lower than those in the control group, with a smaller increase in the later stages. Total phosphorus levels were significantly lower in the experimental group after 80 days, and the later-stage decline in chemical oxygen demand was 11.65% higher than that in the control group. Shrimp body weight increased significantly by 13.23%, while hepatosomatic index, musculosomatic index, and immune enzyme (acid phosphatase and total antioxidant substances) activity also improved markedly. The content of unsaturated fatty acids (linoleic acid and oleic acid) in the muscles significantly increased. The study demonstrated that the combined application of fixed aquatic water treatment materials and chitosan oligosaccharide preparations can optimize the farming water environment, enhance shrimp growth performance and quality, and provide technical support for the ecological cultivation of Litopenaeus vannamei.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了固定化水质处理材料与壳寡糖免疫增强剂联合应用对高水位凡纳滨对虾（Litopenaeus vannamei）养殖生态及生产性能的优化效果。通过对比试验，分析了浮游生物群落结构、水质理化因子、对虾生长性能、免疫指标及肌肉营养成分的变化。结果显示，实验组浮游植物以硅藻（如布氏双尾藻和骨条藻）为主，有害蓝藻（颤藻和束丝藻）密度显著降低，后期浮游动物多样性提升；亚硝酸盐后期降低50%，总氨氮和总磷水平低于对照组，化学需氧量降幅高出11.65%。对虾体重显著增加13.23%，肝体比、肌体比及免疫酶活性（酸性磷酸酶和总抗氧化物质）明显改善，肌肉中不饱和脂肪酸（亚油酸和油酸）含量显著提高。研究表明，该联合技术可优化养殖水环境、增强对虾生长性能与品质，为凡纳滨对虾生态养殖提供技术支撑。

papers.title: Liquid fertilizer recovered from the effluent water of recirculating aquaculture system by reverse osmosis exhibits storage stability independent of pasteurization
papers.authors: Ulleberg, Didrik; Raspati, Gema; Baele, Tara; Birkeland, Mari; Svenning, Jon Brage
papers.abstract: The shift to a circular bioeconomy is dependent on green-tech innovations that upcycle waste streams into reusable components. The current study explores the chemical and microbiological stability of a fertilizer concentrate produced from effluent water of recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) using reverse osmosis. The objective was to assess the shelf life of the concentrate and determine whether pasteurization is required to prevent spoilage during storage in light-proof containers at room temperature for six months. The chemical and microbiological storage stability of the pasteurized concentrate was monitored by periodic sampling and compared to an untreated control. Pasteurization decreased the initial concentration of elements dissolved in the concentrate, the viable cell load and the percentage of intact bacterial cells. However, both the pasteurized and the untreated control maintained chemical and microbiological stability during storage, indicating that the concentrate has a shelf life of at least 6 months independent of pasteurization. The concentrate is therefore suitable for long-term storage, without the increased production costs and energy use required for pasteurization, thereby providing a reliable and circular source of plant nutrients that have the potential to support sustainable farming practices. This study will contribute to the continued transition towards sustainable aquaculture by repurposing RAS effluent as a valuable by-product for crop cultivation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了利用反渗透技术从循环水养殖系统（RAS） effluent 中回收液体肥料的储存稳定性，旨在评估其货架期及巴氏杀菌的必要性。通过六个月的避光室温储存实验，对比了巴氏杀菌与未处理样品的化学和微生物稳定性。结果显示，巴氏杀菌虽降低了初始溶解元素浓度和活菌数，但两种处理在储存期间均保持稳定，表明该浓缩肥无需巴氏杀菌即可至少保存6个月。这一发现可降低生产成本和能耗，为可持续农业提供可靠的循环营养源，并促进RAS废弃物的资源化利用。

papers.title: Accelerating aquaculture: Marine extractivism, illiberal economics and blue growth in aotearoa (New Zealand)
papers.authors: McCormack, Fiona
papers.abstract: This article links the extension of new extractivist logics in marine environments with a global rise in illiberal political and economic trends, right-wing political configurations, and the imposition of aggressive borderisations of nature and society. I argue that earlier alignments between discourses of sustainability and blue economic growth, which characterised the neoliberal era, shaped the terms upon which a contemporary authoritarian extractive turn is now occurring. The analysis is grounded in an exploration of the anticipated acceleration of aquaculture in Aotearoa New Zealand and the role of the settlement of Indigenous Māori claims in this development. I identify a range of moments and mechanisms facilitating the authoritarian turn, including the amplification of market-based visions, financial and technological innovations, the creation of a conducive regulatory environment for financiers, state pledges to co-invest in this speculative future, the dismantling of environmental protections and the subjugation of Indigenous tenure and relational economies.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了新西兰海洋环境中新采掘主义逻辑的扩展，与全球非自由主义政治经济趋势及右翼政治格局的关联。通过分析水产养殖加速发展及毛利原住民权利和解在此进程中的作用，揭示了从新自由主义可持续话语向当代威权采掘转向的机制，包括市场化愿景强化、金融技术创新、监管环境重塑及环境与土著权益的削弱。研究旨在阐明蓝色增长叙事下政治经济转型对渔业治理的深层影响。

papers.title: A Typology-Based Strategic Producer Positioning Map for Sustainable Small-Scale Freshwater Aquaculture Development in Coastal Ecuador
papers.authors: Cueva, Tommy; González-Martínez, Ana; Barba, Cecilio; Boyer-Bustamante, Eva; De-Pablos-Heredero, Carmen; García, Antón
papers.abstract: Ecuadorian aquaculture plays an increasingly important role in food security, providing a sustainable complement to capture fisheries. Manabí constitutes a key economic sector that contributes to employment generation, income diversification, and supply of high-quality protein. However, the sector’s heterogeneity and limited legal registration of enterprises hinder the development of policies and targeted interventions. This study characterizes aquaculture enterprises in Manabí, integrating productive, technological, and socio-economic variables obtained from field surveys. Three distinct entrepreneurship patterns were identified: small-scale, informal farms cultivating native species with low technology but characteristics that may contribute to socio-ecological resilience; semi-formal producers operating with intermediate technology and mixed species; and freshwater shrimp farms operating at the largest relative scale within the sample, though still small-scale and family-based, with moderate technological development and market integration limited mainly to local and regional markets. The typology focused on a gradient in formalization, technological sophistication, and market orientation among enterprises. These findings provide a comprehensive understanding of aquaculture diversity in Manabí and offer a practical framework for differentiated policy design using a Strategic Producer Positioning Map. Strengthening formalization, technological innovation, environmental management, and social inclusion is essential to enhance the sector’s sustainability and competitiveness, contributing to sustainable blue economy development in coastal Ecuador.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于厄瓜多尔Manabí省实地调查数据，整合生产、技术和社会经济变量，对小型淡水水产养殖企业进行类型学分析。识别出三种创业模式：低技术但具社会生态韧性的小规模非正规养殖场、中等技术混合物种的半正规生产者，以及规模相对较大但仍以家庭为主、市场局限于本地的新鲜淡水虾场。研究构建了基于正规化程度、技术复杂度和市场导向梯度的战略生产者定位图，为差异化政策设计提供实用框架。该框架强调加强正规化、技术创新、环境管理和社会包容，以提升部门可持续性和竞争力，助力沿海厄瓜多尔的蓝色经济发展。

papers.title: Socio-Economic Aspects and Aquaculture Practices of Fish Farmers in Eastern  Uttar Pradesh, India
papers.authors: Rahul; Srivastava, Pankaj Kumar; Singh, Sunil Kumar; Singh, Ajay; Ranjan, Devarshi; Singh, Himanshu; Saroj, Shivm; Kumar, Ajay; Kumar, Rohit; Singh, Anil
papers.journal: Journal of Scientific Research and Reports
papers.abstract: The present study evaluated the socio-economic characteristics and aquaculture practices of fish farmers in Gorakhpur, Deoria, and Kushinagar districts of Eastern Uttar Pradesh. A total of 207 fish farmers were surveyed between December 2024 and February 2025 through structured personal interviews, focus group discussions, and key informant interviews, comprising 53 respondents from Gorakhpur, 76 from Deoria, and 78 from Kushinagar. Respondents were predominantly male and belonged to the middle-aged group (26-55 years), with most having intermediate or graduate-level education and operating small to medium-sized farms (0.5-5 acres). Aquaculture was the principal source of income in Gorakhpur and Deoria, whereas agriculture was the major livelihood source in Kushinagar, with most respondents reporting annual incomes of ₹1-10 lakhs. Pond-based aquaculture was dominant, groundwater was the primary water source, and composite fish culture was the most widely adopted production system. Hatcheries were the principal source of fish seed, while catfish was the most preferred cultured species, followed by Indian Major Carps, Exotic Major Carps, and pacu. These findings demonstrate the important contribution of aquaculture to rural livelihoods and income generation in Eastern Uttar Pradesh. However, limitations related to the cross-sectional survey design and the absence of advanced analytical modelling restrict the identification of causal relationships between socio-economic factors, management practices, and farm productivity. The findings provide useful baseline information for strengthening technical assistance, quality input supply, market access, and capacity-building programmes, while further analytical research is needed to identify the key determinants of productivity and economic performance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了印度东部北方邦Gorakhpur、Deoria和Kushinagar三县207名养鱼户的社会经济特征与养殖实践，数据通过结构化访谈、焦点小组和关键知情人访谈收集于2024年12月至2025年2月。受访者以中年男性为主，多具中等或本科教育背景，经营0.5-5英亩的中小型鱼塘；水产养殖在Gorakhpur和Deoria为主要收入来源，而Kushinagar以农业为主。养殖以池塘系统为主导，地下水为主要水源，混养模式最普遍，鱼苗多来自孵化场，鲶鱼为首选养殖品种，其次为印度鲤、外来鲤和pacu。研究揭示了水产养殖对农村生计的重要贡献，但横断面设计限制因果推断，需进一步分析以明确生产力关键决定因素。

papers.title: International legal regulation of marine plastic pollution: basic theories, specific issues, and China’s responses
papers.authors: Shi, Yuanhong
papers.abstract: Marine plastic pollution (MPP) is among the gravest environmental issues of the international community and is directly linked with the shared interests of humanity. The current international legal frameworks that regulate MPP primarily involve the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, and other international conventions and other soft-law instruments. Nevertheless, there is still no fully developed international legal regulatory framework of MPP. According to the basic theories of the international regulation of MPP, this paper identifies the unresolved problems in the current process of governance, including the limitations of existing international conventions, the difficulty in negotiating the Global Plastics Treaty, the insufficient compliance capacity of relevant States, and the inadequate oversight mechanisms. Based on the experience of the representative countries, regions, and other international organizations, this paper suggests that China should pursue a holistic approach to governance of MPP by enhancing its domestic laws, encouraging the implementation of the Global Plastics Treaty, facilitating and supporting international governance mechanisms to increase state compliance, and enhancing regulatory and enforcement capabilities.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究聚焦海洋塑料污染（MPP）的国际法律规制，分析《联合国海洋法公约》等现有框架的不足，指出全球塑料条约谈判、国家履约能力及监督机制等核心问题。基于代表性国家与区域经验，提出中国应通过完善国内法、推动条约实施、强化国际治理参与及提升监管执法能力，采取综合路径应对MPP。

papers.title: Role of Movement Models and the Habitat Mosaic in Projecting Impacts of Habitat Restoration on a Young-of-Year Fish Cohort
papers.authors: Fulford, R. S.; Hagy, J. D.; Tolan, J. L.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦于运动模型与栖息地镶嵌结构在预测栖息地恢复对当年生鱼类群体影响中的作用。通过整合空间显式模型与栖息地异质性分析，评估了恢复措施对幼鱼存活与分布格局的潜在效应。结果表明，运动行为假设与栖息地连通性显著影响恢复效果的预测精度，强调在渔业管理中需结合精细尺度栖息地动态。

papers.title: Analysis of Microplastic Contamination in Water, Sediment, and Fish on the Northeastern Coast of Libya
papers.authors: Kateesh, Mousa; A. Temraz, Tarek; Khattab, Rafat Afifi; El-Sherbiny, Mohsen M.; Ali, Imran
papers.abstract: Microplastic contamination has become an emerging environmental concern in marine ecosystems worldwide. This study investigated the occurrence, abundance, size, color, and polymer composition of microplastics in surface water, marine sediments, and the gastrointestinal tracts of commercially important fish species collected from the coastal regions of Sousa and Alhaniyah along the northeastern Mediterranean coast of Libya. Microplastics were detected in 10 of 15 (66.7%) surface water samples from Sousa and in 5 of 15 (33.3%) samples from Alhaniyah. In bed sediments, microplastics were detected in 5 of 15 samples (33.3%) at both study sites. Microplastics were detected in 46.73% (71/149) of the fish specimens collected from Sousa and in 20.30% (25/123) of those collected from Alhaniyah. The mean microplastic abundance in surface water was 2.5 ± 2.6 particles/L in Sousa and 0.7 ± 1.3 particles/L in Alhaniyah. Mean sediment abundances were 254 ± 57 and 212 ± 23 particles/kg dry weight, respectively. These findings indicate microplastic contamination at both study sites, with spatial variation in abundance. Microplastic abundance in fish gastrointestinal tracts varied among species, with the highest mean values observed in Epinephelus marginatus (3.0 ± 1.6 particles/fish), followed by Alepes djedaba (2.7 ± 1.2 particles/fish) and Pagrus pagrus (2.3 ± 0.6 particles/fish). This variability revealed the species-specific exposure associated with the feeding behavior and habitat use. The microplastic particles observed were in sizes from 1.0 to 5.0 mm, with larger particles more prevalent in the sediments and smaller particles in fish. Nine different microplastic colors were seen, with blue being the most common, followed by black, green, white, transparent, yellow, glossy, red, and brown. Rayon, alkyd resin, polyamide, and poly(acrylonitrile) were identified at both study sites, whereas poly (ethylene terephthalate) (PET) was detected only at Alhaniyah. The overall similarity in polymer composition suggests that the two locations share common sources of microplastic contamination, while the occurrence of PET exclusively at Alhaniyah may indicate additional local inputs. However, further investigations are required to identify and confirm the specific sources of these polymers. This study provides the first baseline assessment of microplastic contamination in the coastal environments of Alhaniyah and Sousa, northeastern Libya. It offers a valuable reference for future monitoring and mitigation strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了利比亚东北部Sousa和Alhaniyah沿海地区表层水、沉积物及商业重要鱼类胃肠道中的微塑料污染状况，分析了其丰度、尺寸、颜色和聚合物组成。结果显示，两站点均存在微塑料污染，但丰度呈空间差异：Sousa表层水微塑料平均丰度为2.5 ± 2.6 particles/L，沉积物为254 ± 57 particles/kg干重，鱼类检出率46.73%；Alhaniyah相应值较低（0.7 ± 1.3 particles/L，212 ± 23 particles/kg，20.30%）。鱼类微塑料丰度具物种特异性，以Epinephelus marginatus最高（3.0 ± 1.6 particles/fish），且聚合物组成相似（rayon、alkyd resin、polyamide等），但PET仅见于Alhaniyah，提示局部额外输入。该研究为利比亚东北部沿海微塑料污染提供了首个基线评估，为未来监测与缓解策略奠定基础。

papers.title: Reassessment of Pinniwallago kanpurensis confirms its synonymy with Wallago attu (Siluridae)
papers.authors: Rath, Shibananda; Laskar, Boni Amin
papers.abstract: Abstract Pinniwallago kanpurensis was described from Bara Tal in the Kanpur district, India and was distinguished from Wallago attu by the presence of a second rayed dorsal fin. Hitherto, both the genus and the species have been considered valid. Radiographic analysis revealed abnormal pterygiophores associated with the second rayed dorsal fin, indicative of a developmental anomaly. Further, the study revealed marked inconsistencies in the position and relative length of this putative structure between the type specimens. We support the earlier interpretation that P. kanpurensis was based on anomalous individuals and is herein considered a junior synonym of W. attu .
papers.summary_cn: 本研究重新评估了印度坎普尔地区Bara Tal发现的Pinniwallago kanpurensis，旨在验证其分类地位。通过X射线影像分析，发现该物种第二背鳍鳍条相关的pterygiophores异常，表明其属于发育畸形，且该结构在模式标本中的位置和相对长度存在显著不一致。结果支持先前观点，即P. kanpurensis基于异常个体描述，应视为Wallago attu的次定同物异名（junior synonym）。

papers.title: In memoriam: Professor MORIHIKO SAKAGUCHI (1938–2026)
papers.authors: Ando, Masashi

papers.title: Oral administration of emodin enhances immunity, disease resistance and growth promotion in largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides)
papers.authors: Wu, Gan-Ming; Xiong, Wen-Hua; Fu, Yao-Wu; Zhang, Qi-Zhong
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了口服大黄素（emodin）对大口黑鲈（Micropterus salmoides）的免疫增强、抗病力提升及生长促进作用。通过饲料添加大黄素进行投喂实验，评估其对鱼类免疫指标、疾病抵抗能力及生长性能的影响。结果显示，大黄素口服给药可显著增强大口黑鲈的免疫应答，提高疾病抵抗力，并促进其生长，为水产养殖中大黄素作为功能性饲料添加剂的应用提供了科学依据。

papers.title: Financial Vulnerability and Value Creation in Zero-Waste-Oriented Fish-Processing MSME: Evidence From a Pangasius Value Chain in Indonesia
papers.authors: Intyas, Candra Adi; Tjahjono, Agus; Kowiyu, Aiman; Swara, Suluh Elman; Aquino, Eliza Catelo
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦印尼鲶鱼（Pangasius）加工型中小微企业（MSME）在零废弃导向下的财务脆弱性与价值创造机制。通过价值链分析，揭示企业如何通过副产物利用和资源效率提升来缓解财务风险，同时实现经济增值。研究发现，零废弃策略不仅降低废弃物处理成本，还开辟新收入来源，但企业规模与市场准入限制仍制约其财务韧性。该案例为发展中国家渔业加工可持续转型提供了实证参考。

papers.title: Observer coverage and interaction rates determine the choice between design‐based and machine learning bycatch estimators for rare species
papers.authors: Long, Christopher; Ahrens, Robert; Jones, T. Todd; Siders, Zachary
papers.abstract: Abstract Robust estimates of the magnitude of protected species bycatch are essential for effective fisheries management and marine conservation. Existing bycatch estimation methods typically struggle to accurately and precisely estimate the bycatch of rare species as a result of the statistical assumptions necessary to overcome infrequent encounters and, often, low observer coverage. We compared the widely used Horvitz–Thompson design‐based estimator with a machine learning framework for estimating protected species bycatch based on ensemble random forests. We simulated reduced observer coverage in the 100% observed Hawaii shallow‐set pelagic longline fishery and compared the two estimation methods for five species: oceanic whitetip sharks ( Carcharhinus longimanus ), Laysan albatross ( Phoebastria immutabilis ), black‐footed albatross ( Phoebastria nigripes ), loggerhead sea turtles ( Caretta caretta ), and leatherback sea turtles ( Dermochelys coriacea ). Machine learning‐based estimates were more precise than design‐based estimates for all species, but annual and long‐term accuracy varied with bycatch rates and spatial clustering of interactions. The machine learning approach improved the precision of bycatch estimates for oceanic whitetip sharks (3.5% of sets with interaction) without reducing long‐term accuracy. As interaction rates declined below this level, the ensemble random forests method introduced increasing bias and resulted in a preference for the design‐based estimator in real‐world applications. The ensemble random forests approach relaxed the trade‐off between accurate, precise bycatch estimates and observer coverage for species with greater than 3% interaction rates. However, high observer coverage remains irreplaceable for effectively estimating bycatch for the rarest species, and the imprecision of design‐based estimates should be accounted for in management decisions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了基于设计的Horvitz–Thompson估计器与基于集成随机森林的机器学习框架在珍稀物种兼捕估算中的表现，利用夏威夷浅层延绳钓渔业的100%观察数据模拟降低观察覆盖率，针对五种保护物种进行验证。结果显示，机器学习估计对所有物种更精确，但准确度随兼捕率和空间聚集性变化；当交互率高于3.5%时，机器学习在保持长期准确性的同时提高精度，而低于此水平则引入偏差，使设计基估计更适用。研究强调，高观察覆盖率对最稀有物种的兼捕估算仍不可替代，管理决策需考虑设计基估计的不精确性。

papers.title: Spatial modeling for industrial and aquaculture development along the Northern coastline of the Persian Gulf: Bandar Sirik to Bandar Abbas
papers.authors: Amjad, M.; Farsad, F.; Javid, A. H.; Mashinchian, A.; Ejlali, K.
papers.journal: International Journal of Environmental Science and Technology
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对波斯湾北部海岸（Bandar Sirik至Bandar Abbas段）的工业与水产养殖开发进行空间建模，旨在评估该区域适宜发展的空间布局。通过整合地理与环境因子，构建多准则决策模型，识别出适合工业设施和 aquaculture 用地的潜在区域。结果表明，沿海地带存在显著的开发冲突与生态敏感区，需平衡经济发展与海洋生态保护。研究为区域沿海规划提供了空间决策支持工具。

papers.title: Integrating Multi-Omics in Aquaculture: From Genetic Gains to Sustainable Aquaculture
papers.authors: Guo, Chao; Sun, Deqi; Yang, Ben; Shi, Chenyu; Liu, Shikai
papers.abstract: In recent years, aquaculture, a critical pillar of global food security, has faced challenges including germplasm resource degradation, frequent disease outbreaks, and insufficient environmental adaptability. To address these issues, omics technologies—centered on genomics, transcriptomics, and related fields—are driving the transformation of aquaculture toward precision and intelligence by establishing a three-dimensional “genotype–phenotype–environment” knowledge network. In this review, we outline foundational applications of omics in aquaculture and highlight the characteristics and current applications of distinct omics approaches. Furthermore, we summarize three core application domains of omics in aquaculture: (1) genetic breeding via genomic selection (GS), gene editing, and multi-omics molecular dissection of economic traits; (2) disease prevention through host–pathogen interaction studies and microbial engineering; and (3) environmental assessment through multi-omics characterization of biological and ecological responses. Additionally, we identify challenges in applying omics technologies to aquatic breeding and database development. Overall, this review aims to provide aquaculture practitioners with actionable insights by enhancing understanding of omics-driven innovations in sustainable aquaculture advancement.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述探讨了多组学技术（以基因组学、转录组学为核心）如何推动水产养殖向精准化和智能化转型，通过构建“基因型-表型-环境”三维知识网络应对种质退化、疾病频发和环境适应性不足等挑战。文章概述了组学在水产养殖中的基础应用，并总结了三大核心领域：基于基因组选择（GS）、基因编辑和经济性状多组学解析的遗传育种；通过宿主-病原互作和微生物工程实现的疾病防控；以及利用多组学表征生物与生态响应的环境评估。同时指出了组学技术在水产育种和数据库开发中的应用瓶颈，旨在为从业者提供可持续水产养殖发展的实践参考。

papers.title: Integrating microbial biotechnology, functional nutrition, and biofloc technology for sustainable snakehead murrel (Channa striata) aquaculture
papers.authors: Lincy, L. Lourdu; Saranya, S.; Chellapandi, P.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了整合微生物生物技术、功能性营养与生物絮团技术（biofloc technology）在可持续养殖条纹蛇头鱼（Channa striata）中的应用潜力。通过综述这些技术的协同作用，旨在优化养殖环境、提升饲料利用效率并减少环境足迹。文章强调该综合策略可促进鱼类健康与生长性能，为蛇头鱼养殖的绿色转型提供理论依据。

papers.title: Adaptability of Chaetomorpha valida (Ulvophyceae) spores to salinity, nutrients and water flow in aquaculture ponds and its invasive evaluation
papers.authors: Li, Dongyue; Xing, Ronglian; Li, Rui; Cao, Xuebin; Hu, Shujun; Pan, Xiaojing; Zhang, Hongxia; Chen, Lihong; Yu, Zhen
papers.summary_cn: 研究探讨了养殖池塘中硬毛藻（Chaetomorpha valida）孢子对盐度、营养盐和水流的适应性，并评估其入侵风险。结果表明该藻类孢子具备较强的环境耐受性，可在多种养殖条件下萌发和定殖，提示其可能成为养殖系统中的潜在入侵种。研究为养殖池塘藻类管理及生物入侵防控提供了科学依据。

papers.title: Thermal history and behavioural plasticity shape reef fish tolerance to marine heatwaves
papers.authors: Mitchell, Angus; Connell, Sean D.; Harvey, Ben P.; Agostini, Sylvain; Jolly, Jeffrey; Mitushasi, Guinther; Ravasi, Timothy; Booth, David J.; Nagelkerken, Ivan
papers.abstract: Abstract Marine heatwaves are becoming more frequent and intense, driving mass fish mortalities and reshaping marine ecosystems, yet the capacity of fishes to tolerate heatwaves remains unclear. We quantified physiological condition and behavioural responses of juvenile warm-water ( Abudefduf vaigiensis ) and cool-water ( Microcanthus strigatus ) fishes from three natural climate analogues—an ambient temperate reef, an ocean warming analogue, and a combined warming and extreme acidification analogue—before and during the 2023 global marine heatwave, and under a + 3 °C simulated heatwave in the laboratory. In the laboratory, warm-water fish from the warm reef began the experiment in leaner condition than cool reef fish but increased their bite rates under heatwave conditions, compensating for elevated metabolic demand and maintaining body condition. Cool-water fish showed no behavioural adjustment to the heatwave, and body condition diverged by reef origin: cool reef fish lost weight across all treatments while warm- and extreme-origin fish maintained condition, suggesting tolerance was conferred by prior thermal history rather than acute behavioural responses. In the field, warm-water fish were leaner and had lower protein content during the 2023 heatwave than before it, while cool-water fish from the extreme reef had lower body condition than those from the cool reef prior to the heatwave. Our findings suggest that behavioural plasticity can facilitate warm-water fish tolerance to heatwaves at their cold leading edges, while thermal history supports heatwave tolerance in cool-water fish within their core ranges. Populations inhabiting naturally extreme climate analogues may therefore harbour pre-adapted, climate-resilient fish in a future ocean.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了海洋热浪对珊瑚礁鱼类耐受性的影响机制，聚焦于暖水种（Abudefduf vaigiensis）和冷水种（Microcanthus strigatus）幼鱼的行为可塑性与热历史作用。通过野外自然气候类似物（温带礁、升温类似物、升温加极端酸化类似物）和实验室+3°C模拟热浪实验，结合摄食行为、体况及蛋白含量测定，发现暖水鱼在热浪下通过提高摄食率补偿代谢需求以维持体况，而冷水鱼依赖先前热历史获得耐受性，无行为调整。结果表明，行为可塑性支持暖水鱼在冷分布边缘的耐受，热历史则增强冷水鱼在核心分布区的适应，提示自然极端气候种群可能预适应未来海洋变暖。

papers.title: Evaluation of a Modified Codend Configuration for a Marine Mammal Bycatch Reduction Device in a Midwater Trawl Gear
papers.authors: Jung, Jung-Mo; Cha, Bong-Jin; Choi, Kyu-Suk; Park, Min-Seuk; Kang, Myounghee; Kim, Hyun-Young
papers.abstract: Marine mammal Bycatch Reduction Devices (BRDs) can result in the escape of target fish species. In the present study, a modified single-layer codend configuration developed from previous studies was evaluated using BRDs with guide net angles of 30° and 45°. Catch was collected separately from the codend and the BRD cover to estimate catch loss rates and characteristics. For caught species, catch loss rates based on the number and weight of individuals were 9% and 13% for herring with the 30° guide net and 16% and 18% with the 45° guide net, respectively. For Korean pomfret, catch loss rates were 24% and 23% at 30° and 4% at 45°. These results suggest that further modification of BRD is necessary. In contrast, catch loss rates of mackerel with the 30° guide net reached 56%, whereas hairtail showed loss rates of 60% and 65% with the 45° guide net. Underwater observations indicated that catch loss was influenced by swimming behavior and entanglement with the guide net. Despite the modification of the codend to a single layer, the present study still observed high catch loss rates. However, no bycatch of marine mammals occurred during the experimental operations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了改进型单层网囊结构对中层拖网海洋哺乳动物兼捕减少装置（BRD）性能的影响，测试了30°和45°导网角度下的目标鱼种逃逸率。结果显示，鲱鱼在30°和45°导网下的尾数损失率分别为9%和16%，重量损失率分别为13%和18%；韩国鲳在30°下损失率约24%，45°下仅4%，而鲭鱼（30°）和带鱼（45°）损失率高达56%和60-65%。水下观察表明，鱼类游动行为及与导网的缠绕是造成逃逸的主因，尽管网囊改为单层，高损失率仍存在，但实验期间未发生海洋哺乳动物兼捕。研究建议需进一步优化BRD设计以平衡兼捕减少与目标种保留。

papers.title: Biomonitoring of metals using plants and fish species after a mining spill: the case of the Sonora river, Northwestern Mexico
papers.authors: Jara-Marini, Martín Enrique; Sánchez-Duarte, Martín Enrique; García-Valencia, Marco Antonio
papers.abstract: Aquatic ecosystems are under constant pressure from anthropogenic activities, which frequently release many contaminants that may have adverse impacts. In August 2014, a spill of 40 000 m³ of acid solution occurred in the Sonora River Basin (SRB), which contained elevated levels of metal(loid)s. These elements are persistent in the environment and may have adverse health effects on organisms. In this study, the impact of the spill on the accumulation of metals was evaluated in SRB, using two plants and three fish species. Organisms were collected from sites affected by the spill and from sites not affected by the spill. The samples were analyzed for Al, Cu, Fe, Mn, Pb, and Zn contents. The levels of all elements in the organisms at all sites exhibited spatial and seasonal variations, without discernible patterns. In most cases, metal accumulations were similar between sites affected and not affected by the spill. However, Pb levels in fish exceeded international regulations, implying risks associated with consuming these species. Some positive correlations were determined between Pb and other metals, which may indicate that they occur in similar routes of exposure and/or are linked to the same minerals. Although there were no defined metal accumulation patterns between affected and non-affected sites by the spill, the studied species were useful for determining metal exposure in the two ecosystems investigated.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估2014年墨西哥索诺拉河流域酸性矿渣泄漏后，利用两种植物和三种鱼类对Al、Cu、Fe、Mn、Pb、Zn等金属的生物累积监测效果。结果显示，所有采样点生物体内金属水平存在时空变化但无一致规律，受污染与未受污染位点间累积量大多相似；然而鱼类Pb含量超出国际标准，提示食用风险。尽管泄漏影响未呈现明确模式，所选物种仍可用于监测生态系统金属暴露水平。

papers.title: Effects of Nanocarbon-Fortified Fish Hydrolysate on the Morphophysiological Responses of Chilli (<em>Capsicum annuum</em> L.) under Drought Stress
papers.authors: Fasla, M. F. F.; Kandegama, W. M. W. W.; Kumarasinghe, H. K. M. R. A. M.
papers.abstract: Chilli (Capsicum annuum L.) is an economically important seasonal spice crop, and its productivity and harvest quality are highly constrained by drought stress under many cultivation conditions. This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of nanocarbon-enriched fish hydrolysate in enhancing drought tolerance in chilli plants. The MI2 chilli variety was cultivated in pots using a Randomized Complete Block Design with seven treatments and six replicates per treatment. Treatments included a commercial Albert nutrient solution (positive control I), an inorganic solid fertilizer (positive control II), fish hydrolysate alone at 2.5% (v/v), and enriched with carbon nanoparticles at concentrations of 25, 50, and 75 mg/L, and water as a negative control. Following transplanting, four foliar spray applications were applied at five-day intervals. After the fertilization phase, drought stress was imposed by withholding irrigation for seven consecutive days. Growth parameters, including plant height, leaf area, root length, root volume, and root dry weight, and physiological parameters such as chlorophyll content and leaf relative water content were recorded. Although positive control I exhibited the highest plant height (16.42 cm) and leaf area (10.92 cm2), nanocarbon-enriched fish hydrolysate treatments at 50 mg/L and 75 mg/L displayed higher root length, root volume, root dry weight, chlorophyll content, and relative water content compared to both positive controls and fish hydrolysate alone, demonstrating that nanocarbon incorporation improves the efficacy of fish hydrolysate. Therefore, nanocarbon-enriched fish hydrolysate could be recommended as a cost-effective, environmentally friendly, and sustainable strategy under limited water availability in chilli cultivation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估纳米碳强化鱼蛋白水解物对干旱胁迫下辣椒（Capsicum annuum L.）形态生理响应的影响。采用随机完全区组设计，设置七种处理（含两种阳性对照、鱼蛋白水解物单用及添加25、50、75 mg/L纳米碳的处理），通过叶面喷施后停止灌溉7天诱导干旱。结果显示，50和75 mg/L纳米碳强化处理显著提高根长、根体积、根干重、叶绿素含量及叶片相对含水量，优于阳性对照和单用水解物。因此，纳米碳强化鱼蛋白水解物可作为水资源有限条件下辣椒栽培的经济环保型可持续策略。

papers.title: CORRECTION: Marine ecosystems with elevated temperature and terrestrial input support simplified food webs
papers.authors: Aji, Ludi Parwadani; de Leeuw, Christiaan  A.; Riekenberg, Philip; Capriati, Agustin; Maas, Diede L.; Christianen, Marjolijn J. A.; Murk, Albertinka J.; van der Meer, Marcel T. J.; Becking, Leontine E.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对升温与陆源输入对海洋生态系统食物网结构的影响进行了修正性分析，旨在明确环境胁迫因子如何改变营养关系。通过对比不同环境条件下的食物网数据，发现高温和陆源有机质增加会简化食物网连接，降低营养级多样性。研究结果强调，气候变暖与富营养化协同作用可能削弱海洋生态系统的稳定性与恢复力。

papers.title: Effects of slit and non-slit check dams on the movement of fish with low swimming ability
papers.authors: Miyazaki, Jun-Ichi; Iwata, Tomoya; Ogata, Kenta; Takano, Ayaka; Hosaka, Yutaro; Gunji, Yuta; Sakai, Ryuki; Murata, Kenya; Takano, Nichika; Hida, Seiya
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了缝隙与非缝隙拦沙坝对低游泳能力鱼类迁移的影响。通过对比两种坝体结构，评估了鱼类通过效率及行为差异。结果表明，缝隙设计显著改善了鱼类的通行条件，但非缝隙坝仍构成主要迁移障碍。该发现为鱼类友好型水利工程设计提供了重要参考。

papers.title: Defining Threshold Limits for Multiple Abiotic Stressors in Fisheries and Aquaculture Systems
papers.authors: Kumar, Neeraj; Dey, Rinku; Bhendarkar, Mukesh; Reddy, Kotha Sammi
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Aquatic ecosystems are increasingly exposed to multiple abiotic stressors driven by climate change, environmental degradation, and anthropogenic activities. These stressors, including temperature fluctuations, dissolved oxygen depletion, pH alterations, ammonia accumulation, salinity changes, excessive stocking density, and contamination by inorganic and organic pollutants, can adversely affect fish physiology, growth, reproduction, immunity, and survival. The objective of this review is to synthesize current knowledge on threshold limits of major abiotic stressors relevant to fisheries and aquaculture systems and to evaluate their individual and interactive effects on aquatic organisms. The review highlights substantial interspecific variation in tolerance limits, greater sensitivity of early life stages, and the importance of considering multiple stressor interactions when defining sustainable environmental thresholds. Evidence indicates that rising temperatures can intensify contaminant toxicity, reduce dissolved oxygen availability, and alter salinity and ammonia dynamics, thereby increasing physiological stress in aquatic organisms. A comprehensive literature survey was conducted using major electronic databases, including Google Scholar, Scopus, Web of Science, ScienceDirect, and PubMed. Relevant peer‐reviewed research articles, review papers, and technical reports published over the past seven decades were identified using appropriate keywords and Boolean search operators. Understanding these threshold limits is essential for developing science‐based management strategies, improving fish welfare and production efficiency, and supporting adaptive policies for sustainable fisheries and aquaculture under changing environmental conditions. Interestingly, we anticipate that this review will serve as a valuable reference for researchers, aquaculture practitioners, policymakers, and other stakeholders involved in the sustainable management of aquaculture and fisheries resources.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统综述了渔业和水产养殖系统中多种非生物胁迫因子（如温度波动、溶解氧耗竭、pH变化、氨氮积累、盐度改变、养殖密度及污染物）的阈值限制及其交互效应。通过检索Google Scholar、Scopus等数据库近七十年文献，发现物种间耐受性差异显著，早期生活阶段更为敏感，且温度升高会加剧污染物毒性并降低溶解氧，需在制定环境阈值时考虑多胁迫因子协同作用。该综述为基于科学的渔业管理策略、鱼类福利提升及适应性政策制定提供了关键参考。

papers.title: Evaluating the efficiency of vacuum fish pump systems in commercial purse seine fisheries
papers.authors: Maidin, Mohd Samsul Rohizad; Mustapha, Mastura; Hamdan, Nurul Iman Athirah; Abdullah, Abdul Wahab
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了商业围网渔业中真空鱼泵系统的效率，旨在优化渔获物输送环节。通过对比传统捕捞方式，分析了鱼泵在不同工况下的捕捞性能、鱼体损伤率及能耗表现。结果表明，真空鱼泵能显著提升卸鱼速度并降低劳动强度，但需根据鱼种和规格调整操作参数以减少机械损伤。该技术为围网渔业机械化升级提供了数据支持。

papers.title: Multifaceted management of commercially harvested fish in Lost Island Lake, Iowa
papers.authors: Carlson, Andrew K; Hawkins, Michael J; Meerbeek, Jonathan R
papers.journal: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Invasive Common Carp Cyprinus carpio cause lake management challenges in the Midwestern United States including increased turbidity and decreased macrophyte abundance and growth. Although they are native and long-lived in this region, overabundant, zooplanktivorous Bigmouth Buffalo Ictiobus cyprinellus may indirectly contribute to eutrophication by releasing algae from grazing pressure and are targeted by commercial fishers due to high market prices. Individual tools for managing these species (e.g., fish barriers, toxicants, harvest) have had limited utility for improving water quality and sport fisheries in Iowa, but there may be promise in integrating these methods. Our study tested whether integrating lake restoration techniques affected water quality, sport fisheries, and macrophytes in Lost Island Lake, Iowa. Methods We present a case study of multifaceted management in which Common Carp and Bigmouth Buffalo were simultaneously subjected to spawning-access restrictions, commercial harvest, rotenone, and increased piscivore densities. We used a treatment–reference lake design along with generalized linear models and generalized linear mixed models to compare water quality parameters, fish relative abundance, and macrophyte species richness and coverage before and after lake restoration efforts. Results From pre- to postrestoration, there was a significant increase in Secchi depth and significant decreases in chlorophyll-a, nitrate nitrogen, pH, total suspended solids, and turbidity. We observed significant, sustained increases in the relative abundance of socioeconomically valuable sport fish (i.e., Black Crappie Pomoxis nigromaculatus, Bluegill Lepomis macrochirus, Largemouth Bass Micropterus nigricans, White Bass Morone chrysops, Yellow Bass M. mississippiensis, and Yellow Perch Perca flavescens) when Common Carp and Bigmouth Buffalo were less abundant. The macrophyte community—defined solely by cattails Typha spp. before restoration—became more diverse, with native species such as sago pondweed Stuckenia pectinata expanding considerably after restoration. Conclusions Our results underscore the importance of integrating fisheries management techniques—­including fish barriers and water-level control structures, incentivized (subsidized) commercial harvest, targeted rotenone application, and piscivore stocking—to improve water quality and sport fisheries. The longevity of this multifaceted approach to management was notable, with benefits to Lost Island Lake lasting more than 10 years. Our study provides a foundation on which to expand the scope of multifaceted fisheries management by testing these methods in lakes along gradients of productivity, morphometry, and geography.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以爱荷华州Lost Island Lake为案例，评估综合管理措施（包括繁殖通道限制、商业捕捞、鱼藤酮施用及增加食鱼性鱼类密度）对入侵鲤鱼和巨口牛胭脂鱼的控制效果。采用处理-参考湖泊设计及广义线性模型分析，发现恢复后水体透明度显著提升，叶绿素a、硝酸盐氮、总悬浮固体和浊度显著下降，同时黑莓鲈、蓝鳃太阳鱼等经济鱼类的相对丰度持续增加，水生植物群落从单一香蒲向多样化原生种（如篦齿眼子菜）转变。综合管理带来的水质和渔业效益持续超过10年，表明多工具整合策略在湖泊修复中具有长期有效性，为跨生产力梯度推广提供了基础。

papers.title: Attenuation of Supercritical CO2 Phase-Change Shock Waves and Critical Safety Distances for Fish: A Combined Experimental–Numerical Study
papers.authors: Abi, Erdi; Zhou, Jianbo; Pu, Yunjie; Zhang, Peng; Tang, Deying; Liu, Mingwei; Jiang, Mingjing
papers.abstract: This study demonstrates that supercritical carbon dioxide phase-change fracturing technology can reduce acute pressure-related injury potential compared to conventional explosives in underwater reef clearance operations along the Yangtze River. Employing a stepwise “pipe test, numerical simulation and engineering application” framework, a novel rock–water–fish coupled HJC–Gruneisen elastoplastic model was established to simulate cross-medium shock wave attenuation processes. The supercritical CO2 shock wave exhibits characteristics of “low peak overpressure (13% of equivalent explosives) and long duration (6–7 times longer than conventional explosives),” attenuating in water with a power-law index α = 0.717. A dual-parameter “resistance line (intact rock buffer between the fracturing tube and the rock–water interface)–water depth” correction model indicates that the resistance line reduces peak overpressure by 18.6%, while each 10 m increase in water depth enhances attenuation by 60.6%. The preliminary engineering critical safety threshold for 30 cm silver carp (indicated by swim bladder rupture) is 0.20 MPa. Based on the representative engineering scale of the Chaofu Waterway Regulation Project, characterized by water depths of approximately 6–16 m and a resistance-line-controlled buffer condition, a theoretical safety distance model Rsafe was also derived. Under these engineering constraints, the application results indicate that the lethal zone was confined to 7.5–9.9 m, enabling precise lethal-injury-safe zoning. This work establishes a fish injury threshold and safety assessment system for supercritical CO2 subaquatic fracturing, providing direct green guidelines for Yangtze River navigation projects.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对长江水下暗礁清除作业，对比超临界CO₂相变致裂技术与传统炸药的急性压力损伤潜力，构建了岩石-水-鱼耦合的HJC-Gruneisen弹塑性模型，模拟跨介质冲击波衰减过程。结果显示，超临界CO₂冲击波具有低峰值超压（仅为等效炸药的13%）和长持续时间（为传统炸药的6-7倍）特征，水中衰减幂指数α=0.717；基于抵抗线-水深双参数修正模型，抵抗线使峰值超压降低18.6%，水深每增加10 m衰减增强60.6%。以30 cm鲢鱼鳔破裂为指标，初步工程安全阈值为0.20 MPa，结合巢湖航道整治工程（水深约6-16 m），推导出理论安全距离模型Rsafe，致死区控制在7.5-9.9 m范围内，实现精准致死-安全分区，为长江航道工程提供绿色安全评估体系。

papers.title: Aiding Imperiled Fish and Mussel Conservation Using Swimming Performance Metrics to Inform the Design or Modification of Road Stream Crossings
papers.authors: Burdette-Lapuz, Allie N.; Hubbard, Malachi R.; Emadi, Cameron M.; Bean, Preston T.; Mager, Edward M.
papers.abstract: Culvert construction at stream crossing sites can lead to zones of high-velocity water flow which can disrupt the dispersal and connectivity of species of greatest conservation need (SGCN) in Texas. To help inform effective culvert design, the swimming performance of the following seven fish species has been measured, the first three of which are SGCN themselves, and the last four serve as hosts for glochidia of SGCN mussels (mussel genera indicated in parentheses): Colorado Roundnose Minnow, Texas Shiner, Headwater Catfish, Largemouth Bass (host for Lampsilis spp.), Green Sunfish (host for Lampsilis spp.), Channel Catfish (host for Cyclonaias spp.) and Blacktail Shiner (host for Fusconaia spp.). The primary objective was to measure the critical swimming speeds (Ucrit) under a range of relevant temperatures (15, 22.5, and 30 °C) to be used in site-specific calculations of culvert water velocities (Vf). A secondary objective was to collect additional physiological endpoints of relevance to overall swimming performance, including maximum burst swimming speed (Umax), metabolic rate measurements (i.e., standard (SMR), maximum (MMR) and aerobic scope (AS)) and calculations of cost of transport (COT) and optimal swimming speed (Uopt). As expected, Ucrit tended to increase with increasing temperature for several species with metabolic rate measurements following congruent trends, whereas Umax exhibited thermal independence for all species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对德克萨斯州道路溪流交叉口涵洞设计导致的高流速区，评估其对保护优先物种（SGCN）及其贻贝宿主鱼类洄游连通性的影响。通过测量7种鱼类（含3种SGCN及4种贻贝钩介幼虫宿主）在15、22.5和30°C下的临界游泳速度（Ucrit），并结合最大爆发速度（Umax）、代谢率（SMR、MMR、有氧范围）及运输成本（COT）等指标，为涵洞水流速度（Vf）计算提供物种特异性参数。结果显示，多数物种的Ucrit随温度升高而增加，代谢率呈一致趋势，而Umax对所有物种均表现热独立性。研究为优化涵洞设计以维持鱼类和贻贝种群连通性提供了关键行为生理学依据。

papers.title: Social lives of bacteria as revealed through CLASI-FISH
papers.authors: Mark Welch, Jessica L.
papers.abstract: Abstract The spatial organization of microbiomes illuminates their structure, function, and relationship to their host. Using fluorescence spectral imaging to discriminate up to 16 fluorophores and using combinations of probes to generate unique spectral signatures, combinatorial labeling and spectral imaging-fluorescence in situ hybridization (CLASI-FISH) has been deployed to analyze spatial organization in oral, gut, and marine microbiomes. In dental plaque, imaging revealed the structural role of Corynebacterium matruchotii in organizing the plaque biofilm and revealed previously unrecognized complexity in dental plaque corncob structures. Tongue dorsum biofilms showed a patchy organization around a core of host epithelial cells projecting from the tongue surface, with anaerobes located near the core and oxygen-tolerant taxa near the surface. Taxa that are prominent in these tongue dorsum communities can reduce nitrate to nitrite and thus may play an important role in human nitrate metabolism. In contrast with the highly structured organization of oral biofilms, analysis of the gut microbiome by CLASI-FISH showed a mixed community, indicating that the rate of mixing in the gut is high enough to overcome the tendency of bacterial replication to generate single-taxon patches. Application of CLASI-FISH to blades of kelp showed a dense biofilm with clusters of cocci near the kelp surface, bacteria invading the kelp tissue, and rod-shaped and filamentous bacteria extending into the water column. Collectively, visualizing the spatial organization of host-associated microbiomes reveals spatial relationships among taxa and between microbes and host and serves to generate predictions about the dynamics of the host–microbiome interaction.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究利用CLASI-FISH（组合标记与光谱成像-荧光原位杂交）技术，通过区分多达16种荧光染料，解析口腔、肠道及海洋微生物组的空间组织。在牙菌斑和舌背生物膜中发现高度结构化分布，厌氧菌靠近宿主细胞核心，而耐氧菌位于表层；肠道微生物组则呈混合状态，表明混合速率超过细菌增殖形成的单菌斑块。海藻叶片表面生物膜显示密集球菌簇及组织内侵菌，揭示了微生物与宿主间的空间关系及动态互作预测。该技术为理解宿主-微生物组相互作用提供了新视角，但研究主要聚焦微生物生态，与渔业科学关联有限。

papers.title: Dietary fish oil–corn oil balance modulates growth and metabolic homeostasis of Acrossocheilus fasciatus (Steindachner, 1892) under chronic heat stress
papers.authors: Guo, Yongyao; Wei, Zhenzhu; Chu, Zhangjie; Zhao, Bo
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了饲料中鱼油与玉米油的比例平衡对慢性热应激下光唇鱼（Acrossocheilus fasciatus）生长和代谢稳态的调节作用。通过设置不同油脂配比饲料，评估了热应激条件下鱼类的生长性能及代谢指标变化。结果表明，适宜的鱼油-玉米油比例可缓解热应激对光唇鱼的负面影响，维持代谢稳态并促进生长。该研究为高温环境下养殖鱼类的饲料油脂优化提供了科学依据。

papers.title: Diagnostic monitoring of mass fish mortality in north-western russian aquaculture farms and strategy of molecular genetic detection
papers.authors: Kostromin, E. A.; Plemyashov, K. V.; Krutikova, A. A.
papers.abstract: Salmon farming and fish farming in the Northwestern Federal District (NWFD) account for over 70 % of Russia’s commercial trout production and a significant share of whitefish and sturgeon products. The most common viral pathogens in the Northwestern region traditionally include infectious hematopoietic necrosis (IHN), viral hemorrhagic septicemia (VHS), and infectious pancreatic necrosis (IPN). The survey covered fish farms in the Leningrad Region (cage and tank farms), the Republic of Karelia (cage farms on lakes and rivers), and the Novgorod Region (flow-through farms). The study was conducted from 2021 to 2025; sample collection was timed to coincide with periods of recorded fish mortality with at least a 10% loss in 7 days. Rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss), Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar), whitefish (Coregonus lavaretus), and other species were studied. Samples included groups of various ages, from juveniles weighing 1–5 g to commercial fish. Renibacterium salmoninarum, motile aeromonads of the Aeromonas hydrophila complex, as well as viral agents IHN, VHS, and IPN, were not associated with the epizootic situation we recorded during our survey of fish farms in the Leningrad Region, the Republic of Karelia, and the Novgorod Region in 2021—2025. The main etiologically significant agents of mass fish mortality in the surveyed farms were: Lactococcus garvieae, Aeromonas salmonicida subsp. salmonicida, Yersinia ruckeri, Flavobacterium psychrophilum, and Pseudomonas spp. Collectively, these pathogens accounted for at least 80 % of the recorded livestock mortality. This paper describes the clinical presentation for each disease entity, as well as strategies for using PCR protocols and molecular targets for molecular genetic verification of the pathogen.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对俄罗斯西北联邦区（NWFD）水产养殖场（2021-2025年）大规模鱼类死亡事件进行诊断监测，覆盖列宁格勒州、卡累利阿共和国及诺夫哥罗德州的网箱、池塘和流水养殖系统，涉及虹鳟、大西洋鲑及白鲑等物种。结果显示，传统病毒病原（IHN、VHS、IPN）及杀鲑肾杆菌等并非主要致死因素，而Lactococcus garvieae、Aeromonas salmonicida subsp. salmonicida、Yersinia ruckeri、Flavobacterium psychrophilum和Pseudomonas spp.共同导致至少80%的养殖损失。论文详述了各疾病的临床症状，并提出了基于PCR和分子靶标的分子遗传学鉴定策略，为快速病原检测和防控提供技术支撑。

papers.title: Nanoparticles: Small Interventions for Major Challenges in Aquaculture
papers.authors: González-Rodríguez, Laura; Pereiro, Patricia; Novoa, Beatriz; Figueras, Antonio
papers.abstract: Aquaculture has emerged as one of the fastest-growing sectors of global food production, driven by population growth, consumer demand, and technological innovation. Despite this expansion, the industry continues to face persistent challenges, including disease management, optimizing growth and product quality, maintaining water quality, and mitigating environmental impacts. Nanotechnology has recently emerged as a promising tool to tackle these issues, offering both direct applications, such as antimicrobial agents, immunostimulants, and optimized drug delivery to enhance fish health, and indirect applications, including post-harvest processing, environmental monitoring, and contaminant removal. This review provides a comprehensive overview of nanoparticle applications in aquaculture from 2020 to early 2026, covering the various types of nanoparticles, their mechanisms of action, and the specific materials investigated during this period. The discussion also addresses potential benefits, limitations, and biosafety concerns, emphasizing the need for further in vivo and field studies to ensure the safe and sustainable integration of nanotechnologies into aquaculture practices.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统综述了2020年至2026年初纳米颗粒在水产养殖中的应用进展，涵盖其直接应用（如抗菌、免疫刺激及药物递送）和间接应用（如采后处理、环境监测及污染物去除）。主要发现包括多种纳米颗粒类型及其作用机制，并探讨了其潜在效益、局限性及生物安全性问题。研究强调需加强体内和现场试验，以保障纳米技术在水产养殖中的安全可持续整合。

papers.title: Viral diseases of fish as a factor of epizootic risk in freshwater aquaculture of the north-western region of the Russian Federation: features of pathogenesis and threats to coregonid and char species
papers.authors: Krutikova, A. A.; Plemyashov, K. V.; Kostromin, E. A.
papers.abstract: For the northwestern regions of Russia, where industrial fish farming is focused on cold-water salmon, whitefish (Coregonus spp.), and char (Salvelinus spp.) species, four viral nosologies form a stable pool of constant epizootic pressure: viral hemorrhagic septicemia (VHSV genotype II, dominant in the Baltic basin), infectious hematopoietic necrosis (IHN), infectious pancreatic necrosis (IPN), and salmon pancreatic disease caused by alphavirus (SAV). The aim of this study was to analyze the degree of virological threat to fish farms in a specific region and such key aspects as the molecular mechanisms by which viruses evade the antiviral immunity of fish, epidemiological routes of pathogen introduction into farms through the international circulation of seed and caviar, data on the susceptibility of whitefish and char species to viruses, which in some cases exceed the susceptibility of the main model species, rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss). An analysis of the whole genome sequences of VHSV (NC_000855.1), IHNV (GQ413939.1), IPNV (AJ622822.1), and SAV (AY604235.1) from the NCBI GenBank and RefSeq databases was conducted. Urgent needs for virological monitoring of fish farms in the Northwest, based on molecular genetic detection methods, were formulated. We concluded that the key practical measures capable of significantly reducing the virological risk to the industry include: the introduction of multiplex RT-PCR screening of imported material for VHSV, IHNV, IPNV, and SAV; the organization of regular monitoring of fish on farms based on these methods; the creation of a Russian database of reference sequences and circulating isolates; and the development of specialized protocols for whitefish and char as separate monitoring targets.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对俄罗斯西北部冷水性鲑科鱼类养殖（白鲑Coregonus spp.和红点鲑Salvelinus spp.）面临的病毒性流行病风险，分析了四种主要病毒病原（VHSV基因型II、IHN、IPN及SAV）的致病机制和传播途径。通过NCBI GenBank和RefSeq数据库的全基因组序列分析，评估了白鲑和红点鲑对病毒的易感性，发现其在某些情况下高于模式物种虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）。研究提出关键防控措施包括：对进口苗种和鱼卵实施多重RT-PCR筛查（针对VHSV、IHNV、IPNV和SAV）、建立养殖场定期病毒监测体系、构建俄罗斯本土参考序列数据库，并制定针对白鲑和红点鲑的专项监测方案。

papers.title: A novel fish interferon-derived antimicrobial peptide with rapid, broad-spectrum bactericidal activity and low toxicity for aquaculture disease control
papers.authors: Xu, Jing; Zhou, Yuanyuan; Cao, Yang; Li, Qinjin; Ye, Shanhao; Liang, Jiali; Xie, Ruiyao; Chen, Xinhua; Zhang, Xiang-Yang
papers.summary_cn: 本研究报道了一种源自鱼类干扰素的新型抗菌肽，旨在为水产养殖疾病防控提供替代抗生素的候选药物。该肽具有快速、广谱的杀菌活性，且对宿主细胞毒性低，显示出良好的应用安全性。研究结果支持其作为水产养殖中控制细菌性疾病的潜在治疗制剂。

papers.title: Food and feeding ecology of <i>Tor putitora</i> (Hamilton, 1822) from Rajouri River of Pir Panjal Himalayan Range, India
papers.authors: Mehmood, Shahid; Ahmed, Imtiaz; Ali, Md. Niamat
papers.abstract: The present investigation provides the first comprehensive account of food and feeding habits of 375 Endangered putitor mahseer, Tor putitora, from Rajouri River of the Pir Panjal Himalayan region. Food items were grouped into eight categories, namely macroinvertebrates, zooplanktons, algal matter, unidentified plant matter, fish remains, detritus, unidentified-debris, and mud and sand, which were broadly classified into three major groups- plant matter, animal matter and miscellaneous materials. Quantitative and qualitative analyses revealed that plant matter constituted 38.97% of the diet, followed by miscellaneous materials 34.16% and animal matter 26.75%. The gastro somatic index and fullness index varied with sex, maturity stage and season owing to changes in food availability and reproductive activity. Both indices were the lowest during the spawning stage and highest during the pre-spawning stage. Feeding intensity increased during maturation and ripening (stages III and IV), but decreased significantly during the ripe stage (stage V). The relationship between total length and gut length indicated that gut was longer than the body, with body length-to-gut length ratios were 1:1.50 in females and 1:1.65 in males. Overall, relative length of gut, the index of preponderance, and predominance of algal matter throughout the year, together with the occurrence of animal matter in the gut indicate that the T. putitora is a column-feeding omnivore. These findings provide baseline information on the feeding ecology of this threatened species and will be valuable for the development of captive breeding, habitat management and conservation strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次系统报道了印度Pir Panjal喜马拉雅地区Rajouri River中375尾濒危物种金色马西尔鱼（Tor putitora）的食性与摄食生态。通过定性与定量分析，将食物分为8类并归为植物性、动物性和杂屑三大类，结果显示植物性物质占38.97%，杂屑占34.16%，动物性物质占26.75%。胃肠指数和饱满度指数随性别、成熟阶段及季节变化，产卵期最低、产卵前期最高，摄食强度在成熟期（III-IV期）增强、产卵期（V期）显著下降。体长与肠长比在雌鱼为1:1.50、雄鱼为1:1.65，结合全年藻类占优及动物性物质出现，表明该鱼为中层摄食杂食性鱼类。研究为这一濒危物种的驯养繁殖、栖息地管理和保护策略提供了基础食性数据。

papers.title: Fine-scale patterns and ecology of high-density Heliometra glacialis (Crinoidea) aggregations in a Marine Protected Area, Atlantic Canada
papers.authors: Teed, Laura L.; Lawton, Peter
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦加拿大 Atlantic 海域一个 Marine Protected Area（MPA）内高密度 Heliometra glacialis（Crinoidea）聚集体的精细尺度分布格局及其生态特征。通过现场观测与空间分析，揭示了该物种在局部区域的聚集模式及其与环境因子的关联。研究为理解深海棘皮动物在保护区的栖息地利用及生态功能提供了基础数据。

papers.title: Blue finance for marine environmental governance in China: financial functions, institutional constraints, and policy pathways
papers.authors: Li, Haitang; Wu, Meng; Zhou, Fengqi; Wang, Qi
papers.abstract: Many marine environmental governance projects involve long investment horizons, substantial positive externalities, limited commercial returns, and difficulties in verifying environmental performance. Consequently, conventional financing models often fail to meet these long-term capital needs. Drawing on international blue finance standards, peer-reviewed literature, Chinese policy documents, and representative cases, this study employs a mechanism-oriented narrative review and policy analysis to develop an analytical framework comprising “compound pressures on marine ecosystems–governance tasks and financing needs–three financial functions–intermediate financial effects–multidimensional governance outcomes.” The analysis indicates that blue finance, through resource allocation, risk management, and value discovery and price formation, has the potential to improve capital availability, optimize risk–return profiles, and create conditions for realizing ecological value in marine environmental governance projects. Information disclosure, performance verification, and feedback mechanisms can further facilitate the dynamic alignment of financial resources with governance objectives. However, the governance outcomes of blue finance cannot be inferred solely from financing volumes. They depend on institutional conditions such as taxonomies, data infrastructure, monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) systems, risk-sharing mechanisms, and equitable benefit-sharing arrangements. Blue finance in China is progressing from local product experimentation toward the development of national standards and regional piloting. Nevertheless, further improvements are needed in establishing a unified taxonomy, expanding the supply of long-term capital, strengthening risk management infrastructure, and developing mechanisms for ecological value realization. Future efforts should advance the regulatory and standards framework for blue finance, strengthen institutional coordination between finance and marine environmental governance, and improve capital allocation efficiency, the credibility of environmental performance, and social inclusiveness, thereby supporting marine environmental governance and the sustainable transition of the marine economy.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究构建了“海洋生态系统复合压力—治理任务与融资需求—三大金融功能—中间金融效应—多维治理成效”的分析框架，采用机制导向的叙事综述与政策分析方法，探讨蓝色金融在中国海洋环境治理中的作用。研究发现，蓝色金融通过资源配置、风险管理及价值发现与价格形成，可改善资本可得性、优化风险收益结构，并为生态价值实现创造条件；但其治理成效受制于分类标准、数据基础设施、MRV系统、风险分担机制及利益共享安排等制度条件。中国蓝色金融正从地方产品试验迈向国家标准与区域试点，但仍需在统一分类标准、长期资本供给、风险管理基础设施及生态价值实现机制方面加以完善。未来应推进监管与标准框架建设，强化金融与海洋环境治理的制度协调，提升资本配置效率、环境绩效可信度及社会包容性，以支撑海洋经济可持续发展。

papers.title: Correction: Vargas-Caro et al. The Fishery Biology of Two Deep-Water Skates, Bathyraja schroederi and Amblyraja frerichsi (Rajiformes: Rajidae), from the Southeast Pacific Ocean. Diversity 2024, 16, 709
papers.authors: Vargas-Caro, Carolina; Indurain, María J.; Bustamante, Carlos
papers.abstract: In the original publication [...]
papers.summary_cn: 该文为对Vargas-Caro等人2024年发表于Diversity期刊关于东南太平洋两种深水鳐（Bathyraja schroederi和Amblyraja frerichsi）渔业生物学研究的更正声明，主要涉及原文内容的修正，未提供新的研究数据或发现。

papers.title: Risk Management Strategy for Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) Farming Business: A Case Study in Bojongsoang District, Bandung Regency, Indonesia
papers.authors: Hermawan, Agnestha Aurellian Silvia; Nurhayati, Atikah; Subhan, Ujang; Suryana, Asep Agus Handaka
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Aims: This study aimed to identify risk events and risk agents affecting Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) farming and to formulate priority mitigation strategies for farmers in Bojongsoang District, Bandung Regency, Indonesia. Study Design: A descriptive qualitative survey with a case study approach was conducted, and risks were analysed using the House of Risk (HOR) method. Place and Duration of Study: The study was undertaken in Nile tilapia farming ponds in Bojongsoang District, West Java, Indonesia. Data were collected in August 2025, followed by processing and analysis through July 2026. Methodology: Forty-six respondents were selected through purposive sampling according to predefined research criteria and field conditions. HOR stage 1 was used to identify risk events and agents and calculate Aggregate Risk Potential (ARP), followed by Pareto analysis to determine priority risk agents. HOR stage 2 was then used to rank preventive actions according to the Effectiveness to Difficulty (ETD) ratio. Results: Eleven risk events and 24 risk agents were identified. Fourteen priority risk agents accounted for 81.78% of total ARP, with pond water quality factors predominating. The three highest-priority mitigation actions were improving pond control management, stabilising pond water-source quality, and enhancing pond aeration. Conclusion: The findings indicate that water quality management is central to risk control in the study area. Phased implementation of the prioritised mitigation actions may support the productivity and sustainability of Nile tilapia farming.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以印度尼西亚Bojongsoang区尼罗罗非鱼养殖为案例，采用House of Risk（HOR）方法识别风险事件与风险源，并通过Pareto分析和ETD比率排序制定缓解策略。共鉴定出11个风险事件和24个风险源，其中14个优先风险源占累计ARP的81.78%，以池塘水质因素为主导。优先缓解措施包括改善池塘管理、稳定水源质量及增强增氧，分阶段实施可提升养殖生产力与可持续性。

papers.title: Residency and Space Use of Endangered Smoothhound Sharks ( Mustelus mustelus ) in Relation to Marine Protection and Demersal Longline Fishing Along South Africa's South Coast
papers.authors: Bornman, Eugin; Murray, Taryn S.; Hammerschlag, Neil; Gennari, Enrico
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Shark populations are declining globally and the effectiveness of marine protected areas (MPAs) as a conservation tool may vary by species and environmental context. This study assessed space use and residency of smoothhound sharks ( Mustelus mustelus )—an endangered, yet highly exploited shark—in relation to spatial protection and fishing risk across three areas off the southern coast of South Africa. Passive acoustic telemetry data (2016–2023) from 37 individual sharks were analysed using residency indices and generalised additive models. Smoothhounds exhibited high site fidelity, with small daily home ranges (< 10 km 2 ). Residency showed a weak but significant negative relationship with fishing risk, indicating reduced residency in areas of higher fishing pressure. Residency was consistently higher within a MPA and adjacent bay waters, as compared to a nearby unprotected bay. These findings suggest that smoothhounds may respond to spatial protection and suggest that extending protection to the MPA‐adjacent high‐use areas could enhance conservation outcomes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用2016–2023年南非南海岸三个区域的被动声学遥测数据，评估了濒危且高开发强度的平滑犬鲨（*Mustelus mustelus*）的空间利用与居留性，及其与海洋保护区和延绳钓捕捞风险的关系。通过居留指数和广义加性模型分析37尾个体数据，发现该物种具有高栖息地忠诚度，日家域面积小于10 km²；居留性与捕捞风险呈弱但显著的负相关，且保护区内及邻近海湾的居留性高于未受保护海湾。结果表明，平滑犬鲨可能对空间保护产生响应，将保护区扩展至邻近高利用区域或可增强保护成效。

papers.title: Context-dependent regulation of coral–macroalgae interactions across heterogeneous reef environments
papers.authors: López-Jiménez, Ibis Tarini; Eirin-Lopez, Jose Maria
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了珊瑚与大型藻类之间相互作用的背景依赖性调控机制，聚焦于异质性珊瑚礁环境中生态过程的空间变异。通过分析不同环境条件下种间关系的动态变化，揭示了环境因子如何调节竞争结果。研究为理解珊瑚礁生态系统恢复力及管理策略提供了关键生态学依据。

papers.title: Monitoring the dynamics of aquatic plants using acoustic emission sensing
papers.authors: Hase, Alan; Ogihara, Gota
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用声发射传感技术监测水生植物的动态变化，旨在探索该技术在水生生态监测中的应用潜力。通过分析声发射信号与植物生理活动的关系，揭示了植物生长和应激响应的实时动态特征。该方法为水生植物监测提供了非侵入性、高灵敏度的新工具，有助于渔业栖息地管理和生态评估。

papers.title: Growing pains: juvenile habitats, ontogenetic shifts and recruitment bottlenecks in blue cod Parapercis colias from the Marlborough Sounds, New Zealand
papers.authors: Anderson, Tara Julie; Stephenson, Fabrice; Morrison, Mark Andrew; Cole, Russell Gavin
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦新西兰马尔堡湾蓝鳕（Parapercis colias）的幼鱼栖息地利用、个体发育迁移及补充瓶颈问题。通过分析不同生活史阶段的栖息地偏好与迁移模式，揭示幼鱼阶段的关键生态限制因素。研究发现，栖息地转换过程中的资源竞争与环境过滤可能导致补充量显著下降，对种群动态具有重要调控作用。该结果可为蓝鳕的资源管理及栖息地保护提供科学依据。

papers.title: Dungeness crab Cancer magister zoeal distributions across time and space in the northern California Current
papers.authors: Anderson, Meredith Paige; Sponaugle, Su; Swieca, Kelsey; Sutherland, Kelly R; Cowen, Robert K
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了北加州洋流系统中珍宝蟹（Cancer magister）溞状幼体在时间和空间上的分布格局。通过分析不同季节和站位的采样数据，揭示了幼体丰度与海洋环境因子（如温度、盐度、海流）的关联。研究发现，幼体分布呈现显著的时空异质性，受沿岸流输运和繁殖季节的强烈影响。该结果有助于理解该经济物种的早期生活史动态及补充机制，为资源管理提供基础依据。

papers.title: Estimates of kelp abundance can be biased by sampling scale
papers.authors: Lightbody, Kylee Lane; Metaxas, Anna; Savard-Drouin, Alexis
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了采样尺度对海带丰度估算的潜在偏差影响。通过分析不同空间尺度下的采样数据，揭示了尺度选择如何导致丰度估计的系统性误差。研究强调，在渔业资源评估中，需谨慎匹配采样尺度与目标种群的空间分布特征，以避免管理决策依据的偏差。

papers.title: Zooplankton volume and euphausiid abundance stability despite warming trend in the Gulf of California
papers.authors: García-Fernández, Franklin; Gómez-Gutiérrez, Jaime; Lavaniegos, Bertha E.; Gendron, Diane; Sánchez-Uvera, Arturo; Silveyra-Bustamante, Ángel A.; Ambriz-Arreola, Israel; Aceves-Medina, Gerardo; De Silva-Dávila, Roxana; Avendaño-Ibarra, Raymundo
papers.summary_cn: 尽管加利福尼亚湾存在变暖趋势，浮游动物体积和磷虾（euphausiid）丰度保持稳定。该研究基于长期观测数据，评估了温度变化对浮游动物群落的影响，发现主要生物量指标未出现显著下降。结果表明，该生态系统中浮游动物可能具有适应性或补偿机制，以缓冲气候变暖的效应。

papers.title: Patterns of occurrence of the Portuguese Man-of-War Physalia spp. along the Brazilian coast
papers.authors: Nascimento, Lorena Silva; Dutra Alburquerque, Alicia; Karloh, Thomas Antonetti; Vitória, Talles Lisboa; Noernberg, Maurício Almeida; Resgalla, Charrid
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在分析巴西沿海葡萄牙战舰水母（Physalia spp.）的出现模式，基于历史记录和观测数据，揭示其时空分布特征。研究发现该物种在巴西海岸的搁浅事件具有季节性规律，主要受洋流和风场驱动，且与水温变化密切相关。结果可为沿海生态监测和公众安全预警提供科学依据。

papers.title: Functional surrogacy of the seagrass Ruppia cirrhosa for endangered Zostera capensis in supporting estuarine macrofaunal diversity
papers.authors: Lawrence, Cloverley; Barnes, Richard S. K.; Smith, Martin Kyle; Arendse, Clement; Majola, Ntando; Njapha, Noxolo; Dreyer, Kezia Uriel Phillipa; Human, Lucienne; Ndhlovu, Aldwin
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了河口生境中，丝粉藻（Ruppia cirrhosa）作为濒危物种角茨藻（Zostera capensis）的功能替代者，对大型底栖动物多样性的支撑作用。通过比较两种海草床的宏底栖动物群落，评估了功能替代的有效性。主要发现丝粉藻能在一定程度上维持相似的生物多样性，但替代效果受环境条件影响。研究为海草栖息地保护与恢复提供了科学依据。

papers.title: Metabolomic plasticity of intertidal mussels in different microhabitats during an extreme cold event
papers.authors: Zhang, Xiaoning; Zhang, Ning; Lv, Chenming; Dong, Yun-wei
papers.summary_cn: 极端寒冷事件期间，潮间带贻贝在不同微生境中表现出显著的代谢组可塑性。研究通过代谢组学分析揭示了温度胁迫下贻贝代谢途径的适应性调整，为理解气候变化下底栖生物的生理响应机制提供了分子层面的证据。

papers.title: Survival of 0-group plaice Pleuronectes platessa in the western Wadden Sea in relation to time of settlement
papers.authors: van der Veer, Henk W.; Witte, Johannes I. J.; Poiesz, Suzanne Sophia Hendrike
papers.summary_cn: 研究聚焦于荷兰瓦登海西部0龄鲽（Pleuronectes platessa）的存活率与定居时间的关系。通过分析定居时间对早期生活阶段死亡率的影响，揭示定居时机如何调节种群补充动态。结果表明，较早或较晚定居的个体存活率存在显著差异，可能与食物可得性和捕食压力等环境因素相关。该研究为鲽鱼早期生活史阶段的种群补充机制提供了关键见解。

papers.title: Obstacle Avoidance Using Population Vector Code-Based SNN-CPG Controller for Robotic Fish in Unknown Environment
papers.authors: Asada, Takumi; Furuhashi, Hideo; Tabata, Kenta; Miyagusuku, Renato; Ozaki, Koichi
papers.abstract: Neurorobotics, which incorporates neuromorphic computing into robotic systems, can emulate biological intelligence and behaviors. The characteristics of neural responses and behavioral patterns are reproduced using spiking neural networks. Many applications utilize mobility robots; however, applications with multiple joints, such as robotic fish, remain limited. The main challenge is that shape types and joint numbers vary among biological organisms, and disturbances affect them in underwater environments. The neural circuit mechanisms used by multi-jointed robots for obstacle avoidance have not yet been clarified. In this study, we propose an obstacle avoidance architecture realized exclusively through neural circuits. The fundamental obstacle avoidance performance of a robotic fish was systematically evaluated, including ablation studies, varying conditions, and the physical environment.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出一种基于群体向量编码的SNN-CPG控制器，用于机器鱼在未知环境中的避障，旨在通过纯神经回路实现多关节机器鱼的自主导航。方法结合脉冲神经网络与中枢模式发生器，模拟生物神经响应机制，并在物理环境中系统评估了避障性能，包括消融实验和不同条件测试。主要发现是该神经架构能有效驱动机器鱼规避障碍，且无需传统算法干预，为神经机器人学在多关节水下平台的应用提供了新思路。

papers.title: Design and Development of a Fuzzy-logic-based Long-range Aquaculture System
papers.authors: Chen, Sheng-Tao; Chou, Tai-I
papers.summary_cn: 本研究设计并开发了一套基于模糊逻辑的远程水产养殖系统，旨在实现养殖环境的智能化监控与管理。系统通过集成传感器网络与模糊控制算法，对水温、溶解氧等关键参数进行实时调节，以提升养殖效率与稳定性。该系统适用于长距离场景，为水产养殖的自动化管理提供了技术支撑。

papers.authors: Hilgendag, Isabel R.; Power, Michael; Aqdam, Mehdi M.; Lewis, Christopher W.; Martin, Zoya; Ehrman, Ashley D.; Swanson, Heidi K.
papers.abstract: Abstract Mercury (Hg) is a globally distributed toxic metal present in northern natural environments that biomagnifies in food webs and bioaccumulates in apex predator fish, such as Arctic char ( Salvelinus alpinus )—an iteroparous species with a circumpolar distribution. Arctic char exhibit a variety of life history types, with the migrating, anadromous life‐history type supporting many subsistence and small‐scale commercial fisheries in the Arctic and sub‐Arctic. Despite anadromous Arctic char having generally lower Hg concentrations than non‐anadromous conspecifics, the mechanisms that contribute to significant inter‐individual differences within this life‐history group have not been well investigated. A total of 119 anadromous Arctic char were captured from inner Frobisher Bay on Baffin Island near Iqaluit, Nunavut, in 2018 and 2019, to investigate causes of inter‐individual differences in Hg concentrations in the anadromous life‐history type of Arctic char. As hypothesized, Hg concentrations significantly decreased with increasing marine prey reliance; marine prey reliance—quantified using δ 34 S ratios—explained 93% of the variability in Hg. Arctic char that relied more on marine (vs freshwater) prey had lower Hg concentrations. Delta 34 S ratios and average somatic growth rate (size‐at‐age) were the best predictors of Hg concentrations among the set of biological variables assessed, and both were negatively related to Hg concentrations in common age groups (i.e., ages 9–13). For samples that had migration data available, Hg concentration increased with age‐at‐first migration ( R 2 = 0.32) and decreased with number of marine migrations ( R 2 = 0.57), suggesting that plasticity in life history tactics affects Hg concentrations in anadromous Arctic char. Overall, results indicate that differences in habitat use and feeding environment (i.e., freshwater vs. marine) play a significant role in determining Hg bioaccumulation in anadromous Arctic char.
papers.summary_cn: 海洋洄游影响北极红点鲑（Salvelinus alpinus）体内汞积累。研究发现，海洋猎物依赖度（以δ³⁴S比值量化）与汞浓度显著负相关，可解释93%的汞含量变异；年龄-体长生长速率和δ³⁴S比值是汞浓度的最佳预测因子。首次洄游年龄与汞浓度正相关，而洄游次数与汞浓度负相关，表明生活史策略差异显著影响汞生物累积。

papers.title: Challenges for Sustainable Coastal Fisheries in a Changing Marine Environment: Spatiotemporal Impacts of Offshore Wind Farm Development in Taiwan
papers.authors: Wu, Yan-Lun; Hsiao, Po-Yuan; Valladares Ponce, Yonatan Isai; Sunardi, Sunardi; Sanjaya Saliyo, Aloysius Dimas; Li, Li-Xiang; Lan, Kuo-Wei
papers.abstract: Offshore wind farm (OWF) development raises concerns regarding potential conflicts with local fisheries and marine ecosystems. This study investigated the spatiotemporal dynamics of gillnet and trawl fisheries in the coastal waters off Changhua, Taiwan, across various development phases. (2016–2024). Spatial analysis revealed distinct operational patterns: gillnet fleets operated within and adjacent to wind farms, while trawl activities were concentrated in northern offshore waters, largely avoiding the development zone. The gillnet fishery demonstrated a significant increase in Income Per Unit Effort (IPUE), suggesting that local fishers successfully employed adaptive strategies. The IPUE of the trawl fishery indicated a slightly lower value during this period. These findings indicate that current OWF development has historically coexisted with gillnet fisheries without causing economic loss. The catch composition of gillnet fisheries remained stable, dominated by Silver croaker and Pharaoh cuttlefish. The species diversity indices of both fisheries showed a stable to increasing trend driven by seasonal variability rather than construction impacts. The habitat-driven shift in community structure was observed within the wind farm zone (gillnet fisheries), where the dominance of benthic species (e.g., Flatfish) transitioned toward reef-associated taxa (e.g., Spotted catfish, Black Sea bream). This indicates that the turbine foundations may function as artificial reefs, supporting a more complex assemblage. Nevertheless, the observed habitat alterations highlight the necessity for long-term monitoring to ensure the sustainable symbiosis of renewable energy expansion and marine resource conservation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了台湾彰化近海离岸风电场（OWF）开发对刺网和拖网渔业时空动态的影响（2016-2024年）。空间分析显示，刺网船队在风电场内及邻近区域作业，而拖网活动集中于北部外海，基本避开开发区。刺网渔业的单位努力收入（IPUE）显著提升，表明当地渔民采取了有效适应策略，且渔获组成稳定，以银姑鱼和法老墨鱼为主；拖网渔业IPUE略降。物种多样性指数呈稳定或上升趋势，主要受季节性变化驱动，而非建设影响。风电场区内刺网渔业的群落结构由底栖物种（如比目鱼）向岩礁关联物种（如斑点鲶鱼、黑鲷）转变，表明涡轮基础可能充当人工鱼礁，支持更复杂的生物组合。研究强调，当前OWF开发与刺网渔业历史共存未致经济损失，但栖息地变化需长期监测以确保可再生能源扩张与海洋资源保护的可持续共生。

papers.title: Fisheries biology of Plagioscion squamosissimus (Heckel, 1840) in a neotropical reservoir in southeastern Brazil
papers.authors: Matsumoto, Anderson Arimura; Campanha, Paula Maria Gênova de Castro; Petesse, Maria Letizia; Maruyama, Lídia Sumile; Brazão, Midiã Lima; David, Gianmarco Silva
papers.abstract: Plagioscion squamosissimus (silver croaker), a non-native species from the Amazon Basin, is one of the main resources supporting artisanal fisheries in the Três Irmãos Reservoir, São Paulo state, Brazil. This study evaluated its fishery biology and population characteristics between 2015 and 2018, aiming to provide information to support species management. Data were obtained through fishery monitoring of 93 artisanal fishers and quarterly scientific sampling conducted in the lotic, transitional, and lentic zones of the reservoir. Catch composition, fishing effort, environmental variables, length-weight relationship, length at first maturity (L50), and gillnet selectivity were analyzed. Spatial and temporal variability in catch per unit effort (CPUE) was assessed using principal component analysis and repeated-measures analysis of variance. The average annual landing of silver croaker was 53.5 tons, with a mean CPUE of 11.7 kg fisher-1 day-1. CPUE was associated with temperature, with the highest yields occurring in March, indicating a preference for lentic habitats. The species exhibited isometric growth (b = 3), continuous reproduction with a peak in spring, and a L50 of 15.9 cm total length. The results highlight the importance of silver croaker to local fisheries and suggest gillnet mesh sizes ≥ 8 cm to enhance commercial yields, whereas smaller meshes may be used in population control strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了巴西东南部Três Irmãos水库中非本地物种银石首鱼（Plagioscion squamosissimus）的渔业生物学特征，基于2015–2018年间93名手工渔民监测及季度科学采样数据，分析了渔获组成、CPUE、生长、性成熟体长（L50）及刺网选择性。结果显示年均渔获量53.5吨，平均CPUE为11.7 kg/渔民/天，CPUE与温度相关且3月最高，偏好静水区；该物种呈等速生长（b=3），繁殖持续但春季为高峰，L50为15.9 cm全长。建议刺网网目≥8 cm以提高商业产量，而小网目可用于种群控制，为资源管理提供关键依据。

papers.title: Participatory Community Development Approaches for Sustainable Fisheries Management in Sri Lanka: Evidence from Coastal Communities
papers.authors: Jayasingha, W. D. C. K.; Chathurangi, K. D. G.
papers.journal: Sri Lanka Journal of Social Work
papers.abstract: Sustainable fisheries management remains a critical challenge for coastal communities in Sri Lanka, where over 250,000 individuals depend directly on fishing for their livelihoods. While top-down regulatory approaches have largely failed to address overfishing and environmental degradation, participatory community development approaches offer promising alternatives. This qualitative case study examined three fishing communities in southern Sri Lanka to understand how participatory community development initiatives contribute to sustainable fisheries management practices and outcomes. Using semi-structured interviews with 42 community members, focus group discussions with 28 fishers and fish processors, and document review, we employed thematic analysis to identify mechanisms through which participation enhances sustainability and factors enabling or constraining such approaches. Findings reveal that participatory initiatives strengthen sustainability through three primary mechanisms: behavioral change in fishing practices, improved institutional capacity for adaptive management, and enhanced social cohesion that facilitates collective enforcement of conservation rules. However, sustainability outcomes were constrained by poverty-driven destructive practices, weak government support, limited market access, and gender inequalities in decision-making. The study demonstrates that participatory approaches hold significant promise for sustainable fisheries management in Sri Lanka, but require integrated support encompassing livelihood diversification, policy reform, institutional strengthening, and deliberate inclusion of marginalized groups. These findings have implications for social work practice, suggesting that environmental sustainability and social equity must be integrated within community development frameworks.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过定性案例研究，探讨斯里兰卡南部三个沿海社区参与式社区发展方法对可持续渔业管理的影响。基于42名社区成员访谈、28名渔民及鱼类加工者焦点小组讨论和文献分析，发现参与式举措通过改变捕捞行为、提升制度适应能力和增强社会凝聚力三种机制促进可持续性，但受贫困驱动破坏性捕捞、政府支持不足、市场准入受限及性别不平等制约。研究表明，参与式方法需结合生计多样化、政策改革、制度强化及边缘群体包容才能有效实现渔业可持续发展。

papers.title: Antibacterial and property stability of nanocomposites from chitosan, fish collagen, Eclipta prostrata extract and biosynthesized silver nanoparticles
papers.authors: Hoang, T. D.; Thai, H.; Tran, T. T.; Nguyen, T. C.
papers.journal: International Journal of Environmental Science and Technology
