The extensive use of antibiotics in aquaculture for therapeutic, prophylactic, and metaphylactic purposes has accelerated the selection of resistant microorganisms within fish-associated microbiota. Fish microflora, particularly the gut, gill, skin, and environmental microbial communities associated with culture systems, serve as reservoirs of antibiotic-resistant bacteria (ARB) and antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs). These resistance determinants can spread through horizontal gene transfer, facilitating the emergence of multidrug-resistant pathogens with implications extending beyond aquatic environments. Recent studies have demonstrated the widespread occurrence of tetracycline, sulfonamide, quinolone, β-lactam, and aminoglycoside resistance genes in aquaculture systems worldwide. The dissemination of ARGs through water, sediments, feeds, fish products, and aquatic wildlife has strengthened concerns regarding the role of aquaculture in the global AMR crisis. Modern metagenomic investigations have further revealed the complexity of fish-associated resistomes and their connectivity with environmental and human-associated microbial communities. This review critically examines the development of antibiotic resistance within fish microflora, the mechanisms underlying resistance acquisition, global distribution patterns, ecological and public health implications, and emerging mitigation strategies. Emphasis is placed on the One Health framework, which recognizes the interconnectedness of human, animal, and environmental health in addressing AMR. Current evidence indicates that antibiotic resistance in fish microflora is no longer a localized aquaculture problem but a global environmental and public health challenge requiring coordinated international intervention.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统分析了鱼类微生物群中抗生素耐药性（AMR）的严重威胁，指出水产养殖中抗生素的广泛使用加速了耐药菌（ARB）和耐药基因（ARGs）在鱼类肠道、鳃、皮肤及养殖环境中的富集与传播。研究发现，四环素、磺胺类、喹诺酮类、β-内酰胺类和氨基糖苷类耐药基因在全球水产养殖系统中普遍存在，且通过水平基因转移扩散至多药耐药病原体，对生态系统和公共健康构成跨域风险。基于宏基因组学证据，鱼类相关耐药组与环境及人类微生物群落高度关联，凸显了AMR已从局部养殖问题演变为全球性挑战。文章强调需采用One Health框架，协调人类、动物与环境健康，制定国际性干预策略以缓解耐药性危机。

papers.title: Assessment of the Impact of Environmental Factors on the Biological Indicators of Commercial Fish in the Shardara Reservoir (Aral-Syr Darya Basin, Kazakhstan)
papers.authors: Sambayev, Nurlan; Sharakhmetov, Sayat; Barakbayev, Tynysbek; Kalymbetova, Mayra; Kirichenko, Olga
papers.journal: Central Asian Journal of Water Research
papers.abstract: Changes in hydrological conditions in the Aral-Syr Darya Basin have been particularly pronounced over the past ten years. The relevance of studying the influence of environmental factors on aquatic fauna is evident today and requires identifying the causes of adverse changes, as well as taking precautionary measures. The study focuses on the Shardara Reservoir, a major reservoir located on the Syr Darya River in southern Kazakhstan. The article presents the results of research conducted in 2020–2024, including an analysis of the biological indicators of commercial fish species in the Shardara Reservoir and an assessment of both abiotic and biotic influencing factors. Based on data obtained from the Kazhydromet website for the Turkistan Region, annual water discharge rates were calculated. The water-level conditions of the reservoir were also assessed using modern geographic information system (GIS) technologies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了哈萨克斯坦锡尔河Shardara水库环境因子对商业鱼类生物学指标的影响，基于2020–2024年数据，结合水文监测与GIS技术分析水位及水量变化。主要发现：近十年流域水文条件显著改变，影响鱼类种群结构；通过量化年径流量与水库水位动态，揭示了环境因子与鱼类生物学响应间的关联。研究为区域渔业资源保护及预防性管理措施提供了科学依据。

papers.authors: Hasegawa, Yuya; Shibata, Kiko; Abe, Taiga; Hotta, Takurou
papers.abstract: Abstract Selective breeding of yellowtail ( Seriola quinqueradiata ) is expanding in Japan, increasing the demand for practical reproductive control tools in commercial aquaculture to reduce genetic risks from escapees. Slowing early gonadal development through environmental manipulation may support future sterilization strategies, particularly when combined with other techniques. This study aimed to examine somatic growth and early gonadal development in juvenile yellowtail reared under continuous darkness (0L:24D). Juveniles were reared under 0L:24D or a 12L:12D photoperiod (control) and sampled at Weeks 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10. Growth was recorded at each time point, and gonads were examined by histology and immunohistochemistry to assess gonadal sex differentiation, germ‐cell proliferation and onset of meiosis. Water temperature increased similarly in both groups and exceeded 28°C from Week 6 onward. Despite identical feeding rations, fish reared under 0L:24D were significantly larger at Weeks 8 and 10 than controls. Gonadal sex differentiation progressed normally in both groups, and germ‐cell proliferative activity did not differ between groups. SYCP3‐positive germ cells were not detected at Week 6 under 0L:24D, whereas the proportion of SYCP3‐positive germ cells at Weeks 8 to 10 was comparable to that in controls, suggesting a possible transient difference in the initial appearance of SYCP3‐positive germ cells. In females, fish reared under 0L:24D showed lower area fraction and diameter of chromatin nucleolus‐ and perinucleolus‐stage (CN/PN) oocytes at Weeks 8 and 10, suggesting reduced development of CN/PN‐stage oocytes. These results suggest that, under the present single‐tank experimental conditions, rearing under continuous darkness was associated with improved growth performance during the high‐temperature period and sex‐specific changes in early gonadal development in juvenile yellowtail.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨持续黑暗（0L:24D）光周期对黄条鰤（Seriola quinqueradiata）幼鱼生长和早期性腺发育的影响。在高温期（水温超过28°C）下，0L:24D组幼鱼在8周和10周时体长显著大于12L:12D对照组，尽管投喂量相同。组织学和免疫组化分析显示，两组的性腺性别分化正常，但0L:24D组雌鱼在8-10周时染色质核仁期和围核仁期卵母细胞的面积比例和直径降低，且SYCP3阳性生殖细胞在6周时未检出，提示早期减数分裂起始可能延迟。结果表明，持续黑暗可改善高温期生长性能，并对雌鱼早期性腺发育产生性别特异性影响，为黄条鰤生殖控制策略提供潜在环境调控手段。

papers.title: The Resource, Users’ Socio-economic Status, and Governance in Coastal Marine Benthic Mollusk fisheries in Costa Grande, Guerrero, Mexico
papers.authors: Cerros-Cornelio, Juan Carlos; Torreblanca-Ramírez, Carmina; Castrejón-Ríos, Alma Rubí; Padilla-Serrato, Jesús Guadalupe; Flores-Rodríguez, Pedro; López-Rojas, Victor Ignacio; Flores-Garza, Rafael
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦墨西哥格雷罗州大科斯塔沿海底栖软体动物渔业，旨在评估其资源状况、用户社会经济特征及治理机制。通过实地调查与数据分析，揭示了该渔业在资源利用、渔民生计依赖及现行管理框架间的相互作用。研究发现，资源可持续性与当地社区经济福祉紧密关联，但治理体系存在协调不足，影响长期管理成效。该研究为热带沿海小型渔业的多维度管理提供了实证参考。

papers.title: Illegal unreported and unregulated fishing in Somalia a systematic review of fisheries governance and sustainable development
papers.authors: Ahmed, Abdikarim; Osman, Mohamed
papers.abstract: Abstract Illegal, Unreported, and Unregulated (IUU) fishing poses a significant threat to fisheries sustainability, maritime governance, and coastal livelihoods in fragile maritime states such as Somalia. This study systematically reviews the literature on IUU fishing in Somali waters to examine its governance context, drivers, impacts, maritime security implications, and governance responses. Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines, a systematic search of Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar identified relevant literature published between January 2001 and March 2025. After screening and full-text assessment, 25 studies met the eligibility criteria and were included in the final evidence synthesis. The findings indicate that weak governance, limited enforcement capacity, economic incentives, and transnational regulatory gaps are consistently identified as the principal drivers of IUU fishing. The review identifies substantial socio-economic and environmental impacts, including declining fish stocks, biodiversity degradation, revenue losses, and livelihood insecurity. Although links between IUU fishing and piracy remain contested, the evidence suggests that both are better understood as outcomes of broader governance failures than as a direct causal relationship. The included studies consistently propose strengthening fisheries institutions, improving maritime enforcement, enhancing regional cooperation, and promoting community participation as key governance responses. The review also identifies important research gaps, particularly the limited availability of field-based research and long-term fisheries monitoring, providing an evidence base for future research and policy development in Somalia and other fragile maritime states.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统综述了索马里水域IUU捕捞的治理背景、驱动因素、影响及应对措施，遵循PRISMA 2020指南检索2001年至2025年3月的文献，最终纳入25项研究。结果显示，治理薄弱、执法能力不足、经济激励和跨国监管缺口是IUU捕捞的主要驱动因素，导致鱼类资源衰退、生物多样性退化、收入损失和生计不安全。尽管IUU捕捞与海盗的关联存在争议，但证据表明两者均是更广泛治理失败的产物而非直接因果关系。研究建议强化渔业机构、提升海上执法、加强区域合作及促进社区参与，并指出实地研究和长期监测的不足，为索马里及其他脆弱海洋国家提供政策与研究方向。

papers.authors: Francolini, Rene D.; Sleith, Robin S.; Cammen, Kristina M.; Brady, Damian C.; Rasher, Douglas B.
papers.abstract: Abstract Sugar kelp ( Saccharina latissima ; order Laminariales) plays a vital role in kelp forest ecosystems, as well as an expanding kelp aquaculture industry, in the Gulf of Maine, United States. However, ocean warming is eroding the resilience of Maine's kelp forests and may be compromising their local genetic diversity, with impacts on population structure and gene flow. Here, we used genome‐wide single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) data to assess the genetic diversity, structure, and connectivity of S. latissima populations at 11 outer coastal sites spanning the historical range of kelp forests in Maine. Our analyses identified moderate genetic diversity and limited inbreeding within sites (average heterozygosity: 0.27). Further, they revealed that three clusters comprising four genetically distinct populations exist across the study region. Population structure was strongly associated with geographic distance and oceanographic features, as supported by principal coordinate analysis, F ST calculations, Bayesian clustering, and spore dispersal modeling. Lastly, our outlier analysis identified genes potentially under selection. Thus, our findings highlight distinct, genetically unique kelp populations along Maine's coast and emphasize the need for regional management strategies that support both ecosystem resilience and sustainable aquaculture under climate change.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用全基因组SNP数据，分析了美国缅因州沿海11个外海岸位点的糖海带（Saccharina latissima）种群遗传多样性、结构与连通性。结果显示，种群内遗传多样性中等（平均杂合度0.27），近交有限，且研究区域存在三个聚类、四个遗传上独特的种群。种群结构与地理距离和海洋学特征显著相关，并通过主坐标分析、F_ST计算、贝叶斯聚类和孢子扩散模型得到验证。研究强调缅因州沿海存在遗传独特的海带种群，需制定区域管理策略以支持气候变化下的生态系统韧性和可持续 aquaculture。

papers.title: SNI-Based Fish Smoking and Digital Marketing in Bandarharjo
papers.authors: Dzakiy, M. Anas; Rakhmawati, Reni; Menarianti, Ika
papers.abstract: The smoked fish processing center in Bandarharjo, North Semarang, faces constraints in hygienic production, product consistency, packaging, and digital marketing. This community service program aimed to improve smoked fish quality through an SNI 2725:2013-oriented smoking design, vacuum sealing, and digital marketing assistance. The program involved 20 business actors from August to October 2024 through socialization, workshops, technical training, mentoring, and evaluation using a 12-item pretest and posttest. Results showed an increase in participants knowledge from 12.08% to 88.75%, or a 76.67 percentage point improvement. Partners practiced standardized hot smoking, improved packaging, mapped business locations on Google Maps, produced digital product content using Photoroom, and promoted products through social media. The sales turnover index increased by 40%. The program strengthened hygienic production, market access, and MSME competitiveness.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对北三宝垄Bandarharjo烟熏鱼加工中心存在的卫生生产、产品一致性和包装及数字营销问题，开展社区服务项目。通过SNI 2725:2013导向的烟熏设计、真空密封和数字营销培训，对20家商户进行社会化、工作坊和技术指导，结果显示参与者知识水平从12.08%提升至88.75%，销售额指数增长40%。项目强化了卫生生产、市场准入和中小微企业竞争力。

papers.title: Retraction Note: Nano-selenium supplementation: improving growth, digestibility and mineral absorption in freshwater fish, Catla catla
papers.authors: Ahmad, Nisar; Hussain, Syed Makhdoom; Ali, Shafaqat; Tahir, Muhammad Farrukh; Sarker, Pallab K.; Shahid, Mudassar
papers.summary_cn: 该撤稿声明涉及一项关于纳米硒补充对淡水鱼（Catla catla）生长、消化率及矿物质吸收影响的研究，但该研究已被撤回。因此，本文不再提供有效的研究结论，仅作为撤稿通知存在，不适用于渔业科学参考。

papers.title: Dynamics of artificial aquaculture ponds in China from 2015 to 2025
papers.authors: Chen, Yao; Zhang, Xiuyuan; Peng, Shushi; Wang, Haoyu; Bai, Lubin; Xiong, Shuping; Li, Mei; Du, Shihong
papers.summary_cn: 基于2015至2025年数据，研究中国人工养殖池塘的动态变化，旨在揭示其时空演变特征。通过遥感与统计分析，发现池塘面积与分布格局显著受政策及市场需求影响。该研究为水产养殖规划与资源管理提供科学依据。

papers.title: Impact of Surveillance and Depopulation Strategies on Fish Disease Transmission Among Net‐Cage Farms Near the Tongyeong Coast Based on a Spatiotemporal Hybrid Approach
papers.authors: Kang, Gyoungsik; Kim, Ju‐sung; Kim, Kyung‐Ho; Roh, HyeongJin
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Infectious diseases among fish farms present significant challenges to fish health and production. Horizontal transmission serves as one of the main mechanisms driving outbreaks in these settings. The dynamics of horizontal transmission are influenced by pathogen properties, host characteristics and environmental factors. Additionally, the implementation of epidemiological interventions can further shape the patterns and consequences of infectious disease spread. However, there is a paucity of studies assessing how specific epidemiological measures, such as timely disease surveillance and strategic depopulation, influence transmission and outbreak outcomes. This study utilized a spatiotemporal hybrid model to assess pathogen dissemination following an infectious disease event in Tongyeong, a prominent area for floating net cage aquaculture in Korea. We investigated how variations in sampling intensity affected the timing of disease detection and analysed the impact of two control strategies (immediate culling upon detection versus no culling) on the progression of disease and fish mortality. Findings revealed significant differences in disease detection timing and probability based on the surveillance sampling size. Early detection of disease was achieved when 100 fish were sampled, as opposed to a delayed response when only 5 fish were tested. Furthermore, the conditions under which surveillance occurred had a notable impact on both the spatial spread and the success of depopulation measures. Generally, prompt detection followed by immediate depopulation led to a decrease in disease‐related mortality over a wider area. However, this method also necessitated culling a substantially greater number of fish. Although the impact of these interventions may be influenced by geographical and environmental variables, our results suggest that the utility of depopulation strategies is closely linked to the efficacy of surveillance efforts and the epidemiological profile of the infection, such as its associated mortality rate and transmissibility.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用时空混合模型评估韩国统营沿海网箱养殖场传染病暴发后的病原传播动态，并分析监测采样强度（5尾 vs 100尾）对疾病检出时间的影响，以及两种控制策略（检出后立即扑杀 vs 不扑杀）对疾病进展和鱼类死亡率的作用。结果显示，采样100尾可显著提前疾病检出时间，而采样5尾则导致响应延迟；及时检出并立即扑杀虽能降低更大范围内的疾病相关死亡率，但需扑杀更多鱼类。研究结论强调，扑杀策略的有效性与监测效率及感染的流行病学特征（如死亡率和传播力）密切相关，其效果可能受地理和环境因素调节。

papers.title: Two perspectives, one river: what macroinvertebrates and fish reveal about mountain river ecosystem
papers.authors: Čanak Atlagić, Jelena; Marić, Ana; Stanković Ristić, Jelena; Đuknić, Jelena; Mitić, Tamara; Ilić, Marija; Tubić, Bojana
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过对比大型无脊椎动物与鱼类两类生物指标，探讨山区河流生态系统的综合评估视角。结果显示，两类生物对河流环境变化的响应存在互补性，鱼类反映大尺度栖息地连通性，而无脊椎动物更敏感于局部微生境退化。研究建议，在河流生态监测中应整合多类群数据，以提升生态系统健康诊断的全面性与准确性。

papers.title: Community Governance and Environmental Education as Social and Institutional Dimensions of Sustainability-Oriented Artisanal Fisheries Management: A Socio-Ecological Assessment of a Coastal Lagoon in Mexico
papers.authors: Moreno Mendoza, Enrique; Saldaña Almazán, Mirella; Bedolla Solano, Ramón; Juaréz López, Ana Laura; Rodríguez Alviso, Columba; Suastegui Cruz, Sirilo
papers.abstract: Small-scale fisheries are socio-ecological systems in which resource users interact with environmental conditions, fishing regulations, community initiatives, and institutional actors. Understanding how fishers perceive and report these interactions provides information on the social context of fisheries management, although such perceptions cannot substitute for independent assessments of ecological sustainability, behavioural compliance, or governance effectiveness. This study characterized fishers’ environmental perceptions, self-reported fishing practices, participation in environmental education and conservation activities, and perceptions of community and institutional involvement in fisheries management in Tecomate Lagoon, Guerrero, Mexico. A cross-sectional quantitative design was used, and structured questionnaires were administered to 120 active artisanal fishers selected through simple random sampling. Data were analyzed descriptively using frequencies and percentages. Respondents primarily associated the lagoon with economic (49.17%) and food-related (25.83%) functions. Declining water levels (60.00%) and reduced species abundance (40.00%) were the environmental changes reported by respondents. Regarding fishing practices, 94.17% stated that they complied with fishing regulations, and 100% reported releasing organisms below the minimum legal catch size. Environmental training was reported by 95.00% of respondents, while 94.17% reported participation in conservation-related activities. CONAPESCA (80.83%) and UAGro (19.17%) were identified as institutions involved in fisheries-related initiatives. These findings characterize the perceptions and self-reported experiences of surveyed fishers and should not be interpreted as evidence of ecological sustainability, actual behavioural compliance, educational effectiveness, or governance performance. The contribution of the study lies in systematically documenting the resource-user perspective as a component of the social dimension of the fishery. This information provides a descriptive baseline that can complement future ecological, behavioural, institutional, and longitudinal assessments of small-scale fisheries in coastal lagoon systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以墨西哥格雷罗州Tecomate泻湖为例，通过横断面定量设计和简单随机抽样，对120名活跃手工渔民进行结构化问卷，评估其环境感知、自报捕捞行为、环保教育参与及社区与机构治理认知。结果显示，渔民主要关联泻湖的经济（49.17%）和食物（25.83%）功能，报告水位下降（60.00%）和物种丰度减少（40.00%）为主要环境变化，94.17%声称遵守捕捞法规，100%释放低于法定最小规格个体，95.00%接受环境培训，94.17%参与保护活动，CONAPESCA（80.83%）和UAGro（19.17%）为主要涉渔机构。研究系统记录了资源使用者视角，为沿海泻湖小型渔业的社会维度提供描述性基线，但强调这些感知不能替代生态可持续性、行为合规或治理有效性的独立评估。

papers.title: Navigating complexity: Evaluating management measures for multispecies snapper-grouper fisheries in the Southeast U.S. Atlantic
papers.authors: Cao, Jie; Shertzer, Kyle; Crosson, Scott; Williams, Erik; DeVictor, Rick
papers.abstract: Multispecies fisheries are globally common, but typically managed through single-species controls. This situation can result in wasteful discarding, when fish of some species cannot be retained, but fishing effort toward the complex continues. In contrast, managing multispecies fisheries through effort controls can address this shortcoming. In this study, we used a simulation model to examine the effectiveness of various temporal and spatial effort controls applied to the multispecies snapper-grouper fishery in the southeast United States Atlantic. To represent the complex, we chose six species that are most commonly caught by the commercial and recreational sectors. We evaluated the various management scenarios based on performance metrics that quantify effects on spawning biomass, commercial and recreational landings, commercial and recreational discards, and economic indicators for both fishing sectors. These performance metrics were applied to both the species individually and in aggregate. We found that some management approaches were more effective than others, but that no single approach worked best for all species and both sectors. The optimal strategy depends on policy priorities, balancing potential tradeoffs between conservation goals (e.g., increased spawning biomass), harvest objectives (e.g., increased landings, decreased discards), and economic outcomes. Our modeling framework quantifies those tradeoffs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对美国东南大西洋多物种snapper-grouper渔业，采用模拟模型评估了时空努力控制管理措施的有效性。以商业和休闲渔业最常捕获的六个物种为代表，通过产卵生物量、渔获量、丢弃量及经济指标等绩效指标，对物种个体和整体进行综合评价。结果表明，不同管理方法效果各异，无单一策略能同时最优满足所有物种和两个渔业部门，最优方案取决于政策优先级，需在保护目标、捕捞目标和经济结果间权衡。该建模框架为量化这些权衡提供了工具。

papers.title: New host record of the hematophagous gill parasite, Polylabris mamaevi (Oguwa & Egusa, 1980) in siganid fish, Siganus javus implicated in fish mortalities under captive conditions
papers.authors: Rajendran, Vidya; Bhuvaneswari, Thangavelu; Raja, Ramalingam Ananda; Patil, Prasanna Kumar; Paramashivam, Kumaravel; Vasagam, Kumaraguru; Makesh, Marappan; Shekhar, Mudagandur Shashi
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次报道了吸血鳃寄生虫Polylabris mamaevi在蓝子鱼（Siganus javus）上的新宿主记录，该寄生虫与养殖条件下的鱼类死亡事件相关。研究基于形态学鉴定确认寄生虫种类，并探讨了其在 captive 环境中的致病性。这一发现为养殖鱼类寄生虫病的防控提供了重要宿主-寄生虫关联信息。

papers.title: Intensity of constructed waterbodies and commonly stocked fishes are associated with fish community changes across a river basin in the southeastern United States
papers.authors: Davenport, Grace; Adams, Ginny L.; Morrill, Daniel P.; Rezac, Calvin; Gavrielides, George; Main, Jennifer; Adams, S. Reid
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了美国东南部某河流流域内人工水体密度及常见放养鱼类对鱼类群落结构变化的影响。通过分析流域尺度上的鱼类组成数据，发现人工水体强度与放养鱼类丰度显著关联，并驱动了本地鱼类群落的组成转变。研究结果强调，人工水体建设和放养管理是改变河流鱼类多样性的关键人为因素，对流域生态保护具有重要参考意义。

papers.title: Novel gelatin-based materials of fish by-products: a systematic review on the functional properties of biofilms, nanocomposites, and nanofibers for food and biomedical applications
papers.authors: Nóbrega, Tiago Cabral; Vieira, Italo Rennan Sousa; Mendes, Joana Maia; Guimarães, Cristiane Cunha; Carvalho, Junior Ribeiro; de Andrade, Jelmir Craveiro; Conte-Junior, Carlos Adam; de Oliveira, Adriano Teixeira
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了鱼副产物明胶基材料的研究进展，聚焦其在生物膜、纳米复合物及纳米纤维中的功能特性。文章旨在评估这些材料在食品包装和生物医学领域的应用潜力，并总结明胶提取、改性及加工技术对材料性能的影响。主要发现包括鱼明胶具有良好的生物相容性和成膜性，通过纳米增强可显著改善机械强度与抗菌活性，为废弃鱼副产物的高值化利用提供理论依据。

papers.title: A comparative study of sperm motility kinematics in six fish species of the subfamily Leuciscinae (Actinopterygii: Cypriniformes)
papers.authors: Dziewulska, Katarzyna; Bocianowski, Jan
papers.abstract: Aims A comparative study was conducted on the sperm motility kinematics of six species within the subfamily Leuciscinae, aiming to elucidate the potential relationship between variations in sperm motility parameters and both the water currents at their spawning grounds and their mating behaviour. Methods Computer-assisted sperm analysis (CASA) was performed to evaluate nine motility parameters. Water currents at the spawning grounds and mating behaviours were compiled based on literature data. Key results This study identified both similarities and differences in sperm motility characteristics. Differences in sperm motility kinematics primarily concerned velocity at activation and the total duration of movement. Conclusions In rheophilic Leuciscinae spawners, such as the vimba bream and chub, a prolonged motility duration or lower sperm velocities were observed compared to still-water spawners. Still-water spawners, such as the territorial freshwater bream and the non-territorial white bream, which exhibits reported courtship tactics, showed intermediate sperm velocities. The roach and rudd, which display lek-like mating behaviour, presented the highest initial velocities. Implications Further research is required to confirm that sperm traits in Leuciscinae are strongly shaped by environmental conditions and mating systems, as well as to provide detailed descriptions of the multi-faceted biological factors that underlie breeding success across different species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了雅罗鱼亚科6种鱼类的精子运动学特征，旨在探讨精子运动参数差异与产卵场水流及交配行为的关系。采用计算机辅助精子分析（CASA）评估9项运动参数，并结合文献数据整合产卵场水流和交配行为信息。结果显示，溪流性产卵鱼类（如文鳊和鲦）运动持续时间较长或精子速度较低，而静水产卵鱼类（如 territorial 欧鳊和非 territorial 白鳊）呈中等速度，具lek式交配行为的拟鲤和红眼鱼初始速度最高。研究提示环境条件和交配系统可能塑造精子性状，但需进一步验证其繁殖成功的多因素机制。

papers.title: Influence of Municipal and Abattoir Effluents on Surface Water Quality and Biological Responses of Fish in the Benue River, Nigeria
papers.authors: Aende, Athanasius; Kwaghvıhı, Orfega; Torsabo, Donald; Gbaior, Tivfa
papers.journal: Journal of Limnology and Freshwater Fisheries Research
papers.abstract: This study assessed surface water quality and biological responses of fish exposed to municipal and abattoir effluents discharged into the Benue River at Makurdi, Benue State, Nigeria (Latitude 7.733218° N, Longitude 8.546908° E). Most physicochemical parameters, including temperature (27.59 ± 1.40°C) and pH (7.17 ± 0.10), fell within NESREA (2011) limits, but ammonia nitrogen (0.50 ± 0.12 mg/L) exceeded the 0.05 mg/L permissible limit, while biological oxygen demand (4.03 ± 0.13 mg/L) surpassed the 3.0 mg/L limit, alongside significantly elevated (p &lt; 0.0001) dissolved oxygen, total alkalinity, total hardness, and transparency, reflecting abattoir-driven pollution. Among fish species, Clarias gariepinus recorded the highest gonadosomatic index but the lowest condition factor, while Oreochromis niloticus showed the highest hepatosomatic index and, with Coptodon zillii, higher condition factors (p &lt; 0.05). Haematological analysis revealed depressed haemoglobin (9.20 g/dl) and markedly elevated white blood cell counts (8753.70 ×10⁹ cells/L; p &lt; 0.001), indicating physiological stress. Liver enzymes (ALT, AST, ALP) and oxidative stress biomarkers (SOD, CAT, MDA, GPx, GR, LPO) varied significantly across seasons and species (p &lt; 0.001), except glutathione (GSH), which remained stable. These findings confirm that abattoir and municipal waste degrade Benue River water quality and compromise fish physiological health, posing ecological and public health risks to communities dependent on the river.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了尼日利亚贝努埃河受市政和屠宰场废水影响的水质及鱼类生物学响应。结果显示，氨氮和生化需氧量超标，溶解氧、总碱度等指标显著升高，表明屠宰场污染主导。鱼类中，Clarias gariepinus性腺指数最高但条件因子最低，Oreochromis niloticus肝体指数最高；血液学分析显示血红蛋白降低、白细胞显著升高，肝脏酶和氧化应激指标随季节和物种显著变化，指示生理应激。研究证实废水排放损害水质和鱼类健康，对依赖该河的生态和社区构成风险。

papers.title: Eastern European–Asian Cooperation: Aquacultural and Cultural Contributions to Increased Fish Consumption in Laos
papers.authors: Békefi, Emese Bozánné; Lénárt, István; Markovina, Irina; Brlás-Molnár, Zsuzsanna; Gyalog, Gergő; Kasza, Gyula; Szakos, Dávid; Kunszabó, Atilla; Váradi, László
papers.abstract: Laos is one of the 32 landlocked developing countries (LLDCs) of the world, where isolation from the sea and the lack of a large-scale fishing industry have a direct effect on fish supply and fish consumption. Per capita fish consumption in LLDCs amounted to 5.1 kg/year in 2023, which is much lower than the world average (20.3 kg) as well as the Developing Regions average (20.0 kg). However, per capita fish consumption in Laos has reached 28.5 kg/year in 2023, representing the highest among the 32 LLDCs. Relying on the results and experiences of several decades of work in aquaculture development in Laos and taking into account the observations of local and international publications, documents and statistics included, the authors aimed at identifying the principal reasons for the elevated fish consumption in Laos from different perspectives, including that of aquaculture, as well as Lao language, culture, and religion. In this review, the authors analyzed the availability of aquatic resources, the role of fishing and aquaculture in the Lao economy and social life, market realities, as well as the importance of fish in Lao culture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦老挝作为全球32个内陆发展中国家（LLDC）中人均鱼类消费量最高（2023年达28.5 kg/年）的独特现象，旨在探究其远超世界平均水平（20.3 kg）的成因。通过综合分析水产养殖发展历程、渔业经济与社会作用、市场现状及鱼类在老挝语言、文化和宗教中的意义，作者从多维度揭示了高消费背后的驱动因素。研究指出，水产养殖的持续发展、丰富的 aquatic resources 以及鱼类在文化传统中的核心地位共同促进了消费水平提升，为内陆国家渔业发展提供了参考案例。

papers.title: Evaluating Glycerol as an Alternative Carbon Source for Denitrification in Land-Based Salmon Recirculating Aquaculture Systems
papers.authors: Salte, Live Aareskjold; Lekang, Odd Ivar; Strauch, Sebastian Marcus
papers.abstract: Heterotrophic denitrification is increasingly used in land-based recirculating aquaculture systems (RASs) to remove nitrate and minimise new-water demand, but the carbon sources traditionally used—methanol and acetic acid—raise safety, corrosion, and cost concerns. This study evaluated glycerol as an alternative external carbon source in a commercial land-based Atlantic salmon RAS in Norway. Trials in two identical post-smolt systems with integrated denitrification bioreactors compared glycerol (80%) against acetic acid for denitrification performance, nitrite accumulation, pH stability, carbon-source consumption, cost, and hazard profile. Glycerol achieved similar or higher apparent total dissolved nitrogen (TDN) removal than acetic acid and, once the biofilm had acclimated, was completely consumed. It maintained a stable outlet pH (≥6.5), avoiding the enzyme inhibition seen when acetic acid depressed pH, and proved about 1.5 times more cost-effective (≈NOK 66 vs. 97 per kg TDN removed). A standardised hazard assessment ranked glycerol as the safest option for flammability, toxicity, and corrosiveness. TDN removal correlated strongly with dissolved nitrogen gas saturation at the bioreactor outlet (r2 = 0.79–0.82), indicating that total gas pressure monitoring is a promising, low-cost proxy for performance. Nitrite accumulation per unit of nitrogen removed was, however, about three times higher under glycerol (≈1 mg NO2-N per mg TDN) than under acetic acid (≈0.3 mg NO2-N per mg TDN), and the nine-day glycerol phase was too short to establish whether this resolves or persists as the biofilm matures. Subject to routine nitrite monitoring in the fish tanks, glycerol is a cost-effective, low-hazard, and pH-stable alternative to acetic acid for nitrate removal in salmon RASs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了甘油作为陆基大西洋鲑循环水养殖系统（RAS）中反硝化替代碳源的可行性，以应对传统甲醇和乙酸在安全、腐蚀及成本上的问题。在挪威商业RAS的两个相同后-smolt系统中，对比甘油（80%）与乙酸的反硝化性能，发现甘油在总溶解氮（TDN）去除率上相当或更高，且完全消耗，维持稳定出水pH（≥6.5），成本效益约为乙酸的1.5倍（每kg TDN去除约NOK 66 vs. 97），并被评为最安全选项。然而，甘油处理下单位氮去除的亚硝酸盐积累量约为乙酸的3倍（≈1 mg NO2-N per mg TDN vs. 0.3），且九天试验期不足以确定该问题是否随生物膜成熟而缓解。TDN去除与生物反应器出口溶解氮气饱和度强相关（r² = 0.79–0.82），提示总气压监测可作为低成本性能指标。结论：在常规鱼池亚硝酸盐监测下，甘油是乙酸的经济、低危且pH稳定的替代品。

papers.title: Full life cycle cultivation of three local kelp species (Ecklonia maxima, Laminaria pallida and Macrocystis pyrifera) in an aquaculture setting in Small Bay of Saldanha Bay, South Africa
papers.authors: Botes, Lizeth; Schalkwyk, Musadiq; Moosa, Waqeefah
papers.abstract: Abstract Seaweed farming is a growing global industry with significant potential for environmental and economic benefits. While East and Southeast Asian countries dominate current production, interest and investment in kelp farming are expanding to other regions, including Africa. In South Africa limited information is available on the cultivation potential of the three local west coast kelp species Ecklonia maxima , Laminaria pallida and Macrocystis pyrifera. This study was conducted as part of the South African Kelp Farming Project (SA KFP) and is the first full life cycle cultivation of the three species in an aquaculture setting over the same 8-month period in Africa. All three kelp species were grown in the hatchery/nursery to ~ 1 cm in 49 days (at 15 ℃, a 16 h L:8 h D photoperiod, GeO 2 in the first two weeks, half strength PES from the second week onward, spore concentration of 2000 spores mL −1 for E. maxima and L. pallida, and 5000 spores mL −1 for M. pyrifera ). To overcome sedimentation and biofouling pressure at the grow-out site, an at-sea weaning step was introduced where juvenile sporophytes were grown for ~ 2 weeks to 2.0–2.5 cm. Results of the 6-month grow-out period demonstrated that all three species can be cultivated in an aquaculture setting but that a good understanding of the spatiotemporal variations in environmental and biological factors at any particular site is critical before full-scale operations are attempted. The methodologies used in this study provide a foundation from which a kelp farming industry in South Africa could potentially develop and improve on.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次在南非Saldanha Bay小湾的 aquaculture 环境中，对三种本地海带（Ecklonia maxima、Laminaria pallida 和 Macrocystis pyrifera）进行了完整的生命周期养殖试验，历时8个月。育苗阶段在15℃、16h光照条件下，49天内将孢子培育至约1cm，并通过海上驯化步骤（约2周至2-2.5cm）克服了生长海域的沉积和生物污损压力。6个月的海上养成结果表明，三种海带均可实现 aquaculture 养殖，但成功关键取决于对特定地点环境与生物因素时空变化的深入理解。该研究为南非海带养殖产业的建立提供了方法论基础。

papers.title: Land-use transitions and carbon emissions of aquaculture expansion in the Brazilian Amazon
papers.authors: Pacheco, Felipe S.; Heilpern, Sebastian A.; Almeida, Rafael M.; Sethi, Suresh A.; Miranda, Marcela; Ray, Nicholas; Greenstreet, Laura; Fan, Joshua; Rappazzo, Brendan H.; Kabra, Anmol
papers.abstract: Accounting for land-use change underlying food sector expansion is critical for conserving ecosystem integrity. This challenge is particularly acute in the Amazon, where the conversion of forests for food production is pronounced and has broad implications for global biodiversity and the cycling of water and carbon. Here, we analyze land-use transitions associated with aquaculture development in the Brazilian Amazon. We found that a 450-fold increase in aquaculture pond area from 1985 to 2022 occurred primarily on pasturelands (87%) but also included wetland conversion (4%) and deforestation (5%). Notably, continued growth can be sustained within already altered landscapes: In Rondônia, the leading aquaculture state in the Amazon, production could double by converting only 1.2% of the total degraded pasture area. While directing aquaculture expansion toward degraded pastures could reduce further natural habitat conversion and carbon costs historically associated with food production in the Amazon, realizing this potential will depend on strong governance and enforceable land-use policies to guide siting decisions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了1985至2022年间巴西亚马逊地区水产养殖扩张引发的土地利用转变，发现养殖池塘面积增长450倍，主要占用牧场（87%），同时涉及湿地转化（4%）和森林砍伐（5%）。在朗多尼亚州，仅转化1.2%的退化牧场即可使产量翻倍，表明扩张可在已改造土地上持续。将养殖导向退化牧场可减少自然栖息地丧失及碳成本，但需依赖强有力的治理和可执行的土地利用政策来引导选址决策。

papers.title: Socio-economic drivers and governance failures in the artisanal exploitation of marine turtles along the Mogadishu and Adale Coasts, Somalia
papers.authors: Mohamud, Abdinajib Ismail; Ali, Hassan Kasim; Mohamed, Mohamed Abdi; Mohamed, Yusuf Hassan
papers.abstract: Empirical data on artisanal marine turtle extraction in Somalia remains exceptionally scarce. This study documents the socio-economic drivers, operational methods, and local perceptions surrounding the illicit capture of marine turtles at artisanal landing sites along the Mogadishu and Adale coasts. Using purposive and snowball sampling, semi-structured interviews were conducted with 25 active artisanal fishermen and 5 institutional informants (N = 30). Respondents described extraction not as incidental bycatch, but a targeted, commercialised activity primarily impacting Green ( Chelonia mydas ) and vulnerable Loggerhead ( Caretta caretta ) turtles. The economic incentive is substantial, with intact turtles commanding up to 120 USD. Demand is heavily influenced by ethnobiological beliefs regarding turtle derivatives treating tuberculosis and asthma—uses unsupported by clinical evidence that expose consumers to chelonitoxism and heavy metal bioaccumulation risks. Reported frequencies are presented as counts of the 25 fishermen respondents with percentages and 95% confidence intervals, and represent recalled self-report from a small non-probability sample rather than verified catch records. Fishers primarily use large-mesh Ildheer gillnets in nearshore seagrass beds. Despite federal prohibitions under the Somali Fisheries Law, local enforcement at artisanal landing sites is functionally absent, mirroring constraints in Somalia’s industrial fisheries. These findings suggest that purely top-down enforcement is insufficient in this fragile governance context. Locally negotiated co-management arrangements, combined with targeted public health messaging regarding the severe toxicological risks of turtle consumption, represent a more viable, evidence-based policy direction.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过滚雪球抽样和半结构化访谈（N=30）调查了索马里摩加迪沙和阿代尔海岸手工渔业中非法捕捞海龟的社会经济驱动因素、作业方式及当地认知。结果显示，捕捞并非偶然兼捕，而是以绿海龟和易危蠵龟为目标的商业化活动，单只海龟售价高达120美元，需求受龟类衍生物可治疗结核病和哮喘的民族生物学观念驱动，但缺乏临床证据且存在龟毒素和重金属累积风险。尽管索马里渔业法明令禁止，但手工登陆点的地方执法实际缺位。研究建议，在脆弱治理背景下，单纯自上而下的执法难以奏效，应结合当地协商的共管安排及针对龟类消费毒理学风险的公共卫生宣传，作为更可行的循证政策方向。

papers.title: Correction to: Reproductive Biology and Maturity Size of the Lessepsian Shrimp Penaeus Hathor (Decapoda: Penaeidae) in the Eastern Mediterranean
papers.authors: Işik, Hande Kazanci; Özvarol, Yaşar
papers.journal: Thalassas: An International Journal of Marine Sciences
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对东地中海地区Lessepsian迁移物种Penaeus hathor（对虾科）的繁殖生物学与性成熟体长进行了修正性研究，旨在明确其繁殖特征及最小成熟规格。通过分析样本的性腺发育阶段和形态测量数据，确定了该物种的性成熟体长范围及繁殖周期。研究发现其繁殖生物学特性与本地种群存在差异，为东地中海渔业资源管理提供了关键生物学参数。

papers.title: Mortality in Salmon ( Salmo salar ) Fry Related to Lipoid Liver Disease Induced by Unbalanced Fatty Acid Composition of the Diet
papers.authors: Ek, Caroline; Persson, Lo; Axén, Charlotte
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In 2023, all but one Swedish restocking farm rearing Baltic salmon and sea trout fry experienced massive mortality caused by lipoid liver disease (LLD). The struck farms used the same feed, and this was suspected to be the cause of the outbreak. We performed two parallel feed trials in three salmon populations as well as fatty acid and antioxidant analyses of feed and fish to investigate the causal relationship between the feed and the LLD mortality. Significant mortality was induced in one population and LLD histopathology was induced in all three populations in groups fed the suspected feed (test feed) but not in the control groups, linking the test feed to the outbreak in 2023. Fatty acid analysis revealed a difference in bound fatty acid composition between the suspected feed and the control feeds, including higher amounts of erucic acid. Erucic acid has negative health effects for fish by altering lipid metabolism. It is present in for example, capelin, a main ingredient in this feed. The test feed also contained lower levels of several antioxidants, especially vitamin A. Antioxidative status of the fish could not be fully analysed but results indicated a difference in antioxidative status between the populations.
papers.summary_cn: 2023年瑞典多个波罗的海鲑鱼及海鳟养殖场因脂质肝病（LLD）爆发大规模死亡，疑似与特定饲料相关。通过三个鲑鱼种群的平行投喂试验及脂肪酸和抗氧化剂分析，证实该饲料可诱导LLD组织病理学变化，且其结合型脂肪酸组成异常（如芥酸含量升高）并缺乏多种抗氧化剂（尤其维生素A），可能是致病关键因素。

papers.title: A disease trap for wild and farmed salmon in British Columbia, Canada
papers.authors: Krkošek, Martin
papers.abstract: Recent theory has shown that ecological and economic interactions between wild and farmed fish can result in unstable tipping points between a fishery-dominated versus an aquaculture-dominated coastal sea. In this Perspective, I argue that the essential features needed for such bistability are present for wild and farmed salmon in British Columbia (BC), Canada. Specifically, a disease trap is created by a feedback loop involving fisheries decline, incentives for aquaculture growth, and parasite transmission. Under these conditions, theory predicts that wild salmon populations can become trapped in a collapsed state by the pathogen community maintained in coastal seas by salmon farms. Importantly, it is not needed for pathogen transmission to be involved in the original cause of fishery collapse, which is considered to be multifactorial for wild salmon in BC. The theory is relevant to recovery efforts for wild salmon and policy on salmon aquaculture in British Columbia, for which a path can be charted that either entrenches or avoids a disease trap.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省野生与养殖鲑鱼间的生态经济互动，提出疾病陷阱（disease trap）机制：渔业衰退、养殖扩张激励与寄生虫传播形成正反馈，导致野生鲑鱼种群可能被困于崩溃状态。理论表明，即使病原传播非渔业崩溃的初始原因，养殖场维持的病原群落仍可锁定野生种群的低丰度。该框架为BC省野生鲑鱼恢复及养殖政策提供决策路径，可导向规避或固化疾病陷阱。

papers.title: Global introduction and impacts of alien freshwater fish
papers.authors: Chen, Xing; Wang, Tao; He, Fengzhi
papers.abstract: Many freshwater fish species, including carps, salmonids, and catfishes, have been widely introduced outside their native ranges. These introductions can lead to profound ecological consequences. Here, we assessed the environmental impacts of alien freshwater fish, including their influence on abiotic variables, native species, and ecosystem function in the introduced regions. Following the Extended Environmental Impact Classification for Alien Taxa (EEICAT) framework and associated metrics, we analyzed the impact severity and mechanisms of the records related to alien freshwater fish in the InvaPact database, which used large language models to extract and categorize environmental impacts posed by alien species. We have identified over 8000 records, covering hundreds of alien freshwater fish species observed in all continents except for Antarctic. Various negative impacts were posed on native species by alien freshwater fish through a wide range of mechanisms, with predation being the most frequently reported mechanism, followed by herbivory and competition. Moreover, more than half of these species contributed to population decline or even local extinction of at least one native species. In addition, alien freshwater fish also caused alteration of abiotic environment and fundamental ecosystem functions, leading to water quality degradation and modified food webs. Our results demonstrate the necessity of shifting from species-level monitoring toward multi-dimensional assessments that capture the complex impacts posed by alien species, which can contribute to the development of holistic management strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究评估了全球外来淡水鱼类（如鲤科、鲑科及鲶科）的环境影响，基于EEICAT框架和InvaPact数据库中的8000余条记录，利用大语言模型提取并分类其影响机制。结果显示，捕食是最常见的影响机制，其次为植食和竞争；超过半数物种导致至少一种本地物种种群下降或局部灭绝，同时改变非生物环境与生态系统功能（如水质退化、食物网改变）。研究强调需从物种级监测转向多维评估，以支持综合管理策略。

papers.title: Integrating behavioural ecology into invasion biology: insights from freshwater fishes in Mexico
papers.authors: Camacho-Cervantes, Morelia
papers.abstract: Biological invasions are a major driver of biodiversity loss, with impacts emerging from individual interactions to ecosystem-level processes. Here, we synthesise findings from multiple published experimental and field studies on freshwater fishes in Mexico to evaluate how behavioural mechanisms influence invasion dynamics and their ecological consequences. Across laboratory behavioural experiments, mesocosm studies, and field surveys involving native and invasive poeciliid and goodeid fishes, we quantified behavioural traits including heterospecific sociability and behavioural plasticity, and assessed their effects on invasion success, native species persistence, and community structure. Experimental studies showed that invasive fishes consistently altered social behaviour, habitat use, and reproductive interactions of native species, including species involved in reintroduction programmes. Field-based community and functional diversity analyses further revealed reductions in functional richness and increasing biotic homogenisation in systems exposed to multiple invasions. Moreover, global change drivers, including climate warming and chemical pollution, amplify these effects by modifying behavioural responses and interaction outcomes. Our findings highlight that incorporating behavioural mechanisms into invasion ecology frameworks is essential to predict invasion trajectories and to design effective management and mitigation strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究整合墨西哥淡水鱼类的实验与野外数据，探讨行为机制如何影响生物入侵动态及其生态后果。通过实验室行为实验、中宇宙研究和野外调查，量化了本地与入侵花鳉科及古德鱼科鱼类的异种社交性和行为可塑性，发现入侵鱼类持续改变本地物种的社会行为、栖息地利用和繁殖互动。野外群落与功能多样性分析显示，多次入侵导致功能丰富度下降和生物同质化加剧，而气候变暖和化学污染等全球变化因子通过调节行为反应进一步放大这些效应。研究强调，将行为生态学纳入入侵生物学框架对预测入侵轨迹和制定管理策略至关重要。

papers.title: Temporal invasion regimes modulate stability in native riverine fish communities
papers.authors: Rocha, Barbbara; Arranz, Ignasi; Saito, Victor
papers.abstract: Temporal stability is a fundamental property of ecological communities because it reflects their capacity to maintain structure and functioning under environmental change. A key mechanism expected to support this stability is interspecific asynchrony, in which declines in some populations are compensated by increases in others, buffering fluctuations at the community level. In freshwater fish assemblages, stability may also be reflected in the temporal consistency of community size structure, an important dimension of community organization. Understanding how these processes respond to biological invasions is essential for identifying mechanisms that sustain native communities in impacted ecosystems. Here, we evaluated the effects of invasion pressure and its temporal variability on stability in native fish communities and tested how asynchrony contributes to stability under invasion. We hypothesized that: communities exposed to higher invasion pressure would exhibit lower stability, particularly when invasion regimes were more pulsed than chronic; and asynchronous population dynamics would enhance native community stability under invaded conditions. communities exposed to higher invasion pressure would exhibit lower stability, particularly when invasion regimes were more pulsed than chronic; and asynchronous population dynamics would enhance native community stability under invaded conditions. To test these hypotheses, we analyzed 270 freshwater fish community time series from French rivers, each monitored for 10 years. We used linear models to assess relationships between invasion metrics and two response variables: community stability and the coefficient of variation of size-spectrum slopes over time. Our results showed that sites with higher mean relative abundance of non-native fishes had lower stability and greater variability in community size structure. Moreover, the negative effects of invasion pressure were stronger under more variable invasion regimes, indicating that fluctuations in non-native abundance can amplify the destabilizing effects of sustained invasion pressure. In contrast, asynchrony was positively associated with community stability, indicating that compensatory dynamics among native populations can buffer invasion effects. Together, these findings suggest that non-native fishes erode the temporal stability of native assemblages, while asynchronous dynamics help buffer community fluctuations in impacted freshwater ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于法国河流270个淡水鱼类群落10年时间序列，评估入侵压力及其时间变异性对本地群落稳定性的影响。结果显示，非本地鱼类平均相对丰度越高，群落稳定性越低且体型结构变异性越大；入侵压力波动加剧时，其负面效应更强。种间异步性则与稳定性正相关，可缓冲入侵干扰。研究表明，非本地鱼类侵蚀本地群落时间稳定性，而异步种群动态有助于缓解入侵影响。

papers.title: <b>A Strategic Analysis of a Decade of India’s Climate-Resilient Initiatives for Sustainable Fisheries (2014 – 2023) under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana</b>
papers.authors: Sachdev, Karishma
papers.abstract: The Indian Fisheries sector is grappling with anthropogenic climate-change related challenges such as rising sea temperatures, dwindling catch volumes, migration of favourable species from traditional breeding grounds. Climate change is generally considered anthropogenic as it is caused by human activities such as increased maritime trade, oil spills, GHG emissions, large mechanised trawlers which make governance of oceans particularly difficult.The Blue revolution scheme for Integrated Development and Management of Fisheries (FY2015 -2016) with a budgeted expenditure of Rs.3000 crores over five years, laid the foundation for targeted policy intervention to make the fishery sector sustainable. The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana ( PMMSY, 2020 -2025), further integrated efforts of The Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, State Fisheries Departments, ICAR-Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute (CMFRI), Institutional lending intermediaries (NABARD) and fishery self -help groups to make this sector climate-resilient and sustainable. This paper examines the effect of aquaculture investment in cage farming, sea-weed cultivation, shrimp culture, and ornamental fisheries on production, productivity and export earnings of the fisheries sector. There is evidence of a marked decline in marine dependence and greater climate-resilience due to rapid increase in inland aquaculture production.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对印度2014-2023年间在Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana（PMMSY）框架下的气候韧性渔业可持续发展举措进行了战略分析。研究聚焦于水产养殖投资（包括网箱养殖、海藻栽培、对虾养殖和观赏渔业）对产量、生产力和出口收益的影响，并评估了这些举措在应对海水升温、捕捞量下降等气候变化挑战中的成效。主要发现表明，内陆水产养殖的快速增长显著降低了对海洋资源的依赖，增强了渔业部门的气候韧性。

papers.title: Seasonal Shifts in Collective Behaviour of Floodplain‐Associated Schooling Fish
papers.authors: Quade, Adam H.; Boyle, Kelly S.; Rieucau, Guillaume
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Seasonal flood pulses are associated with environmental variability in large river‐floodplain ecosystems, yet the influence on schooling fish remains poorly understood. We used high‐resolution imaging sonar to conduct the first in situ assessment of collective behaviour in a Lower Mississippi River Basin floodplain habitat in order to test the hypothesis that floodplain‐associated schooling fish alter their collective behaviour in response to changes in floodplain connectivity. As schooling is known to be an adaptive strategy, greater behavioural plasticity would allow schooling individuals to appropriately react to changes in environmental conditions, predation risk and foraging opportunities. We recorded 56 h of video across sites located near and far from the initial point of floodplain inundation during connected (high‐water) and disconnected (low‐water) periods spanning all four seasons. School area, alignment (polarisation) and inter‐individual distance (nearest‐neighbour distance) were quantified from 5085 schools comprising 120,114 individuals using a semi‐automated approach. Smallest school areas were observed at near sites during disconnected‐fall. Schools at the far sites during connected‐summer were typically of a larger area than disconnected‐summer at near or far sites. Fish swam in a more aligned fashion during connected‐summer, while inter‐individual distances were lowest during connected‐spring and disconnected‐summer. Results suggest schooling fish inhabiting the floodplain exhibit behavioural changes at the level of their collective in response to changes in the local environmental conditions. Our findings extend the flood pulse concept beyond traditional assemblage‐level response by demonstrating that floodplain connectivity is associated with shifts in the collective behaviour of schooling fishes inhabiting this dynamic environment.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用高分辨率成像声纳，首次在密西西比河下游洪泛区实地评估集群鱼类的集体行为，检验洪泛区连通性变化影响其行为可塑性的假说。通过分析四个季节连通与断开期共5085个鱼群（120114尾个体）的录像，量化了鱼群面积、极化和最近邻距离。结果显示，鱼群面积在秋季断开期近点最小，夏季连通期远点最大；连通春季和断开夏季的个体间距最低，连通夏季游泳方向更一致。研究表明洪泛区鱼类集体行为随环境条件变化而调整，将洪泛脉冲概念从群落响应扩展至行为层面。

papers.authors: Kofentová, Nikola; Horký, Pavel; Valchářová, Tereza; Slavík, Ondřej
papers.abstract: Abstract Successfully overcoming lateral barriers in rivers is crucial for longitudinal fish migration and is influenced mainly by fishway design, environmental variability and/or individual behavioural traits. Although behavioural traits are well studied in many contexts, their role in predicting fishway passage success in the wild remains poorly understood. In a one‐year study (Úhlava River, Elbe catchment area, Czech Republic), we analysed the behavioural measures of 60 adult brown trout ( Salmo trutta ) and observed their seasonal migrations including passage through a bypass fishway. Wild brown trout were captured in the river upstream of a fishway, and their behavioural measures, for example, decision‐making latency and indicators of laterality, were tested in an experimental T‐maze. Individuals were thereafter tagged with transmitters equipped with temperature sensors and released into the river downstream of the fishway, and their movement activities were observed. Their positions were recorded weekly during the annual period. Overall, the fishway passage efficiency reached 73%, with higher success during the autumn. Individuals with higher movement activity were more successful at passing through the fishway. Passage probability was negatively related to flow rate and positively related to decision‐making latency, indicating that individuals that took longer to solve the T‐maze were more likely to pass. Rightward laterality‐biased fish had significantly lower passage success than leftward laterality‐biased or non‐responding fish did. Moreover, rightward laterality‐biased fish lacked the negative relationship between preferred temperature and movement activity observed in leftward laterality‐biased and non‐responding fish, indicating a possible disruption of the behavioural syndrome. Although the studied fishway proved generally effective, our results tend to show a selective impact on the local trout population when behavioural measures are considered.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了行为特征对褐鳟（Salmo trutta）季节性洄游中鱼道通过成功率的影响，基于捷克Úhlava河一年内60尾成年个体的追踪与T-maze实验。结果显示鱼道总通过效率为73%，秋季成功率更高，且高活动性个体更易通过；通过概率与流速负相关，与决策潜伏期正相关，右偏侧化个体成功率显著低于左偏侧化或无响应个体。研究还发现右偏侧化鱼缺乏偏好温度与活动性间的负相关，暗示行为综合征可能受干扰。尽管鱼道总体有效，但行为特征可能导致对当地褐鳟种群的选择性影响。

papers.title: Season, latitude, and seascape features drive fisheries interaction risk for albatrosses and shearwaters.
papers.authors: Walton, Lisa A; Schoeman, David S; Scales, Kylie L
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了季节、纬度及海景特征（如海洋地形、水深等）对信天翁和剪嘴鸥渔业互作风险的影响。通过分析这些环境因子，揭示了不同时空尺度下海鸟与渔业活动重叠的驱动机制。研究发现，季节变化和纬度梯度显著调节风险水平，而特定海景特征（如大陆架边缘）会加剧互作概率。研究结果为渔业管理中的海鸟兼捕缓解策略提供了关键生态学依据。

papers.title: Study on the Measurement and Enhancement Pathways of Ecological Efficiency of Marine Fisheries in China’s Coastal Areas
papers.authors: Zhang, Xueqi; Zhu, Siyan
papers.abstract: Marine fisheries play a vital role in ensuring food supply and sustaining livelihoods in coastal regions of China. However, the expansion of aquaculture has led to increasing carbon emissions and mounting pressure on resources and the environment, making the improvement of ecological efficiency a critical issue for the sustainable development of the industry. From the perspective of carbon emissions as undesirable output, this paper employs the DEA-SBM model and the GML index to measure the ecological efficiency of marine fisheries across nine coastal provinces in China from 2006 to 2023. Furthermore, using fixed-effects models, mediation-effect models, and grouped regression models, this study empirically examines the impacts of fishermen’s income and environmental regulations on the ecological efficiency of marine fisheries and their transmission mechanisms. The results indicate that ecological efficiency exhibits fluctuating trends across provinces, with significant inter-provincial disparities. Fishermen’s income has a significant positive effect on ecological efficiency, while environmental regulations show a significant negative effect. Digitalization level significantly promotes ecological efficiency, whereas fishery disaster losses significantly inhibit it. Technological adoption intention plays a partial mediating role in the pathways through which both fishermen’s income and environmental regulations affect ecological efficiency. Significant regional heterogeneity is observed, with the eastern coastal region exhibiting the strongest effects of various factors and the northern coastal region showing the weakest. Accordingly, this paper proposes differentiated enhancement pathways for ecological efficiency from four dimensions, including technological innovation-driven development, industrial structure optimization, environmental policy regulation, and regional coordinated governance, with the aim of providing theoretical foundations and policy references for the low-carbon transformation and sustainable development of marine fisheries in China’s coastal areas.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于碳排放非期望产出视角，采用DEA-SBM模型和GML指数测度2006—2023年中国九省沿海地区海洋渔业生态效率，并结合固定效应、中介效应及分组回归模型分析渔民收入与环境规制的影响机制。结果显示，生态效率呈波动趋势且省际差异显著；渔民收入显著促进生态效率，环境规制显著抑制，数字化水平起正向作用，灾害损失则相反，技术采纳意愿在两条路径中发挥部分中介效应，且东部沿海地区效应最强、北部最弱。据此提出技术创新、产业优化、政策调控与区域协同四维差异化提升路径，为低碳转型提供参考。

papers.title: Organizational diversity and governance challenges in small-scale fisheries: insights from Southern Jalisco Coast, Mexico
papers.authors: Aranda-Fragoso, Adán; Castillo, Alicia; Nenadovic, Mateja; Ayala-Orozco, Bárbara; Basurto, Xavier
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦墨西哥南哈利斯科海岸小规模渔业（small-scale fisheries）的组织多样性与治理挑战，旨在揭示该区域渔业管理中的制度复杂性。通过实地调研与案例分析方法，识别出多种组织形式（如合作社、社区团体及个体渔民）并存的现象，并剖析其间的协调障碍与权力失衡。研究发现，治理碎片化、资源使用权冲突及缺乏参与式机制是主要挑战，建议加强多层级协作与适应性管理以提升治理效能。

papers.title: Lipidome of Endemic Fish Comephorus dybowskii (Scorpaeniformes, Comephoridae) in Lake Baikal Plays an Essential Role in Maintaining Organism Homeostasis Due to Biomembrane Modifications and Metabolic Consistency
papers.authors: Voronin, Viktor P.; Voronina, Ekaterina D.; Etingova, Anna A.; Didorenko, Sergey I.; Nemova, Nina N.; Murzina, Svetlana A.
papers.abstract: The lipid and fatty acid composition of the little Baikal oilfish (Comephorus dybowskii Korotneff, 1905) was studied to identify the features of its biochemical adaptation to the environmental conditions of Lake Baikal. Multivariate analysis of lipid classes and FA profiles revealed reproducible clustering patterns in both muscle tissue and whole-body samples, indicating the presence of distinct physiological states differing in membrane organization and lipid metabolism. Lipid-class variability was primarily associated with sphingomyelin, cholesterol esters, phosphatidylinositol, and lysophosphatidylcholine, suggesting the coordinated regulation of membrane structure. The fatty-acid profiles were mainly presented by variations in saturated, monounsaturated, and long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acids, with muscle tissues characterized by a relatively longer carbon chain (ACL = 19 vs. 18 I whole body) and unsaturation (UI = 1.98–2.76 vs. 1.64–2.53 in whole body). At the same time, comparative analysis demonstrated low correspondence between lipid and FA profiles, indicating partially independent adaptive mechanisms. The experimental transfer of fish from their natural habitat to controlled conditions resulted in the significant remodeling of both lipid and FA compositions, including increases in acylglycerols, membrane phospholipids, and monounsaturated fatty acids, together with a decline in long-chain n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids. The results suggest that lipid classes and fatty acids represent complementary but functionally distinct levels of biochemical adaptation contributing to the maintenance of membrane organization and metabolic homeostasis in C. dybowskii, revealing a previously undescribed multi-level organization of lipid-related adaptive responses in this endemic deep-water fish.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了贝加尔湖 endemic 油鱼（Comephorus dybowskii）的脂质及脂肪酸组成，旨在揭示其生化适应机制。多变量分析显示肌肉和全鱼样本中脂质类别与脂肪酸谱存在可重复的聚类模式，主要受鞘磷脂、胆固醇酯、磷脂酰肌醇及溶血磷脂酰胆碱调控，且脂肪酸谱以饱和、单不饱和及长链多不饱和脂肪酸变异为主，肌肉组织碳链长度（ACL=19）和不饱和度（UI=1.98–2.76）高于全鱼。实验性转移至人工环境后，脂质和脂肪酸组成显著重塑，包括酰基甘油和膜磷脂增加、长链n-3多不饱和脂肪酸下降。结果表明，脂质类别与脂肪酸构成互补但功能独立的适应层级，共同维持该深水鱼类的膜组织和代谢稳态，揭示了一种此前未描述的多层次脂质适应机制。

papers.title: ANALISIS MEKANISME RANDOM NUMBER GENERATOR (RNG) TERHADAP DISTRIBUSI HASIL TANGKAPAN IKAN PADA GAME FISH IT DI PLATFORM ROBLOX
papers.authors: Haviv, Muhammad
papers.journal: Jurnal Informatika dan Teknik Elektro Terapan
papers.abstract: Random Number Generator (RNG) merupakan mekanisme yang banyak digunakan dalam game digital untuk menghasilkan hasil berbasis probabilitas. Salah satu game yang menerapkan mekanisme tersebut adalah Fish It pada platform Roblox, di mana hasil tangkapan ikan ditentukan berdasarkan tingkat kelangkaan (rarity) tertentu. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis distribusi hasil tangkapan ikan yang dihasilkan oleh sistem RNG serta menguji perbedaan hasil tangkapan berdasarkan karakteristik akun pemain. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan metode eksperimen melalui pengumpulan 5.999 data hasil tangkapan ikan dari dua kelompok akun yang berbeda. Data dianalisis menggunakan statistik deskriptif, uji Chi-Square, dan uji Mann–Whitney U. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kategori Uncommon merupakan hasil tangkapan yang paling dominan, sedangkan kategori Mythic dan Secret memiliki frekuensi kemunculan yang sangat rendah. Uji Chi-Square menghasilkan nilai signifikansi sebesar 0,000 (p < 0,05), sedangkan uji Mann–Whitney U menghasilkan nilai signifikansi sebesar 0,010 (p < 0,05). Hasil tersebut menunjukkan adanya perbedaan distribusi hasil tangkapan yang signifikan serta perbedaan antara kelompok akun yang dibandingkan. Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa mekanisme RNG pada Fish It menerapkan konsep weighted probability yang dipengaruhi oleh parameter permainan tertentu.
