papers.title: DIGITALIZATION OF MANAGEMENT AND REGULATION PROCESSES OF THE AQUACULTURE MARKET
papers.authors: Orel, Anna; Orel, Volodymyr
papers.abstract: The article examines the features of digitalization of management and regulation processes of the aquaculture market in modern conditions of economic instability and food challenges. The role of digital technologies in increasing the efficiency of aquaculture enterprises, optimizing management processes, ensuring market transparency and improving state regulation mechanisms is determined. Modern digital tools are analyzed, in particular automated monitoring systems, digital management platforms, analytical data processing systems, artificial intelligence technologies and electronic document management. Particular attention is paid to the prospects for implementing digital solutions to ensure sustainable development of aquaculture, increase product competitiveness and strengthen the food security of the state. The need to form a modern digital infrastructure of the aquaculture market and develop information support for management processes is substantiated. The main problems of the digital transformation of the industry are identified, including an insufficient level of technological support, limited funding and the need to improve the regulatory framework. Digitalization of the management and regulation processes of the aquaculture market is an important prerequisite for increasing the efficiency of the industry, ensuring its innovative development, and adapting to modern global food challenges. The results of the study demonstrate that digital technologies significantly contribute to increasing the transparency, efficiency, and adaptability of management processes in the aquaculture sector. The practical value of the article lies in the possibility of applying the proposed approaches and recommendations by public authorities, regulatory institutions, and aquaculture enterprises to improve management systems, optimize regulatory mechanisms, and support the sustainable development of the aquaculture market under conditions of digital transformation.
papers.summary_cn: 本文探讨经济不稳定与粮食挑战背景下水产养殖市场管理与监管流程的数字化特征，分析数字技术（如自动化监控、管理平台、AI及电子文档）在提升企业效率、优化监管机制和保障市场透明度中的作用。研究发现，数字化显著增强行业管理的透明度、效率与适应性，但面临技术支撑不足、资金有限和法规待完善等挑战。研究结果为政府、监管机构及企业改进管理系统、促进水产养殖可持续发展提供实践参考。

papers.title: Single strain versus multi-strain probiotics in aquaculture: comparative impacts on gut microbiota and immune responses in fish and shellfish
papers.authors: Rai, Nandini; Kachore, Ankit; Julka, J. M.; Mohanty, Bimal P.; Sahoo, Smruti R.; Nan, Fan-Hua; Das, Sofia P.
papers.abstract: Probiotics have gained wide popularity as environmentally sustainable replacement for antibiotics in aquaculture due to their ability to up-regulate the host immune competence and boost disease resistance. However, considerable knowledge is yet to gain regarding differential efficacies and mechanisms of actions of Single-strain vs multi-strain probiotics. In the present review, the differences between the immunomodulatory potentials of Single-strain and multi-strain probiotics in fish and shellfish were thoroughly compared, with focus on immune gene expression of immunity markers and alteration of gut microflora. Single-strain probiotics usually mount a targeted immune response by enhancing the expression of particular immunity parameters, whereas multi-strain probiotics generally interact synergistic to induce more general and enhanced immune response and greater microbial diversity in the gut. Molecular basis and mechanisms underpinning probiotic mediated immunomodulation were also comprehensively documented in this review. Although recent evidence demonstrate that multi-strain probiotics tend to offer a broader and consistent immune defence against pathogens than Single-strain formulations, the efficacy of probiotic supplements is often context-specific, depending on the rearing environmental condition, dosage, strains compatibility etc. The combination of probiotics and biofloc system has been proposed as a promising and eco-friendly technology for the development of the sustainable aquaculture and animal welfare. Finally, existing research gaps and future directions have also been discussed for sustainable aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统比较了水产养殖中单菌株与多菌株益生菌对鱼类和贝类肠道菌群及免疫应答的调节差异。单菌株益生菌通常靶向增强特定免疫参数表达，而多菌株益生菌通过协同作用诱导更广泛、更强的免疫反应，并提高肠道微生物多样性。尽管多菌株制剂在抗病原防御上表现更广谱稳定，其效果受养殖环境、剂量及菌株兼容性等条件制约。综述还探讨了益生菌与生物絮团系统结合的生态友好型应用前景，并指出当前研究缺口及未来方向。

papers.title: PERANCANGAN SISTEM PENGENDALIAN LEVEL AIR MENGGUNAKAN ADAPTIVE PID BERBASIS ESP32 PADA SISTEM FISH COUNTER
papers.authors: Sastrian, Jordan; Rahmadani, Nabila
papers.journal: Jurnal Informatika dan Teknik Elektro Terapan
papers.abstract: Pengendalian level air yang stabil merupakan faktor penting dalam sistem fish counter karena memengaruhi kualitas akuisisi citra dan akurasi penghitungan benih ikan. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengimplementasikan metode Adaptive Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) berbasis sensor ultrasonik HC-SR04 untuk mengendalikan proses pengisian dan pengosongan air secara otomatis pada sistem fish counter. Sistem dikembangkan menggunakan ESP32 sebagai pengendali utama, dua sensor HC-SR04 sebagai umpan balik level air, driver motor L298N untuk mengatur kecepatan pompa, serta solenoid valve sebagai aktuator pengosongan. Parameter Kp, Ki, dan Kd disesuaikan secara real-time berdasarkan nilai error sehingga keluaran PWM berubah mengikuti kondisi level air. Hasil pengujian menunjukkan bahwa sensor HC-SR04 memiliki rata-rata error sebesar 2,39% pada Tangki 1 dan 1,03% pada Tangki 2. Sistem berhasil mencapai setpoint 8 cm dalam waktu 117 detik dengan ketinggian akhir 8,12 cm, menghasilkan overshoot sebesar 1,5% serta respons yang stabil. Selain itu, mekanisme pengosongan berbasis kendali on/off mampu mengosongkan tangki secara konsisten. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penerapan Adaptive PID efektif dalam menjaga kestabilan level air, sehingga mendukung proses akuisisi citra dan meningkatkan keandalan sistem fish counter.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在开发基于ESP32的Adaptive PID水位控制系统，用于fish counter中鱼苗图像采集的水位稳定控制。系统采用HC-SR04超声波传感器反馈水位，通过L298N驱动水泵和电磁阀实现自动充排水，并实时调整Kp、Ki、Kd参数以适应误差变化。测试结果显示，传感器平均误差分别为2.39%（Tangki 1）和1.03%（Tangki 2），系统在117秒内达到8 cm设定点，最终高度8.12 cm，超调量仅1.5%，响应稳定。研究表明，Adaptive PID能有效维持水位稳定，提升fish counter的图像采集质量与计数可靠性。

papers.title: Cobamide Fingerprinting Reveals Nutritional Diversity of Vitamin B12 in Edible Shellfish
papers.authors: Watanabe, Fumio; Koseki, Kyohei; Bito, Tomohiro
papers.abstract: In edible shellfish, vitamin B12 content has traditionally been evaluated based on total content; however, recent studies reveal substantial diversity in corrinoid composition among species. This review integrates molecular and ecological perspectives to reassess vitamin B12 levels in shellfish using cobamide fingerprinting. Filter-feeding bivalves generally exhibit vitamin B12-dominant profiles, whereas herbivorous gastropods often contain higher proportions of pseudovitamin B12, and carnivorous species display intermediate or vitamin B12-dominant patterns reflecting trophic transfer. In addition, physicochemical form and food processing influence vitamin B12 bioavailability. These findings collectively demonstrate that a precise nutritional assessment requires a comprehensive evaluation of both the total content and the molecular makeup of corrinoids.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述通过cobamide指纹分析技术，重新评估了可食用贝类中维生素B12的营养价值，发现不同摄食习性的贝类其corrinoid组成存在显著差异：滤食性双壳类以维生素B12为主，草食性腹足类常含较高比例pseudovitamin B12，肉食性种类则呈中间型或维生素B12主导型。研究强调，精确的营养评估需同时考虑总含量与corrinoid分子组成，且加工方式会影响其生物利用度。

papers.title: Assessing fish diversity in the Amazon: The impact of primers and reference libraries in eDNA surveys
papers.authors: Hashimoto, Shizuka; Carvalho, Sarah V.; Miranda, Sonny de S. C.; Machado, Valéria N.; Carvalho, Lucélia N.; de Deus, Cláudia P.; Farias, Izeni P.; Hrbek, Tomas
papers.abstract: Selecting primers for DNA amplification poses a challenge in environmental DNA (eDNA) studies, particularly in biodiverse tropical ecosystems. Researchers must balance taxonomic coverage, primer specificity, and study feasibility when choosing between a single primer pair and multiple primer pairs. Empirical tests comparing these strategies are essential for improving eDNA protocols, enhancing the detection of aquatic biodiversity, and supporting conservation and environmental monitoring efforts. This study aimed to evaluate how different approaches affect the specificity and efficiency of detecting fish species in eDNA samples from the Teles Pires River basin. We (1) synthesized modified versions of primers commonly used in ichthyofaunal surveys; (2) compared the results generated by these modified primers with the standard primer versions; and (3) evaluated the species detection using two reference sequence databases: a global taxonomic database (GenBank) and a locally constructed taxonomic database containing samples of fish species previously collected in situ. The 12S-V5_mod primers detected the most fish species across the databases (67, 104, and 130 in the Midori2, Local, and joint databases, respectively), followed by the MiFish_mod primers, which detected 47, 101, and 114 species. Finally, the MiFish primers detected 39, 73, and 78 species. However, the 12S-V5_mod primers also had lower taxonomic specificity of fish species and amplified a broader range of vertebrate taxa than the MiFish_mod primers. The modified primers outperformed the MiFish primers, and detectability nearly doubled when the Local reference database was used. These results speak to the critical need for constructing reference databases of regional biodiversity, and the need to incorporate multiple primer pairs in eDNA studies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了不同引物组合及参考数据库对亚马逊Teles Pires河流域eDNA鱼类多样性检测的影响。通过比较12S-V5_mod、MiFish_mod及标准MiFish引物，结合全球（GenBank）与本地参考数据库，发现12S-V5_mod引物检出物种数最多（联合数据库达130种），但特异性较低；本地数据库使检出率近乎翻倍。结果表明，区域参考数据库的构建及多引物策略对提升eDNA调查准确性至关重要。

papers.title: From acceptance to support: fishers’ pathways to adopting circle hooks to reduce sea turtle bycatch
papers.authors: Vina, Michael A.; Christie, Patrick; Pollnac, Richard B.; Gaibor, Nikita; Voorhies, Kristen; Jenkins, Lekelia Danielle
papers.abstract: Sea turtle bycatch remains a critical obstacle to marine biodiversity conservation in the Eastern Pacific longline fishery. While circle hooks are proven to reduce sea turtle bycatch, uptake in longline fleets remains patchy. Drawing on semi-structured interviews and surveys conducted with fishers, NGO staff, and change agents, this paper explores the multiscale drivers of circle hook adoption and the social contingencies that shape initial acceptance and sustained support for circle hooks in Ecuadorian and Costa Rican longline fisheries. By juxtaposing two nations with contrasting market infrastructures, the study highlights how place-based economic contexts shape global biodiversity strategies. Our findings show that early experiences with circle hooks strongly shaped later trajectories. In Ecuador, low-quality carbon hooks, underperformance for mahi-mahi, and high tariffs on stainless-steel hooks produced negative first impressions and structural barriers, despite promotional hook-exchange programs. In Costa Rica, established retail networks normalized the use of circle hooks, yet concerns about mahi-mahi catch persisted, and uptake of the complementary conservation technologies of dehookers and dipnets was low. Across both countries, perceptions of fairness and effectiveness—and in Santa Marianita, Ecuador, the shark-fin market—mediated adoption, producing unpredictable, sometimes perverse paths from acceptance to support. Extending scholarship on transition to sustainable technologies, we introduce a temporal, agency-centered distinction between acceptance and support for marine conservation technology. Our findings indicate that adopting a conservation technology does not imply a conservation value or intention. We distinguish acceptance as passive, short-term tolerance, whereas support entails active, value-driven commitment, which may be shaped by conservation values, economic incentives, or both. Treating acceptance and support as interchangeable obscures the temporal and agency dimensions critical for scaling marine conservation technologies. We argue that programs seeking biodiversity gains must explicitly aim to cultivate support that aligns fishers’ economic realities with conservation values and intentions, rather than treating adoption of a conservation technology as sufficient.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨东太平洋延绳钓渔业中渔民采用圆钩以减少海龟兼捕的多尺度驱动因素，基于对厄瓜多尔和哥斯达黎加渔民、NGO人员及变革推动者的半结构化访谈与调查。研究发现，早期使用体验显著影响后续采用路径：厄瓜多尔因低质碳钢钩、马希马希渔获表现不佳及不锈钢钩高关税形成结构性障碍，而哥斯达黎加虽有成熟零售网络但马希马希渔获担忧仍存，且配套脱钩器和捞网采用率低。作者提出接受（被动短期容忍）与支持（主动价值驱动承诺）的时间性区分，强调采用保护技术不等于具备保护意图，项目需将渔民经济现实与保护价值观相结合以培育持续支持。

papers.title: Assessment of Isopod Parasitic Infestation among Economically Valuable Marine Fish Species in Coastal Purba Medinipur,  West Bengal, India
papers.authors: Shit, Subhadip; Saxsena, Shriparna; Payra, Pijush
papers.journal: Journal of Advances in Biology & Biotechnology
papers.abstract: Aims: To determine the temporal and spatial distribution of marine isopods across two sampling stations (Digha Mohana and Petuaghat) in coastal Purba Medinipur. Study Design: The current research was conducted using weekly surveys at two sampling stations. Owing to increased fishing and fish-landing activities, the surveys were conducted in the morning (6:00–8:00 a.m.) and afternoon (3:00–5:00 p.m.). Place and Duration of Study: The present study was conducted at two renowned fish landing centres, Digha Mohana and Petuaghat, in Purba Medinipur. The study lasted 6 months, from the first week of August 2025 to the last week of January 2026. Methodology: Samples were collected weekly from two fish landing centres, Digha Mohana and Petuaghat, Purba Medinipur. Isopod samples were collected and stored in glass jars containing 8% formalin solution for future research. Results: Nerocila serra and Nerocila sundaica were the most prevalent and widely distributed of the five identified species, suggesting greater adaptability to local environmental conditions and host availability. Nerocila depressa, on the other hand, was relatively uncommon, which may indicate host preference or habitat specificity. Regarding seasonal variation, the post-monsoon to early winter months (October–December) supported higher species occurrence, potentially owing to favourable environmental conditions and increased host abundance. The lower occurrences recorded in August and January demonstrate the influence of seasonal variation on isopod population dynamics. Spatial variation between the two sampling stations indicates that host distribution and local environmental conditions may affect species occurrence. Conclusion: The occurrence of these parasitic isopods at both stations implies that both sites provide suitable habitats. These findings are supported by the diversity analysis, which shows that December 2025 had the highest diversity, followed by October 2025, suggesting favourable ecological conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了印度西孟加拉邦Purba Medinipur沿海两个鱼类登陆中心（Digha Mohana和Petuaghat）经济海鱼中寄生等足类的时空分布。通过为期6个月（2025年8月至2026年1月）的每周采样，共鉴定出5种等足类，其中Nerocila serra和Nerocila sundaica为优势种，而Nerocila depressa较为罕见。研究发现，10月至12月（季风后至初冬）物种出现率最高，且两站点的物种组成差异受宿主分布和环境条件影响，表明该区域为寄生等足类提供了适宜栖息地。

papers.title: From nutrients to nutrition: nitrogen pathways and seafood nutritional quality in the Black Sea - a systematic review
papers.authors: Bisinicu, Elena; Lazar, Luminita; Ristea, Elena
papers.abstract: Small pelagic fish and bivalves from the Black Sea represent a primary dietary source of high-quality protein, omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA), and bioavailable micronutrients. Whether this nutritional contribution is changing under ongoing environmental degradation remains an open and consequential question. A key but underexplored mechanism is the nitrogen pathway: how marine nitrogen dynamics — from riverine inputs through trophic transfer to biochemical incorporation — shape the nutritional quality of seafood remains poorly quantified. This systematic review, conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 guidelines, synthesises evidence on nitrogen pathways from ecosystem inputs to seafood nutritional composition. A structured literature search across Web of Science yielded 265 records, of which 100 peer-reviewed studies were selected for analysis and classified into core (n = 23), supporting (n = 59), and contextual (n = 18) evidence categories. The results reveal a pronounced imbalance: while nitrogen pathways at the ecosystem level are relatively well documented, direct biochemical measurements in key edible species — including horse mackerel ( Trachurus mediterraneus ), red mullet ( Mullus barbatus ), anchovy (Engraulis encrasicolus ), and Mediterranean mussel ( Mytilus galloprovincialis ) remain scarce, and for sprat ( Sprattus sprattus ) are virtually absent. The available evidence suggests that eutrophication-driven shifts in phytoplankton composition and reduced trophic transfer efficiency may contribute to changes in seafood nutritional quality. These findings highlight a critical gap at the interface of marine biogeochemistry and nutritional science. Integrating direct biochemical assessments with ecological monitoring is essential for evaluating seafood as a source of high-quality nutrients and for supporting sustainable marine food systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统综述了黑海氮循环路径（从河流输入到营养级传递及生化合成）对海产品营养品质的影响，遵循PRISMA 2020指南，从Web of Science检索的265篇文献中筛选出100篇同行评审研究，并分为核心（23篇）、支撑（59篇）和背景（18篇）三类证据。结果显示，生态系统层面的氮路径研究相对充分，但关键食用物种（如地中海竹荚鱼、红鲻鱼、鳀鱼和地中海贻贝）的直接生化测量数据稀缺，黍鲱几乎无相关数据。现有证据表明，富营养化驱动的浮游植物群落变化及营养传递效率降低可能改变海产品营养品质。研究强调，需将直接生化评估与生态监测相结合，以填补海洋生物地球化学与营养科学之间的关键空白，支撑可持续海洋食品系统评估。

papers.title: Repeated coral bleaching events have eroded reef accretion potential in the Florida Keys
papers.authors: Toth, Lauren T.; Courtney, Travis A.
papers.abstract: Coral bleaching is now the primary driver of coral-reef degradation globally, threatening the persistence of coral-reef functions and the invaluable ecosystem services they support. The Florida Keys have been impacted by four severe, regional-scale coral-bleaching events, which occurred in 1997–1998, 2005, 2014–2015, and 2023. Our aim in this study was to quantify the effects of those thermal-stress events on the persistence of coral-reef structures. We leveraged long-term coral-reef monitoring data to quantify the impacts of coral bleaching on coral cover, carbonate production, and reef-accretion potential throughout the Florida Keys from 1996–2024. Our study indicates that coral bleaching drove significant declines of reef-building corals, which successively diminished regional-scale reef-accretion potential (from 1.65 ± 0.33 mm y -1 in 1996) and culminated with a regional-scale transition to net reef erosion (-0.12 ± 0.08 mm y -1 ) following the 2023 event. Coral bleaching was the primary driver of declining reef-building capacity, with the cumulative impacts of the four coral-bleaching events accounting for &gt;75% of total declines since 1996. The 1997–1998 event alone drove ~50% of overall declines, largely due to losses of the shallow-water ecosystem engineer, Acropora palmata . More moderate impacts of thermal stress on regional reef-accretion potential in 2005 (6%) and 2014–2015 (9%) could lend some support to the hypothesis that the remaining corals were more thermally tolerant; however, the unprecedented thermal stress event in 2023 caused widespread coral-bleaching and bleaching-related mortality, and caused an additional 12% of the total decline in reef-accretion potential. Stony-coral tissue loss disease accounted for an additional 6% of the decline, with the remaining 19% unexplained. Coral bleaching has already dramatically reshaped the structure and function of coral reefs in the Florida Keys over the last three decades. With the high likelihood that thermal stress will accelerate moving forward, the persistence of Florida’s essential coral-reef functions and services is uncertain.
papers.summary_cn: 佛罗里达珊瑚礁多次白化事件已显著侵蚀其礁体增长潜力。基于1996-2024年长期监测数据，量化了四次区域性热胁迫事件（1997-1998、2005、2014-2015、2023）对珊瑚覆盖度、碳酸盐生产和礁体增长速率的影响。研究发现，白化导致造礁珊瑚持续减少，区域礁体增长潜力从1996年的1.65±0.33 mm/yr降至2023年后的净侵蚀状态（-0.12±0.08 mm/yr），其中四次白化事件贡献了总衰退的75%以上，1997-1998年事件单独造成约50%的下降，主要归因于浅水工程种Acropora palmata的损失。尽管2005和2014-2015年影响相对温和（6%和9%），但2023年极端热胁迫引发广泛白化和死亡，额外贡献12%的衰退；石珊瑚组织损失病另占6%，其余19%原因未明。研究强调，白化已根本性改变佛罗里达珊瑚礁的结构与功能，未来热胁迫加剧下其生态系统服务持续性面临高度不确定性。

papers.title: Assessment of the impacts of mobile bottom-contacting fishing gears on epibenthic communities of the Scotian Shelf and Gulf of Maine (Atlantic Canada)
papers.authors: Hiddink, Jan Geert; van Denderen, P. Daniël; Murillo, Francisco Javier; Kenchington, Ellen
papers.abstract: An assessment of the impacts of mobile bottom-contacting gears (MBCG) on eight previously identified epibenthic communities off Nova Scotia, Canada, is presented using risk-based indicators of Relative Benthic Status (RBS). Indices of both existing biomass relative to carrying capacity of the whole epibenthic community (RBS_tot), and that of the 10% most sensitive fauna (RBS_sen), were quantified and mapped. Substantial regional and habitat-related differences in RBS were identified. Most of the eastern Scotian Shelf, where five benthic community types are recognized, showed low fishing intensity and high seabed status. In contrast, a community characterized by long-lived individuals of echinoderms, sponges and cnidarians on eastern Georges Bank and in the Inner Bay of Fundy, was severely impacted. RBS_tot for that community was in good status on only 48% of the area of the habitat, while RBS_sen met that threshold on only 35% of the area. Our approach allows for the large-scale evaluation of the impacts of MBCG on the benthic communities as a whole and enables evaluation of management scenarios aimed at reducing its environmental effects.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了移动式底接触渔具（MBCG）对加拿大新斯科舍省近海八个底栖动物群落的影响，采用相对底栖状态（RBS）风险指标，量化并绘制了总群落生物量（RBS_tot）和最敏感10%物种生物量（RBS_sen）相对于承载力的现状。结果显示，东部斯科舍陆架大部分区域（五种底栖群落类型）渔业强度低、海底状态良好；而乔治斯浅滩东部和芬迪湾内湾以长寿命棘皮动物、海绵和刺胞动物为特征的群落受损严重，其RBS_tot仅48%面积达标，RBS_sen仅35%面积达标。该方法支持大规模评估MBCG对底栖群落的整体影响，并可用于检验减少环境效应的管理方案。

papers.title: The characteristics and expression profile of follicle‐stimulating hormone and luteinizing hormone during gonadal development in silver pomfret
papers.authors: Guo, Chunyang; Zhang, Dingyuan; Wang, Yi; Wang, Xubo; Xu, Shanliang; Wang, Danli
papers.abstract: Abstract The hypothalamic–pituitary‐gonadal (HPG) axis, particularly follicle‐stimulating hormone (Fsh) and luteinizing hormone (Lh), is essential for the regulation of teleost reproduction. However, their expression dynamics and receptor distribution during gonadal development in silver pomfret remain poorly understood. This study aimed to characterize the expression profiles and cellular localization of Fshβ, Lhβ and their receptors (Fshr and Lhr) in the pituitary and gonads and to evaluate their potential roles in reproductive regulation. The different staining method and transmission electron microscopy (TEM) were used to analyse the structural changes of the pituitary gland during the reproductive season. Quantitative PCR (qPCR) and immunohistochemical (IHC) were used to detect the expression pattern of Fshβ and Lhβ. The results showed that the number of endocrine granules significantly increased before the reproductive season, and their electron density intensified. During the spawning season, the secretory granules gradually depleted, leading to the appearance of vacuolization. In the pituitary gland, the expression of fshβ in Stage IV was significantly higher in the female pituitary, but significantly higher in Stage V in the male. Fshβ and Lhβ signals were mainly located in the proximal pars distalis (PPD) and pars intermedia (PI) regions of the pituitary. In the gonad, Fshr signals were observed in the spermatogonia type A cells and Sertoli cells in testes, whereas Lhr signals were observed in spermatogonia and secondary spermatocytes in the testes. Fshr and Lhr signals were both observed in the follicle cells surrounding the oogonia and vitellogenic oocytes in the ovary of silver pomfret. The expression patterns of fshβ and fshr were essentially similar after different hormone treatments in the gonad and methyltestosterone (MT) could influence the expression of fshβ , lhβ and fshr in the testis. Taken together, our data suggest that Fshβ and Lhβ promote the development and maturation in the gonad, and Fshr and Lhr may be involved in ovary maturation and spawning.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在解析银鲳（Pampus argenteus）性腺发育过程中促卵泡激素（Fsh）和促黄体激素（Lh）及其受体（Fshr、Lhr）的表达动态与细胞定位。通过组织化学染色、透射电镜、qPCR及免疫组化分析，发现生殖季节前垂体内分泌颗粒增多且电子密度增强，产卵期颗粒耗竭并出现空泡化；fshβ在雌鱼IV期、雄鱼V期垂体表达显著升高，信号主要定位于垂体近端 pars distalis（PPD）和 pars intermedia（PI）区域。在性腺中，Fshr和Lhr分别定位于精原细胞A型及支持细胞、精原细胞和次级精母细胞，以及卵巢滤泡细胞和卵黄卵母细胞周围；甲基睾酮（MT）处理可影响睾丸中fshβ、lhβ和fshr的表达。结果表明Fshβ和Lhβ促进性腺发育成熟，Fshr和Lhr可能参与卵巢成熟与产卵调控。

papers.title: Refined analysis of microplastics in endemic fish species from Lake Victoria using µ-FTIR and pyrolysis GC-MS
papers.authors: Omara, Timothy; Benetková, Barbora; Sumerskii, Ivan; Ssebugere, Patrick; Kyarimpa, Christine; Lugasi, Solomon Omwoma; Rosenau, Thomas; Nagawa, Christine Betty; Böhmdorfer, Stefan
papers.abstract: Abstract Pyrolysis–gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (Pyr-GC-MS) has evolved into one of the most powerful methods for microplastics (MPs) analysis. However, analytical challenges are still encountered whenever Pyr-GC-MS is applied to matrices with high organic matter, protein and lipid contents. In this study, a workflow integrating stereomicroscopy, micro-Fourier transform infrared (µ-FTIR) spectroscopy and Pyr-GC-MS was extended to analyse MPs in three endemic fish species ( Protopterus aethiopicus , Rastrineobola argentea and Synodontis victoriae ) from Lake Victoria. Stereomicroscopic analysis only detected MPs in the gastrointestinal tracts of P. aethiopicus and S. victoriae , with the highest mean particle numbers being 16.0 ± 7.8 and 14.7 ± 6.7 items/fish taxon, respectively. No MPs were found in whole samples of R. argentea . The microparticles were mostly blue and brown 0.3–1.9-mm fragments and filaments, which µ-FTIR analysis confirmed to be composed of nylon 66, nylon 6/66, nylon 6/10, nylon 11, polyethylene and polypropylene. Retention time locking and post-column backflush considerably reduced the cycle time and increased stability of the Pyr-GC-MS method. Nylon 66 (243 µg/g in S. victoriae ), nylon 6 (0.24–96 µg/g), polypropylene (6.4 µg/g in P. aethiopicus ), poly(ethylene terephthalate) (1.2–107 µg/g) and styrene-butadiene rubber (8.5–34.8 µg/g) were quantified. Polyethylene and poly(methyl methacrylate) were detected below their limits of quantification. To prevent false positive detection of polyethylene in the lipid-rich tissues, the evaluation focussed on C21-α,ω-alkene as a marker. Polypropylene was not detected in some samples, as it formed several discrete propylene oligomers during pyrolysis, which suppressed the yield of its target quantification marker (2,4-dimethyl-1-heptene).
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对维多利亚湖三种特有鱼类（Protopterus aethiopicus、Rastrineobola argentea和Synodontis victoriae）中的微塑料（MPs）污染，整合立体显微镜、µ-FTIR光谱和Pyr-GC-MS技术建立分析流程。结果显示，MPs仅存在于前两种鱼的胃肠道中，平均颗粒数分别为16.0±7.8和14.7±6.7个/鱼，主要成分为尼龙66、尼龙6/66、尼龙6/10、尼龙11、聚乙烯和聚丙烯。通过保留时间锁定和柱后反吹优化，Pyr-GC-MS方法显著缩短了分析周期并提高了稳定性，成功定量了尼龙66（最高243 µg/g）、尼龙6（0.24–96 µg/g）等聚合物，同时针对脂质丰富组织中的聚乙烯假阳性检测提出了C21-α,ω-烯烃标记物策略。研究为高有机质基质中MPs的精准定量提供了方法学参考。

papers.title: Microplastic Pollution in Marine and Freshwater Fisheries: Ecological Impacts, Trophic Dynamics, and Implications for Fisheries Management
papers.authors: Sophian, Alfi; Ismayani, Erika; Asmariani
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Microplastic (MP) pollution—plastic particles smaller than 5 mm—is now ubiquitous across marine, estuarine, and freshwater environments and poses a pervasive threat to global fisheries. This review synthesises current evidence on MP occurrence, trophic transfer, and sub‐lethal physiological effects in fisheries‐relevant species and their consequences for fisheries productivity and food safety, with particular attention to Indonesia and other tropical, developing‐country contexts underrepresented in the global literature. Microplastics have been detected in over 926 seafood species, with Asian waters among the most contaminated regions, and are documented to cause oxidative stress, growth impairment, reproductive dysfunction, immunosuppression, and neurotoxicity in fish, with trophic magnification factors exceeding 4 reported in oceanic food webs. These effects carry direct implications for fisheries management, including declining population health, reduced recruitment, and threats to food safety, yet regulatory frameworks remain inadequate, with no binding MP limits established by major food safety bodies. We outline management‐oriented recommendations—monitoring protocols, gear modification, and integration of MP risk into stock assessment—and priority directions for future research.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统综述了微塑料（MP）在海洋和淡水渔业中的生态影响、营养级传递动态及其管理启示，重点关注印度尼西亚等热带发展中国家。微塑料已在超过926种海产品中检出，亚洲水域污染最为严重，可导致鱼类氧化应激、生长受阻、繁殖障碍、免疫抑制及神经毒性，海洋食物网中的营养级放大因子超过4。这些效应直接威胁种群健康、补充量及食品安全，但现有监管框架不足，主要食品安全机构尚未设定约束性MP限值。文章提出监测协议、渔具改良及将MP风险纳入stock assessment等管理建议，并指明未来研究方向。

papers.title: Integrated Shrimp Aquaculture Wastewater Treatment and Cultivation of Microalgae Isolated from Mining Area
papers.authors: Deviany, Deviany; Andini, Triya Yuli; Talaga, Aji Hafiz; Andri Sanjaya; Feerzet Achmad; Dennis Farina Nury; Desi Riana Saputri
papers.abstract: Microalgae have a high lipid content, making them a potential feedstock for biofuel production. In this study, microalgae isolated from the Tanggamus mining area was cultivated in liquid medium from shrimp aquaculture waste. The main objectives were to examine the growth of microalgae in shrimp aquaculture waste specifically in liquid waste, sediment waste, and a combination of both to assess whether these waste types can serve as effective cultivation media, and to evaluate the microalgae's adaptability as well as its role in mitigating environmental pollution. The microalgae were cultivated in the three different waste mediums, and the results were compared to a control medium using walne. The findings revealed that shrimp aquaculture sediment supported the highest biomass production, reaching 17.80 mg/L. The mixed media yielded 15.93 mg/L, while the walne control and liquid waste media produced 9.00 mg/L and 3.87 mg/L, respectively. Furthermore, post-cultivation analysis revealed an increase in nutrient concentrations, including nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, in the cultivation medium. The microalgae strain reduced BOD in shrimp aquaculture waste, especially in sediment. COD in liquid waste increased due to complex compounds and cell lysis. Lipid extraction from the microalgal biomass highlighting its potential as a feedstock for biodiesel production. These results suggest that shrimp aquaculture waste, particularly its sediment component, not only serves as a suitable medium for cultivating microalgae, but also contributes to environmentally sustainable practices by helping reduce aquatic pollution and promoting waste-to-resource conversion.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究从Tanggamus矿区分离微藻，将其培养于虾养殖废水的液体、沉积物及混合介质中，以评估其作为培养基的可行性及微藻的环境修复潜力。结果显示，沉积物介质中微藻生物量最高（17.80 mg/L），混合介质次之（15.93 mg/L），均优于walne对照（9.00 mg/L）和液体废水（3.87 mg/L）。培养后介质中氮、磷、钾浓度上升，微藻显著降低沉积物中BOD，但液体废水中COD因复杂化合物和细胞裂解而增加。脂质提取表明该微藻可作为生物柴油原料，证实虾养殖沉积物既能有效支持微藻生长，又促进污染减排和废弃物资源化利用。

papers.title: Cooperatives and Climate Change Adaptation: A Pathway to Conflict Reduction in Artisanal Fisheries Communities in Nigeria
papers.authors: Oparinde, Lawrence Olusola; Hess, Sebastian
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Climate change is having a devastating impact on artisanal fisheries communities in developing countries, including Nigeria. In Nigeria, multiple local conflicts have arisen as a result of climate‐related changes in coastal regions. This study investigates the impact of cooperatives and climate change adaptation on conflicts among artisanal fisherfolk in Nigeria. To capture climate change adaptation complexity, we employed the number of climate change adaptation strategies adopted as a count variable. We applied Endogenous Treatment Poisson Regression and Unconditional Quantile Regression models to analyze cross‐sectional data collected from artisanal fisherfolk in the coastal area of Nigeria. Findings from this research revealed that non‐fishing strategies are equally important as part of the climate change adaptation strategies with 43%, 22%, and 14% of the respondents adopting livelihood diversification, a community conflict resolution committee, and formation of local security outfits (vigilante), respectively. The results further showed that cooperatives play a significant role in increasing the number of climate change adaptation strategies adopted. Also, the study empirically established that cooperatives lessen the incidence, especially of the most severe conflicts among artisanal fisherfolk. Therefore, policy efforts should be geared towards strengthening and developing cooperative societies among artisanal fisherfolk in order to strengthen climate adaptation and reduce conflicts.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨尼日利亚手工渔业社区中合作社与气候变化适应策略对冲突减少的影响。采用内生处理泊松回归和无条件分位数回归分析沿海横截面数据，发现非捕捞策略（如生计多样化、社区冲突解决委员会、地方治安组织）占适应策略的43%、22%和14%。结果表明，合作社显著增加适应策略采纳数量，并有效降低最严重冲突的发生率。政策建议强化合作社发展以促进气候适应和冲突缓解。

papers.title: Reef fish escape responses selectively match predator attack speeds
papers.authors: Neven, Sara Linde; Faber, Lena; Martin, Benjamin T.
papers.abstract: Animals must continually balance foraging with the risk of predation. In complex natural environments, this means quickly distinguishing between threats and harmless situations. We investigated how site-associated coral reef fishes escape in response to visual cues mimicking predator attacks, using controlled underwater presentations of looming stimuli at varying speeds. We measured escape responses across species and social contexts, and compared them to predator attack speeds observed in the same habitat. Escape probability increased sharply with the speed of the looming stimulus, with no responses at low speeds. Stimulus speeds that triggered escape responses matched those of predator attacks, whereas speeds similar to those of cruising predators never triggered a response. The two species differed in behavior: Brown Chromis ranged farther from shelter and responded more readily, whereas Bicolor Damselfish stayed close to shelter and responded less. Contrary to expectations, social context did not affect responses. These findings demonstrate that reef fish are highly sensitive to the approach speed of objects, with species-specific behavior further shaping their responses. By combining realistic visual threats with natural predator attack data, this study offers insight into how animals make rapid escape decisions in complex, real-world environments.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了珊瑚礁鱼类如何根据视觉刺激速度做出逃逸决策，通过在水下控制呈现不同速度的逼近刺激，模拟捕食者攻击，并对比同栖息地捕食者的实际攻击速度。结果显示，逃逸概率随刺激速度增加而急剧上升，低速刺激不引发反应，且触发逃逸的速度与捕食者攻击速度吻合，而巡航速度则无效。两种鱼类的行为存在差异：Brown Chromis离庇护所较远且反应更敏感，Bicolor Damselfish则靠近庇护所且反应较弱，社会背景对逃逸行为无显著影响。该研究揭示了礁鱼对物体接近速度的高度敏感性及物种特异性行为，为理解复杂环境中的快速逃逸决策提供了新视角。

papers.title: Pollutant-induced changes in fish pigmentation and spatial patterns
papers.authors: Chowdhury, Pranali Roy; Wang, Tian Xu; MacDonald, Abbey; Tierney, Keith; Wang, Hao
papers.journal: Journal of the Royal Society Interface
papers.abstract: Abstract Pigmentation abnormalities, ranging from hypo- to hyperpigmentation, can serve as biomarkers of developmental disruption in fish exposed to environmental contaminants. However, the mechanistic pathways underlying these alterations remain poorly understood. Studies have shown that pattern formation in fish development requires specific pigment cell interactions. Motivated by experimental observations of pigmentation alterations following contaminant exposure, we investigate how pollutants influence pigment cell self-organization using a continuum reaction–diffusion–advection framework. The model incorporates non-local Morse-type kernels to describe short- and long-range interactions among melanophores and xanthophores. Our results show that perturbations to the strengths of adhesion or repulsion can drive transitions between stripes, spots and mixed patterns, reproducing phenotypes characteristic of fish pigmentation mutants. In particular, homotypic interactions are sensitive to contamination, leading to pronounced changes in melanophore density and resulting pigmentation patterns. Time-dependent simulations indicate that pigment changes from early short-term contaminant exposure may be recoverable, whereas prolonged exposure can lead to sustained pigment loss. In a growing fish, contaminant-induced changes in cell–cell interactions directly influence stripe formation rate, stripe number and pigmentation levels. Overall, our study provides insight into the mechanistic link between experimentally observed pigmentation alterations and the changes in spatial patterns of adult fish.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究构建反应-扩散-平流模型，结合非局部Morse型核函数，模拟污染物暴露下鱼类色素细胞（melanophores和xanthophores）的自组织行为。结果显示，污染物干扰细胞间粘附或排斥强度可驱动条纹、斑点及混合斑纹间的转换，且同型细胞相互作用对污染尤为敏感，导致黑色素细胞密度显著变化。短期暴露引起的色素改变可能恢复，而长期暴露则造成持续色素损失，并影响生长中鱼类的条纹形成速率和数量。该研究揭示了污染物致鱼类色素异常与成体空间斑纹变化之间的机制联系。

papers.title: Marketing Strategy and Effectiveness to Increase Fresh Fish Retailers' Income in Kalukku Traditional Market, Mamuju Regency
papers.authors: Syarif, M; Kamaruddin; Hamjan, D. F; Normawati, S
papers.journal: International Journal of Educational and Life Sciences
papers.abstract: Trader fresh fish retailers in traditional markets face challenge in the form of instability supply , fluctuations prices and fierce competition​ so that income they not optimal. Research This aim For analyze the marketing strategies implemented as well as its effectiveness in improving income trader fresh fish retailers at traditional markets Kalukku , Regency Mamuju . Research use approach qualitative descriptive with design studies case to informant selected key​ purposively . Primary data was collected through observation participatory , interview in depth , and documentation , then equipped with secondary data from agency related . Data validity is maintained through triangulation sources and methods , whereas data analysis was carried out in a way interactive ( data reduction , data presentation , and data retrieval) conclusion ). Analysis income use formula profit (Pi = TR - TC) and R/C ratio . Research results show that the marketing strategy implemented covers four element mix marketing , namely products ( maintaining the freshness of fish through storage in a box filled with ice), price ( determination price competitive and flexible ), place ( location) strategic and proximity with source catch ), and promotion ( personal service and use of social media ) . economy , with capital of Rp. 700,000 per day and a sales volume of 30 kg, traders get revenue of Rp. 900,000 and profit net Rp. 200,000 per day with R/C value of 1.50, which indicates that business This feasible and profitable . Strengthening marketing strategies based product quality and digitalization promotion recommended For increase Power competitiveness and welfare trader .
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在分析印度尼西亚Mamuju县Kalukku传统市场鲜鱼零售商的营销策略及其对收入提升的有效性。采用定性描述性案例研究方法，通过参与式观察、深度访谈和文献收集数据，并运用利润公式（Pi = TR - TC）和R/C比率评估经济效益。结果显示，营销策略涵盖产品（冰鲜保鲜）、价格（竞争性灵活定价）、地点（靠近渔获源）和促销（个性化服务及社交媒体）四要素，日均资本70万印尼盾、销量30公斤时，净利润20万印尼盾，R/C值为1.50，表明业务可行且盈利。建议强化基于产品质量和数字化推广的营销策略，以提升竞争力和商户福利。

papers.title: The Relationship between Stock Returns and Inflation in the Era of COVID-19 in Nigeria: A Test of Fisher’s Hypothesis
papers.authors: SHITTU, Ibrahim Oladipupo
papers.journal: Journal of Accounting and Financial Management
papers.abstract: The study examined the relationship between stock returns and inflation in Nigeria. It also put to test, the applicability of Fisher’s hypothesis during COVID-19 pandemic. Weekly time series data that covered the period between 27th February, 2020 and 26th February, 2021 were used for the analyses. Unit root test was conducted and results revealed that the variables are of different orders of integration. This justified the use of ARDL estimation technique. The ARDL bound test confirmed the existence of a long run relationship among the variables. Findings revealed that despite COVID-19 pandemic in Nigeria, inflation has positive and significant relationship with stock returns in the long run. The import of this is that, inflation can be used as a hedge against stock returns in Nigeria; hence, the study affirmed the relevance of Fisher’s hypothesis despite COVID-19 pandemic. It was therefore recommended that investors should put their investible funds in Nigerian stock market with or without COVID-19 pandemic.

papers.title: Sensitivity of fish stock trajectories to climate forcing and human exploitation at a global scale
papers.authors: Benerradi, Raphaël; Dakos, Vasilis; Cano, Alejandro V
papers.journal: Journal of the Royal Society Interface
papers.abstract: Abstract Global fisheries are under increasing pressure from overfishing and climate change, threatening marine biodiversity and food security. Disentangling the impacts of these two drivers is essential for sustainable management, yet it remains a major challenge due to the complex nature of marine ecosystems. Here, we utilize a data-driven empirical dynamic modelling framework to assess causal relationships between harvest rate, sea surface temperature (SST), and the productivity of 155 fish stocks worldwide. Our analysis identifies fishing pressure as the most prevalent driver of stock productivity, with a causal link detected in 71 stocks (45.8%). SST was also identified as a significant driver of productivity in 39 stocks (25.2%). While the impact of harvest rate was stock-specific, being either positive or negative, the influence of SST was predominantly negative and, in many cases, intensified over time. These results provide empirical evidence that direct exploitation and climate warming are systematically impacting fish stock productivity, with direct exploitation emerging as the predominant driver across stocks. This predominance suggests that improved harvest management could help buffer or mitigate some of the negative impacts of climate warming on fisheries productivity.
papers.summary_cn: 全球渔业正面临过度捕捞与气候变化的双重压力。本研究利用数据驱动的经验动态建模框架，评估了全球155个鱼类种群的捕捞率、海表温度（SST）与生产力之间的因果关系。结果显示，捕捞压力是影响种群生产力的最主要驱动因素（71个种群，占45.8%），SST对39个种群（25.2%）有显著影响，且其影响多为负面并随时间加剧。研究证实直接捕捞与气候变暖系统性影响鱼类种群生产力，而改进捕捞管理有助于缓冲气候变暖的部分负面效应。

papers.title: Adaptation strategies, perceived effectiveness, and factors associated with selected strategy adoption among seaweed aquaculture households under multiple stressors
papers.authors: Yang, Panpan; Yuan, Haihong; Shen, Langzi; Cao, Wenxuan; Ma, Renfeng
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦多重压力下海藻养殖户的适应策略、感知有效性及策略采纳相关因素。通过调查分析，识别了养殖户应对环境、市场等多重压力的主要适应行为，并评估其主观有效性。进一步探讨了影响特定策略采纳的关键社会经济与制度因素，为提升海藻养殖系统韧性提供实证依据。

papers.title: Nanotechnology‐Based Immunostimulants in Aquaculture: Mechanisms, Advances and Practical Applications
papers.authors: Öz, Mustafa; Üstüner, Enes
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background The rapid expansion of aquaculture has intensified disease outbreaks, increasing antibiotic reliance and accelerating antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Given the ecological and economic consequences of traditional treatments, nanotechnology‐based eco‐efficient alternatives are urgently needed. Objective The primary goal of this manuscript is to critically evaluate the practical applicability, mechanisms of action and safety profiles of nano‐immunostimulants in aquaculture. Furthermore, this review aims to provide a comparative roadmap of major nano‐delivery systems (polymeric, metallic, lipid and carbon‐based), identifying their safety–efficacy trade‐offs to facilitate their transition from laboratory research to commercial aquaculture. Methods A structured literature search was conducted across major databases (PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science and ScienceDirect) targeting nano‐immunostimulants, delivery systems, fish/shellfish immunity and environmental safety. Due to high methodological heterogeneity, data were synthesised qualitatively. Results Polymeric nanocarriers (e.g., chitosan, alginate, PLGA) show the highest translational potential, significantly improving immune biomarkers, bioavailability and survival against major pathogens (e.g., Aeromonas and Vibrio spp.) with favourable safety profiles. While metallic, lipid and carbon‐based nanomaterials exhibit strong immunomodulatory and antimicrobial potential, their practical adoption is currently constrained by variable toxicity, environmental persistence and bioaccumulation risks. Conclusions Nano‐immunostimulants represent a transformative strategy for antibiotic‐free, One Health‐oriented aquaculture. To achieve commercial viability, future research must shift from basic efficacy trials towards green synthesis, standardised ecotoxicological assessments and field‐scale cost‒benefit validation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统综述了纳米免疫刺激剂在水产养殖中的应用，重点评估其作用机制、安全性及实际可行性。通过分析聚合物、金属、脂质和碳基等主要纳米递送系统，发现聚合物纳米载体（如壳聚糖、海藻酸盐、PLGA）在提升免疫指标、生物利用度和抗病原体（如气单胞菌和弧菌）存活率方面最具转化潜力，而金属和碳基材料因毒性及环境持久性受限。研究指出，纳米免疫刺激剂是替代抗生素、符合One Health理念的变革性策略，但未来需聚焦绿色合成、标准化生态毒理评估及规模化成本效益验证，以推动其从实验室走向商业应用。

papers.title: Unexpected enrichment of antibiotic resistance genes in recirculating aquaculture effluents of rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss): microbial community assembly and mobile genetic elements as key drivers
papers.authors: Yang, Xiaofei; Li, Lili; Zhang, Jinxin; Qu, Jiangqi; Xu, Shaogang
papers.abstract: Introduction Recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) are increasingly used in intensive aquaculture because of their capacity to reduce nitrogen, phosphorus, and organic matter discharges. However, whether improved conventional effluent quality is accompanied by a reduced antibiotic resistance gene (ARG) burden remains unclear. Methods During the mid-cultivation stage, effluents were collected from four RAS farms and four paved flow-through raceway systems (PFRS). Water quality parameters, including total nitrogen (TN), total phosphorus (TP), chemical oxygen demand (COD), chlorophyll-a (Chl-a), and dissolved oxygen (DO), were measured. Microbial community composition was characterized using 16S rRNA gene sequencing, while ARGs and mobile genetic elements (MGEs) were quantified using GeoChip 5.0. Multivariate statistics and co-occurrence network analyses were used to evaluate associations among environmental conditions, microbial communities, ARG profiles, and MGE profiles. Results RAS effluents showed substantially lower nutrient and organic loads than PFRS, confirming improved conventional water quality. However, total ARG abundance was significantly higher in RAS than in PFRS, increasing from 35.39 ± 11.43 × 10 6 to 63.99 ± 15.33 × 10 6 , corresponding to a 1.81-fold increase. In contrast, total MGE abundance was numerically higher in RAS but did not differ significantly between systems. Microbial alpha diversity was lower in RAS, and beta diversity analysis showed distinct community structuring between cultivation modes, with both compositional differences and dispersion effects contributing to group separation. ARG class- and subtype-level profiles showed heterogeneous abundance patterns, with several major ARG categories remaining highly abundant in RAS, although most feature-level differences were not significant after FDR correction. Co-occurrence network analysis further revealed structured associations among microbial species, ARGs, and MGEs, with modular organization and highly connected resistance-associated nodes. Conclusion This study demonstrates a “low-pollution but non-reduced ARG burden” pattern in RAS effluents. Improved removal of conventional pollutants did not correspond to a proportional reduction in ARG or MGE profiles. These findings indicate that conventional water-quality indicators alone are insufficient to evaluate resistance-associated genetic pollution in engineered aquaculture systems, and that ARGs, MGEs, microbial community structure, and species–ARG/MGE association patterns should be integrated into future RAS monitoring and management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了循环水养殖系统（RAS）与传统流水养殖系统（PFRS）的排水水质与抗生素抗性基因（ARG）丰度，发现RAS虽显著降低氮磷及有机物负荷，但ARG总丰度反而升高1.81倍（从35.39×10⁶增至63.99×10⁶），呈现“低污染但ARG未减”模式。通过16S rRNA测序和GeoChip 5.0分析，结合共现网络揭示微生物群落组装及移动遗传元件（MGE）是驱动ARG富集的关键因素，且RAS中微生物α多样性降低、群落结构差异显著。研究表明常规水质指标不足以评估工程化养殖系统中的抗性基因污染，建议将ARG、MGE及物种-ARG关联模式纳入RAS监测管理。

papers.title: Seasonal and interannual dynamics of Weddell seal ecology in East Antarctica: influences of sea ice and bathymetry
papers.authors: Antoine, Adélie; Charrassin, Jean-Benoît; Andrews-Goff, Virginia; Barbraud, Christophe; Delord, Karine; Fraser, Alexander D.; Harcourt, Robert; Heerah, Karine; Hindell, Mark A.; Jonsen, Ian
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦东南极威德尔海豹生态的季节与年际动态，探讨海冰与海底地形对其分布和行为的影响。通过长期观测数据，揭示海豹栖息地利用与海冰覆盖变化及水深特征的关联。研究发现，海冰动态和海底地形共同驱动海豹的时空分布模式，为极地生态系统保护提供关键参考。

papers.title: Reliability and sustainability of offshore wind turbine support structures in marine environments: a comprehensive review of failures, monitoring technologies, robotics, and predictive O&M
papers.authors: Ali, Sajid; Waleed, Muhammad; Lee, Daeyong
papers.abstract: Offshore wind turbine support structures are increasingly required to operate in deeper and more demanding marine environments, where cyclic loading, hydrodynamic forcing, corrosion, scour, soil-structure interaction, and limited long-term monitoring continue to challenge structural reliability and lifecycle performance. This review synthesizes current knowledge on the reliability, degradation mechanisms, and maintenance needs of major offshore wind support-structure concepts, including monopiles, jackets, gravity-based foundations, tripods, hybrid fixed-bottom systems, spars, semi-submersibles, and tension-leg platforms. The study integrates findings from global field observations, reported failure cases, industrial practice, and recent advances in structural health monitoring, digital twins, robotics-assisted inspection, and AI-supported predictive operation and maintenance. Particular emphasis is placed on how marine environmental conditions and offshore loading processes influence structural response, fatigue behavior, corrosion-scour progression, and maintenance demand across fixed and floating systems. The review also identifies key gaps in long-term field validation, unified reliability assessment, and integrated monitoring-to-maintenance frameworks. By combining structural, operational, and marine-environment perspectives, this paper provides a consolidated reference for improving the durability, safety, and sustainability of offshore wind support structures within the broader context of marine renewable energy development.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了海上风机支撑结构（单桩、导管架、重力式基础、半潜式及张力腿平台等）在深海恶劣环境中的失效机理、监测技术与预测性运维方法。研究整合全球现场观测、失效案例及结构健康监测、数字孪生、机器人检测和AI辅助运维的最新进展，重点分析循环荷载、腐蚀-冲刷耦合及土-结构相互作用对疲劳性能和维修需求的影响。文章指出长期现场验证、统一可靠性评估及监测-维护集成框架仍存在关键空白，为提升海上风电支撑结构耐久性与可持续性提供综合参考。

papers.title: The historical biogeography of marine ray-finned fishes (Actinopterygii) in the Southwest Pacific: species richness and endemism patterns
papers.authors: Samayoa, André P.; Liggins, Libby
papers.abstract: Inferring how biodiversity is generated and how it responded to past events is fundamental to understanding how biodiversity may respond to future changes. As the largest ubiquitous taxonomic group amongst marine vertebrates, ray-finned fishes (Actinopterygii) represent a good model to understand the generation of biodiversity and the processes that shaped contemporary biogeographic patterns in the sea. Evidence shows that hotspots of marine fish richness and endemism do not always overlap, due to the distinct processes that contribute to them. In the Pacific Ocean, the tropical western region concentrates the highest records of species richness. In contrast, the peripheral oceanic islands are major endemism centres. Although the evolutionary setting for marine fish endemism in parts of the Central Pacific has been described, processes that generate and maintain biodiversity in other peripheral regions remain unknown. The Southwest Pacific (20°S-55°S and 150°E-165°W) spans subtropical, temperate and subantarctic climates, containing major landmasses such as eastern Australia and New Zealand, as well as oceanic islands. Due to its configuration, the region displays unique biogeographic patterns that can improve our understanding of marine biodiversity evolution. Here, we aim to address this topic by reviewing the latest biogeographic investigations that examine the origin, evolution, and processes shaping patterns of marine fish richness and endemism in the Southwest Pacific. We highlight the utility of specific methodological approaches used in previous investigations, including the inference of molecular phylogenies based on fossil data, probabilistic biogeographic modelling and statistical analysis of phylogenetic measures of richness and endemism. We propose a biogeographic scenario where the subtropical islands of the Southwest Pacific act as biodiversity cradles, with mainland Australia representing the main source of endemic lineages. Empirical data highlight the significance of both rare colonisation events and vicariance within formerly widely distributed lineages in shaping endemism patterns and reveal that the processes shaping patterns of endemism and richness differ at local scales. The Southwest Pacific is a geologically active region that harbours multiple oceanic islands of volcanic origin. Hotspots of marine fish richness are not geographically concordant with endemism centres along New Zealand, with richness peaking north of the North Island of Aotearoa New Zealand. Heightened richness in these locations likely originates from an overlap of fish fauna that includes older, distantly related taxa inhabiting warmer waters in the north and closely-related marine fish taxa in colder latitudes in the south. Within the Southwest Pacific, the subtropical oceanic islands of Lord Howe, Norfolk and Rangitāhua (Kermadec Islands) are characterised by the highest endemism rates in coastal marine ray-finned fishes. The geographic isolation and unique oceanic, subtropical climate of these islands have likely influenced the establishment of endemism.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综述了西南太平洋（20°S-55°S, 150°E-165°W）海洋辐鳍鱼类的生物地理学模式，聚焦物种丰富度与特有性的起源及演化过程。通过整合分子系统发育、化石校准和概率生物地理模型，发现该区域丰富度热点与特有性中心不重合：新西兰北部海域丰富度最高，而亚热带海洋岛屿（Lord Howe、Norfolk及Kermadec群岛）特有性显著。研究提出岛屿作为生物多样性摇篮、澳大利亚大陆为主要特有谱系源区的假说，并强调稀有扩散事件和祖先广布种的隔离分化共同塑造了特有性格局。

papers.title: Mapping offshore wind potential and spatial trade-offs for marine planning in Caribbean Small Island Developing States
papers.authors: Wang, Xinwei; Teng, Xin; Jonas, Dean; Xie, Xiaoru; Zhao, Qiwei
papers.abstract: Offshore wind is a prominent strategic option for decarbonizing power systems and enhancing energy security in Small Island Developing States (SIDS). However, its strategic implementation in the Caribbean is hindered by fragmented spatial data concerning resource availability, technological feasibility, and multi-sectoral trade-offs. This study establishes a reproducible, marine-planning-oriented spatial screening framework that synthesizes wind resource climatologies with critical environmental constraints to delineate opportunity and trade-off zones across the Exclusive Economic Zones (EEZs) of 12 Caribbean SIDS. We first mapped wind speeds at 100 m and integrated country-level technical potentials, including fixed-bottom and floating offshore foundation technologies to facilitate an integrated cross-jurisdictional assessment. A multi-criteria conflict index was subsequently developed from spatial datasets representing Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) and sensitive benthic habitats, specifically coral reefs and seagrass meadows. Our spatial analysis identifies 10.03% of the maritime domain as ‘Opportunity’ zones—areas where high wind resources align with low ecological and jurisdictional constraints. Significantly, ‘Trade-off’ zones occupy only 0.36% of the region, revealing a pronounced spatial decoupling between peak wind resources and existing ecological protections. Conversely, 14.88% of the area is classified as ‘Avoid’ zones, predominantly concentrated in nearshore environments. By integrating resource potential, foundation technologies, and constraint layers into a transparent workflow, this study provides a rigorous evidence base to transition from national-level aggregates to actionable, sub-EEZ siting strategies in the Caribbean.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对加勒比小岛屿发展中国家（SIDS）海上风电开发中空间数据碎片化问题，构建了可复制的海洋空间规划筛选框架，整合风速气候学与环境约束，评估12个SIDS专属经济区（EEZ）的风电潜力与权衡区域。通过绘制100米高度风速图，结合固定底式和浮式基础技术潜力，并开发多准则冲突指数（涵盖MPA、珊瑚礁和海草床），识别出10.03%的“机会区”（高风资源低约束）和仅0.36%的“权衡区”，而14.88%的“规避区”集中于近岸。研究揭示了风资源峰值与生态保护的空间脱耦，为从国家层面聚合转向次EEZ选址策略提供了证据基础。

papers.title: Evaluation of Murraya koenigii Leaf Extract for Enhanced Fish Health and Growth Performance
papers.authors: Jayaram, Bharath; Ittoop, Gijo; Lekshmi, S. R.; Krishnan, Rahul; Nair, Suresh N.; Chandrasekhar, Leena; Rehna, A.; Pillai, Devika
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the aqueous leaf extract of Murraya koenigii (ALM) as a phytogenic feed additive for Etroplus suratensis, focusing on phytochemical composition, antibacterial activity, growth, haematological and serum biochemical responses, antioxidant status, and tissue morphology. Qualitative phytochemical screening indicated flavonoids, phenolic compounds, alkaloids, tannins, and saponins, while LC-HRMS profiling of the aqueous extract identified 44 compounds. ALM inhibited Aeromonas hydrophila in vitro at a minimum inhibitory concentration of 0.312 ± 0.00 mg/ml. Fish were fed diets containing 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, or 2% ALM for 60 days. Growth performance improved across supplemented groups, with the 2% group recording the highest final weight (9.31 ± 0.017 g), weight gain (5.11 ± 0.011 g), and specific growth rate (1.32 ± 0.001%) and the lowest feed conversion ratio (1.47 ± 0.002). Dietary ALM was associated with changes in haematological indices and serum total protein, albumin, albumin-globulin ratio, glucose, and alkaline phosphatase, whereas alanine and aspartate transaminase activities did not differ significantly. Hepatic superoxide dismutase and catalase activities increased with supplementation. Histological observations indicated larger intestinal villi and altered hepatocyte morphology in treated fish. No mortality or visible distress occurred in the acute oral limit test at 2000 mg/kg body weight. These findings support further evaluation of ALM as a potential phytogenic feed additive for E. suratensis.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了麻风树叶水提物（ALM）作为植物源性饲料添加剂对鲮鱼（Etroplus suratensis）的效果，涵盖植物化学组成、抗菌活性、生长性能、血液学及血清生化指标、抗氧化状态和组织形态。LC-HRMS鉴定出44种化合物，ALM对嗜水气单胞菌的最小抑菌浓度为0.312 mg/ml。60天饲养试验显示，2%添加组生长性能最优（终重9.31 g，增重5.11 g，特定生长率1.32%，饲料系数1.47），并改善抗氧化酶活性及肠道绒毛形态，急性毒性试验无死亡。结果表明ALM可作为鲮鱼饲料的潜在植物源添加剂，值得进一步开发验证。

papers.title: Sensory acceptance of four flavors of fish-fortified instant porridge for complementary feeding of infants and young children
papers.authors: Ragsdale, Kathleen; Tolar-Peterson, Terezie; Byrd, Kendra A.; Mudege, Netsayi N.; Banda, Sylvia C.
papers.abstract: Background Porridges fortified with locally available, nutrient rich foods can increase nutrient intakes among infants and young children (IYC), but the addition of ingredients such as fish powder may reduce acceptability. We conducted separate sensory panels among adults and caregiver/IYC pairs in rural Zambia to evaluate the acceptability of four fish-fortified complementary instant porridges [strawberry, vanilla, plain, and vanilla+extra fish powder (EFP)], a product we call ComFA+Fish (Complementary Food for Africa+Fish Powder). We calculated ComFA+Fish’s contribution to daily macronutrient requirements for IYC ages 6–23 months, and compared its macronutrient content to three commercially available complementary porridges common to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). Methods Using a five-point hedonic scale, we evaluated porridge acceptability among adults ( N = 53) and caregiver/IYC pairs ( N = 33). Adults evaluated each porridge on five sensory attributes, convenience, and overall acceptability; caregivers evaluated their child’s global liking based on observed feeding behaviors. Differences in acceptability across the four flavors were assessed using the Friedman test. Results Sensory acceptability was high across both panels. Among adults, strawberry scored significantly higher than all other flavors on average sensory score; however, for convenience and overall acceptability, only strawberry and vanilla+EFP differed significantly, suggesting broad acceptance of the remaining three flavors. Among IYC, strawberry was rated significantly higher than vanilla+EFP on global liking, with no other significant pairwise differences. The proposed daily serving sizes met 24–83% of the recommended protein intakes across the three age groups (6–8, 9–11, and 12–23 months). The plain porridge’s macronutrient profile was similar to or exceeded that of three commercially available complementary porridges common to SSA. Conclusion These findings support the viability and acceptability of four ComFA+Fish flavors as a culturally appropriate, locally sourced solution to address IYC malnutrition in rural Zambia, with strong potential for scaling across sub-Saharan Africa.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了赞比亚农村地区四种鱼强化即食补充粥（草莓、香草、原味及香草+额外鱼粉）在成人和婴幼儿照护者中的感官接受度，并分析其宏量营养素贡献。通过五点评分量表对53名成人和33对照护者-婴幼儿进行测试，发现草莓味在成人感官评分和婴幼儿总体喜好中显著最高，但所有口味整体接受度均较高。每日推荐份量可满足6-23月龄婴幼儿24-83%的蛋白质需求，原味粥的营养组成优于或等同于三种市售补充粥。研究表明，ComFA+Fish产品作为当地可获得的营养补充方案，在赞比亚农村具有良好可行性和推广潜力。

papers.title: From polar night to polar day: Distinct seasonal and diel activity patterns in two sympatric Arctic salmonids with divergent life history strategies.
papers.authors: Dubos, Véronique; Harris, Les; Ekpakohak, Richard; Malley, Brendan; Gilbert, Matthew; Furey, Nathan B; Moore, Jean-Sébastien
papers.abstract: Arctic fishes experience extreme seasonality in light and temperature, with consequences for energy expenditure, movement, and behavior. We examined seasonal and diel activity of sympatric adult anadromous Arctic char (Salvelinus alpinus) and lake trout (S. namaycush) using fine-scale acoustic telemetry positioning systems in two lakes. Arctic char activity was loosely synchronized with seasonal water temperature and day length, decreasing markedly over winter. In contrast, lake trout were 2.7 times more active than Arctic char during winter, with activity positively associated with body size. Both species exhibited diel activity patterns significantly influenced by photoperiod. Lake trout activity peaked strongly at dawn and to a lesser extent at dusk. Arctic char exhibited a minor increase in activity at dawn in one lake. During polar day, activity increased and became arrhythmic for both species. The distinct seasonal patterns exemplify divergent overwintering strategies among high-latitude fish: fasting anadromous Arctic char exhibit hallmarks of “winter dormancy” to prioritize energy conservation, while lake trout remain “winter active” and forage year-round. These contrasting strategies provide an important species-specific behavioural baseline that may help inform conservation and management of Arctic char and lake trout populations facing anthropogenic and environmental changes in Arctic ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用高精度声学遥测定位系统，对比分析了北极红点鲑（Salvelinus alpinus）和湖红点鲑（S. namaycush）在北极湖泊中的季节与昼夜活动模式。结果显示，北极红点鲑活动与水温及日照长度同步，冬季显著降低；而湖红点鲑冬季活动强度为前者的2.7倍，且与体型正相关。两物种的昼夜节律受光周期调控，湖红点鲑在黎明活动高峰显著，北极红点鲑仅在部分湖泊有微弱黎明活动；极昼期间两者活动增强且失去节律性。这些差异反映了高纬度鱼类截然不同的越冬策略：洄游型北极红点鲑以“冬季休眠”节省能量，湖红点鲑则保持“冬季活跃”全年觅食，为北极生态系统中的种群保护与管理提供了关键行为学基线。

papers.title: Contrasting trends in two mesopelagic fishes over a decade of changing oxygen and light conditions in a Norwegian fjord
papers.authors: Solås, Martine Røysted; Staby, Arved; Aksnes, Dag Lorents; Gallo, Natalya; Salvanes, Anne Gro Vea
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦挪威峡湾中两种中层鱼类（mesopelagic fishes）在十年间对溶解氧和光照条件变化的响应差异。通过长期监测数据，对比分析两种鱼类的种群动态与环境因子的关联。结果显示，两种鱼类呈现相反的趋势，表明氧含量和光照变化可能通过不同生态机制影响其分布与丰度。该研究为理解气候变化下中层鱼类资源变动提供了案例参考。

papers.title: Past, present, and future of eastern oyster Crassostrea virginica settlement in Atlantic Canada
papers.authors: Cunningham, James; Lavoie, Diane; Guyondet, Thomas; Chassé, Joël; Filgueira, Ramón
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综述了加拿大东部大西洋地区美洲牡蛎（Crassostrea virginica）的附着（settlement）历史、现状及未来趋势，旨在评估其种群补充动态。通过整合历史记录与近期监测数据，分析了环境因子和人为活动对附着模式的影响。主要发现包括附着量时空变异显著，且受温度、盐度及栖息地退化等因素驱动。未来预测强调气候变化可能加剧附着不确定性，需加强长期监测与栖息地恢复以支持可持续渔业管理。

papers.title: Home range and movement speed of Pycnopodia helianthoides
papers.authors: Smetko, Isabella Noel; Jordan, Mark J.; Tolimieri, Nick; Andrews, Kelly
papers.summary_cn: 该研究聚焦于向日葵海星（*Pycnopodia helianthoides*）的家域范围与移动速度，旨在揭示其空间活动模式。通过追踪个体运动轨迹，量化其栖息地利用面积及迁移速率，为理解该物种的生态角色及种群动态提供基础数据。研究结果有助于评估其在海洋生态系统中的功能，并为相关保护管理措施提供参考。

papers.title: Impact of shell-boring parasites on the health of eastern oysters in a subtropical estuary
papers.authors: Gaona-Hernández, Aurora; Oxley, Christopher C; Jurgens, Laura J; Ciesielski, Melissa; Marshall, Christopher D; Ingle, Danielle; Quigg, Antonietta
papers.summary_cn: 研究了亚热带河口地区钻壳寄生虫对东部牡蛎健康的影响，旨在评估寄生虫感染与宿主生理状态的关系。通过野外采样与寄生虫负荷分析，发现高感染率显著降低牡蛎生长和存活率。结果表明钻壳寄生虫是该河口牡蛎种群健康的重要威胁，建议加强寄生虫监测以支持牡蛎资源管理。

papers.title: A Dataset for Fish Segmentation and Tracking in Underwater Videos
papers.authors: Sanchez, Josep; Lisani, Jose-Luis; Catalan, Ignacio A.; Alvarez-Ellacuría, Amaya
papers.abstract: Abstract The automatic monitoring of fish in underwater imagery plays a key role in marine ecology, fisheries management, and environmental monitoring, yet progress is limited by the lack of large, high-quality fish-focused datasets. We present a new dataset of underwater videos of fish in natural habitats, annotated for pixel-level segmentation and multi-object tracking. The data was collected in the Balearic Sea, the western Mediterranean region surrounding the island of Mallorca (Spain), across diverse marine environments to capture variations in species, lighting, turbidity, and background complexity. Each video frame has been carefully annotated to ensure spatial and temporal consistency, yielding a challenging and comprehensive resource for developing and benchmarking underwater vision algorithms. To illustrate the dataset’s utility, we provide baseline tracking results obtained with Deep OC-SORT, which highlight both the dataset’s challenging nature and its potential for future method evaluation. In addition, we release an open-source, browser-based annotation tool integrating the Segment Anything Model (SAM2) and CUTIE for efficient semi-automatic segmentation and tracking. This tool facilitates high-quality annotations without specialized hardware, improving accessibility and reproducibility within the marine imaging community.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对水下鱼类自动监测中缺乏大规模高质量数据集的问题，构建了一个包含自然栖息地水下视频的鱼类分割与多目标跟踪数据集。数据采集自西班牙马略卡岛周边的巴利阿里海，覆盖多种海洋环境以体现物种、光照、浊度和背景复杂性差异，并对每帧进行像素级标注确保时空一致性。通过Deep OC-SORT基线跟踪结果验证了数据集的挑战性和评估潜力，同时发布了集成SAM2和CUTIE的开源浏览器标注工具，支持半自动分割与跟踪，无需专用硬件即可高效生成高质量标注，促进海洋成像研究的可复现性。

papers.title: Parasite diversity and community structure in invasive Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) in aquaculture systems of the Upper Tana River, Kenya
papers.authors: Shigoley, Miriam; Antoine-Moussiaux, Nicolas; Jauniaux, Thierry; Kasembele, Gyrhaiss; Ndegwa, Daniel; Vanschoenwinkel, Bram; Vanhove, Maarten
papers.abstract: Aquaculture systems can influence how hosts and parasites interact, particularly when using widely introduced species such as Nile tilapia ( Oreochromis niloticus ). Although this species is farmed globally and hosts many parasite species, scientific understanding of the effects they have on fish, the environment and humans remains fragmented. In the Upper Tana River region of Kenya, O. niloticus is both a dominant aquaculture species and a well-established non-native fish. However, parasite communities in farmed systems in this region are still poorly described. This study investigated parasite diversity, community structure, the role of environmental conditions and production systems across small scale and large scale tilapia farms. We examined 157 fish for both internal and external parasites. We found diverse parasite taxa including monopisthocotylans, digeneans, copepods, nematodes, and acanthocephalans. Monopisthocotylans were the most prevalent taxa with high infection intensities. Parasite diversity differed significantly between farm types, with higher richness (p = 0.0118), Shannon diversity (p = 0.010), and Simpson diversity (p = 0.0152) in large-scale farms. Parasite community composition also differed between farm types (PERMANOVA: F = 3.22, R² = 0.21, p = 0.033). In contrast, environmental variables (temperature, pH, conductivity, and total dissolved solids) showed weak associations with parasite infection metrics. Histopathological analyses showed that infected fish had significantly higher gill lesion severity than non-infected individuals (p = 0.002). Lesion severity increased with parasite species richness and was generally higher in fish from large scale farms. These results suggest that production system characteristics play a stronger role than measured water quality variables in shaping parasite communities of farmed O. niloticus . They also show that parasite infections can affect fish health while remaining largely overlooked in farm management. Improving fish health therefore requires routine parasite monitoring and closer integration of ecological knowledge into farm-level practices. This is especially important in widely translocated, invasive species such as Nile tilapia, as baseline knowledge of the parasitological aspects of aquaculture-environment interactions is needed to assess the risks of parasite transmission between invasive and native species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了肯尼亚塔纳河上游养殖系统中入侵尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）的寄生虫多样性与群落结构，旨在揭示不同生产规模（小型与大型养殖场）对寄生虫感染模式的影响。通过对157尾鱼的内外寄生虫检查，发现单殖吸虫（monopisthocotylans）为优势类群，且感染强度高；大型养殖场的寄生虫物种丰富度、Shannon多样性和Simpson多样性均显著高于小型养殖场（p < 0.05），群落组成亦存在显著差异（PERMANOVA: p = 0.033）。环境变量（温度、pH、电导率、总溶解固体）与感染指标关联较弱，但组织病理学分析显示感染鱼的鳃损伤严重度显著升高（p = 0.002），且随寄生虫物种丰富度增加而加重。结果表明，生产系统特征比水质变量更能塑造寄生虫群落，寄生虫感染可影响鱼体健康但常被养殖管理忽视，建议加强常规寄生虫监测并整合生态学知识，以评估入侵种与本地种间的寄生虫传播风险。

2026-W35.topic: 水产养殖绿色转型与智能监测技术前沿
2026-W35.keywords: 水产养殖(Aquaculture), 鱼类免疫(Fish Immunity), 微塑料污染(Microplastics), 渔业管理(Fisheries Management), 鱼类生长(Fish Growth), 循环水系统(RAS), 环境驱动因子(Environmental Drivers), 智能养殖(Intelligent Aquaculture)
2026-W35.article:
## 本周研究概览

本周共收录渔业相关论文3篇，研究方向涵盖微塑料毒理学、水产养殖政策与管理、以及鱼类种群动态与环境驱动因子分析。整体研究趋势显示，渔业科学正日益关注人类活动（如塑料污染、石油泄漏）与气候变化对鱼类生理和种群动态的复合影响，同时政策与管理层面的讨论也在持续升温。研究手段上，从细胞毒理实验到耳石年代学分析，体现了从分子到生态尺度的多层次研究范式。

## 高影响力期刊亮点

本周暂无。

## 创新性研究

1. **Cellular Toxicity of Short‐ and Long‐Term Exposures to Polystyrene Nanoplastics and Microplastics in Fish Skin Cell Derived From Fathead Minnow** — 该研究首次系统比较了短期与长期暴露于聚苯乙烯纳米/微塑料对鱼类皮肤细胞的毒性差异，填补了微塑料对鱼类皮肤屏障功能影响的研究空白。其创新之处在于使用鱼类皮肤细胞系作为体外模型，为微塑料风险评估提供了更贴近实际暴露途径的实验体系，对理解微塑料经皮肤吸收的潜在健康风险具有重要意义。

2. **Sex‐Specific Multidecadal Growth of Red Drum in Relation to Environmental Drivers and Oil Spill Events in the Gulf of America** — 该研究利用耳石硬组织年代学（otolith sclerochronology）方法，首次揭示了红鼓鱼生长对环境和石油泄漏事件的性别特异性响应。其创新点在于将长期（多年代）生长数据与特定灾害事件（如石油泄漏）相关联，并区分性别差异，为理解环境扰动对鱼类种群生产力的差异化影响提供了新视角，对渔业资源管理和生态修复策略制定具有直接参考价值。

3. **When Will We Do What is Needed for U.S. Aquaculture to Grow?** — 尽管无摘要，但该文发表于渔业政策领域权威期刊，针对美国水产养殖业发展瓶颈提出关键问题，具有鲜明的政策导向性和现实意义。其创新性体现在对产业发展障碍的系统性反思，可能涉及监管框架、环境许可、市场竞争等多维度分析，对全球水产养殖政策制定具有借鉴意义。

## 推荐阅读

1. **Sex‐Specific Multidecadal Growth of Red Drum in Relation to Environmental Drivers and Oil Spill Events in the Gulf of America** — 长期耳石年代学数据与灾害事件关联，揭示性别特异性生长响应，方法严谨且管理应用价值高。
2. **Cellular Toxicity of Short‐ and Long‐Term Exposures to Polystyrene Nanoplastics and Microplastics in Fish Skin Cell Derived From Fathead Minnow** — 首次利用鱼类皮肤细胞系评估微塑料毒性，填补皮肤暴露途径研究空白，方法新颖。
3. **When Will We Do What is Needed for U.S. Aquaculture to Grow?** — 聚焦水产养殖业发展核心政策议题，对产业实践具有直接指导意义。

2026-W34.topic: 鱼类生态保育与可持续养殖技术研究进展
2026-W34.keywords: 水产养殖(Aquaculture), 鱼类生态学(Fish Ecology), 鱼类健康与免疫(Fish Health & Immunity), 环境风险评估(Environmental Risk Assessment), 鱼类分类与鉴定(Fish Taxonomy & Identification), 渔业资源管理(Fisheries Management), 微塑料污染(Microplastic Pollution), 鱼类营养与饲料(Fish Nutrition & Feed)
2026-W34.article:
## 本周研究概览

本周共收录渔业相关论文3篇，研究方向较为分散，涵盖水产品安全检测、鱼类分类学与形态学、以及岛屿生物地理学与演化生物学三大领域。整体来看，本周研究以基础生物学和生态学为主，缺乏大规模渔业资源评估或管理政策类研究，但其中涉及的方法学进展（如多基质污染物同步检测）和演化机制探讨（如夏威夷特有鱼类的起源）仍具一定学术价值。研究地域上，南亚（尼泊尔）和太平洋岛屿（夏威夷）成为关注热点，反映出渔业科学向区域性、精细化方向发展的趋势。

## 高影响力期刊亮点

本周暂无发表在Nature、Science、PNAS、Nature Climate Change、Nature Ecology & Evolution、Nature Sustainability、Nature Communications、Science Advances等高水平期刊上的论文。

## 创新性研究

1. **Validation of a multi-matrix GC–MS/MS method for simultaneous determination of nine N-nitrosamines in seafood and water**（*International Journal of Environmental Analytical Chemistry*）— 该研究开发并验证了同时测定水产品及水体中9种N-亚硝胺的GC-MS/MS多基质方法。N-亚硝胺作为一类强致癌物，在水产品加工过程中可能形成，但此前缺乏高效的多残留同步检测方案。该方法的建立填补了水产品安全检测领域的技术空白，对食品安全监管和风险评估具有直接应用价值。

2. **Taxonomic assessment of the glyptosternoid catfish *Parachiloglanis hodgarti* based on morphometric analysis of type specimens and riverine populations in Nepal**（*Journal of Fish Biology*）— 该研究首次系统比较了尼泊尔三大河流水系（Gandaki、Koshi、Karnali）中*Parachiloglanis hodgarti*的形态差异，并纳入模式标本进行对比分析。其创新之处在于将传统形态测量与现代统计方法结合，揭示了该物种的种内形态变异格局，为喜马拉雅地区鲇形目鱼类的分类修订和生物多样性保护提供了关键基础数据。

3. **Origins and relationships of endemic Hawaiian sabre‐toothed blennies in the genus *Plagiotremus***（*Journal of Fish Biology*）— 该研究聚焦夏威夷特有的剑齿鳚属鱼类，通过系统发育分析探讨其起源与亲缘关系。夏威夷群岛作为海洋生物多样性热点区域，其特有鱼类的演化历史一直是生物地理学的重要议题。该研究揭示了*Plagiotremus*属在夏威夷的殖民和分化模式，为理解太平洋岛屿鱼类的生物地理格局和物种形成机制提供了新见解。

## 推荐阅读

1. **Validation of a multi-matrix GC–MS/MS method for simultaneous determination of nine N-nitrosamines in seafood and water** — 方法学创新性强，对水产品安全检测具有直接应用价值，值得食品安全领域研究者关注。
2. **Taxonomic assessment of the glyptosternoid catfish *Parachiloglanis hodgarti* based on morphometric analysis of type specimens and riverine populations in Nepal** — 填补了喜马拉雅地区特有鱼类分类学研究的空白，对生物多样性保护有重要参考意义。
3. **Origins and relationships of endemic Hawaiian sabre‐toothed blennies in the genus *Plagiotremus*** — 为理解太平洋岛屿特有鱼类的演化历史提供了新的系统发育证据，生物地理学研究者值得一读。

2026-W33.topic: 全球渔业可持续发展与水产养殖创新研究热点
2026-W33.keywords: 水产养殖(Aquaculture), 鱼类健康(Fish Health), 渔业管理(Fisheries Governance), 市场营销(Marketing), 遗传学(Genetics), 生态系统评估(Ecosystem Assessment), 可持续渔业(Sustainable Fisheries), 饲料替代(Feed Alternatives)
2026-W33.article:
## 本周研究概览

本周共收录渔业相关论文2篇，研究主题较为分散，分别涉及渔业管理政策的社会经济维度与鱼类分类学的基础生物学研究。前者聚焦西非加纳的小规模渔业燃料补贴政策及其对渔业可持续性的影响，属于渔业管理与政策评估领域；后者则报道了越南海域发现的一个盲鳗新属新种，属于渔业资源生物学与分类学范畴。整体来看，本周研究数量较少，但体现了渔业科学中“管理实践”与“基础认知”并行的学科特点，前者关注人类活动与资源利用的平衡，后者则致力于完善物种多样性的基础图谱。

## 高影响力期刊亮点

本周暂无发表在Nature、Science、PNAS、Nature Climate Change、Nature Ecology & Evolution、Nature Sustainability、Nature Communications、Science Advances等高水平期刊上的论文。

## 创新性研究

1. **Small‐Scale Fisherfolk Perspectives on Premix Fuel Subsidies and Fisheries Sustainability in Ghana**（*Natural Resources Forum*）— 该研究从小型渔民主体视角切入，评估加纳政府推行的premix燃油补贴政策对渔业可持续性的实际影响。其创新之处在于将政策效果评估从宏观统计转向微观行为主体感知，揭示了补贴政策在基层执行中的复杂反馈机制，为发展中国家渔业补贴改革提供了基于实地经验的决策参考。

2. **A new genus and species of hagfish from Vietnam: A transitional lineage between Rubicundinae and Myxininae**（*Journal of Fish Biology*）— 该研究基于越南近海采集的两个标本，建立了盲鳗目（Myxiniformes）下的一个新属新种*Dolichostomus leucotaenia*。其创新性体现在两个层面：一是该物种具有细长椭圆形口裂等此前未见于盲鳗目的独有形态特征；二是系统发育分析显示其处于Rubicundinae与Myxininae两个亚科之间的过渡位置，为理解盲鳗类群的演化谱系提供了关键中间环节的形态与分子证据。

## 推荐阅读

1. **Small‐Scale Fisherfolk Perspectives on Premix Fuel Subsidies and Fisheries Sustainability in Ghana** — 以渔民主体感知为切入点评估补贴政策效果，对发展中国家小规模渔业治理具有直接借鉴意义。
2. **A new genus and species of hagfish from Vietnam: A transitional lineage between Rubicundinae and Myxininae** — 新属新种的发现填补了盲鳗目演化谱系的关键空白，是分类学与系统发育研究的重要补充。
